jobs.description:
VP of Strategic Finance

Competitive compensation: $230,000–$300,000 + equity

Why You Should Choose Steno

When you join Steno, you're not just joining a finance team - you're joining a company that:

  • Wins together – Stock options included. When Steno grows, you grow.
  • Invests in you – Premium Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage — options for you and your family, with generous employer contributions toward premiums.
  • Supports your wellbeing – Wellness and mental health benefits to be used among employees and families.
  • Operates with integrity – We value long-term partnerships over short-term wins.
  • Constantly innovates with technology at our core – We are a modern organization solving real problems in an industry that needs a revolutionary approach.
  • Gives you room to build – You own your domain, drive your own agenda, and serve as a true thought partner to leadership.

Why Strategic Finance at Steno Is Different

Steno is an operationally complex business, and the financials are always a downstream read on what’s happening upstream. That means the interesting questions don’t live in the P&L — they live in how jobs get scheduled, how providers get paid, how firms get invoiced, how sales teams get deployed, and how product usage ladders up to revenue. You will be the person who diagnoses across all of it. It's a strategic, high-impact role where you:

  • Own the full FP&A cycle — reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis — with the narrative depth that helps leadership understand not just what happened, but why, and what it means for next quarter.
  • Act as the company’s internal consulting bench — pick up the ambiguous, cross-functional problems that don’t yet have an owner and run them from problem framing to decision to implementation.
  • Diagnose beyond the model — when something moves in the P&L, trace it back to what actually happened in the business: a comp plan change, a service delivery constraint, a product decision, a team restructure.
  • Drive action, not just insight — use data to inform real-time decisions on staffing, pipeline performance, pricing, and resource allocation.
  • Connect the dots across the company — surface the insights that span teams before anyone thinks to ask for them.
  • Build with a systems mindset — evaluate tools, data infrastructure, and processes with an eye toward scalability, integration, and downstream impact.
  • Lead the company’s highest-stakes analytical work — unit economics, investment cases, new business models, and deep dives that shape company direction.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the SVP of Finance — pressure-test assumptions, flag second-order impacts, and bring rigor to decisions that span the business.

You'll report directly to Dayna Shi, SVP of Finance, and work cross-functionally across the organization. There is no ceiling on the impact you can have.

The ideal candidate brings 8+ years of experience spanning FP&A and Business Operations, including time in investment banking, management consulting, or a BizOps / Strategy & Operations seat at a scaling company. They have a track record of owning the FP&A cycle end-to-end — reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and board-level narrative — at a company with real operational complexity. They operate with deep analytical rigor and have experience running ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from framing through to decision.

This person thinks in systems, communicates complex analysis with clarity, and has a bias toward operational action. Experience in SaaS, legal tech, or marketplace businesses is highly valued, as is familiarity with tools like Looker, dbt, or Snowflake

Who You Are

You are genuinely curious about how every part of the business works, and you have learned to read financial outcomes through a business-first lens. When revenue is down, your first question isn’t “what changed in the model?” — it’s “what happened in the business that the P&L can’t show me?” That answer might live in Ops (a service delivery constraint, a throughput issue), in GTM (a territory change, a comp plan that shifted rep behavior), in Product (a change that affected how clients experience the service), or in a people decision made two quarters ago. You know the P&L is a lagging report on decisions that were already made — and you’ve built the instinct to work backwards from the number to the real cause.

You think like an internal consultant. You’re the person other leaders pull in when a problem is messy, cross-functional, and doesn’t have an obvious owner — because you can frame the question, build the analytical case, align the stakeholders, and see the work through to a decision. You distinguish leading indicators from lagging ones instinctively. When you build a model or a report, you don’t stop at the dashboard — you use it to change how a team operates.

You also think in systems. When a new tool is being evaluated or a new business unit is being modeled, you’re already considering how it connects to the broader ecosystem, who needs to be involved, and how to set things up for success. You are comfortable operating in environments where the infrastructure is evolving and the process is still being built — you see that as an opportunity to create something better.

Application Information

  • Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information included in an application, is collected, analyzed, and stored in our system.

Senior Backend / Product Engineer(AI Platform)

Location: Remote
Type: Full-time
Team: Cost Optimisation (CO) – Product Engineering
Reports to: Product Lead (CO)

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 professionals across 130+ countries. We specialise in cloud architecture, engineering, and transformation, helping enterprises deliver at scale while building internal capability and reducing third-party dependency.

We work with ambitious, forward-thinking organisations to solve real-world challenges through hands-on execution, deep technical expertise, and a delivery-led approach.

The Role

We’re hiring a senior backend-first product engineer to help build and scale our AI-powered cost intelligence platform.

This role is explicitly product-focused. You will not be pulled into client delivery. Your mission is to build core platform capabilities that mature our current FinOps platform into a smart intelligence platform - including AI-driven insights, workflows, and agent-based features that can be sold as standalone capabilities.

You’ll operate with high autonomy, significant ownership, and direct access to product leadership. Think founding engineer energy, without the chaos.

You will help define how AI capabilities move from experimentation to durable product features, with an emphasis on reliability, cost efficiency, and clear user value - not just model novelty.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and build backend-heavy platform features for our platform.

  • Productionalise AI-enabled capabilities (e.g. anomaly detection, recommendations, agent-based workflows).

  • Implement AI thoughtfully across the entire SDLC - prototyping, testing, iteration, and deployment.

  • Collaborate closely with Product to turn vision into shipped features.

  • Identify blockers early, communicate clearly, and iterate fast.

  • Help shape engineering standards and patterns as the product matures.

  • You will help define how AI capabilities move from experimentation to durable product features, with an emphasis on reliability, cost efficiency, and clear user value - not just model novelty.

  • Design systems that support model evaluation, prompt/version management, and deterministic fallbacks to ensure AI-driven features are observable, testable, and production-safe.

  • Build AI features with explicit evaluation criteria, feedback loops, and guardrails (accuracy, latency, cost, and explainability) so models improve predictably over time.

Success in the first 6–12 months looks like:

  • 2+ production-ready features shipped.

jobs.description:
About Eve
Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

The Role

Eve is doubling revenue quarter over quarter, and the platform is being built to keep pace. A medallion architecture is in place on a Terraform-managed Snowflake footprint. Most of what goes on top is still ahead: the access and governance model, ingestion and orchestration built for the volume coming, reliability practice, and the standards every contributor works inside.

The data spans product usage, case and firm data, and every go-to-market system Eve runs on. Analytics engineers and business analysts build models and reporting on top of it, and increasingly AI agents query it directly. That last part raises the bar on everything underneath: an agent with broad access is a different kind of risk than a person with broad access, and a stale model is a different kind of problem when something automated is reading it rather than a human who would notice the number looked wrong.

As the Staff engineer, you set technical direction and take on the problems where the right answer isn't obvious yet. What the warehouse looks like at ten times the volume. How access works for a company holding client and case data. Which tools to buy and which to build.

You'll have real say in how the platform gets built. You'll work on our central team and report to the Head of Data Engineering, who reports directly to the CEO. Data is a first-class function at Eve and the fuel to drive our future growth.

What You'll Do

Build and run the platform

  • Own the role-based access model: role hierarchy, least-privilege grants across the medallion layers, and scoped access for service accounts, BI tools, and AI agents rather than broad inherited access
  • Manage grants as code and run the access review cycle, so the process itself is the audit evidence
  • Own Snowflake administration: security and network policies, data masking and PII controls, storage organization, compute cost, and retention
  • Extend the medallion architecture and the Terraform-managed footprint. Own state, module design, and environment promotion, including full separation of development and production
  • Own ingestion through Fivetran, third-party connectors, and custom extraction where no connector exists, including a defined review of what data is allowed to land
  • Own orchestration across dbt platform and GitHub Actions, own materialization strategy and model performance, move critical models off nightly full rebuilds onto incremental patterns, and cut latency where decisions are waiting on stale data
  • Build source-schema change detection, so an upstream field change surfaces as an alert before it reaches a report
  • Stand up observability: freshness SLAs on critical tables, alerting on failure and drift, and an incident path with clear ownership
  • Contribute to the foundational modeling layer the Analytics Engineers build on: source-to-staging patterns, conformed dimensions, shared entities, and SCD patterns that make history reliable

Set the direction

  • Define the dbt project architecture and the git-based development workflow, CI, and testing standards every model passes through, including the macro and package libraries and the isolated development environments that let analysts contribute safely
  • Partner on data retention and customer data handling policy, and implement the technical controls behind it
  • Establish how the team uses AI-assisted development: Claude Code skills, agents, and evals as part of the workflow, held to the same review bar as anything else
  • Build the tooling and setup that gets a new engineer or analyst productive in days, not weeks
  • Document as you build. If it isn't written down, it isn't done
  • Mentor engineers and analysts, and set the technical bar for how data engineering gets done at Eve

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in data engineering, including time at a staff or senior IC level setting technical direction others followed
  • Deep Snowflake administration, especially designing a role-based access model from scratch: role hierarchy, least-privilege grants, and scoping access for service accounts and tools. Plus masking, PII controls, and cost management
  • Strong Python and SQL, with production experience across ingestion (Fivetran or similar), orchestration (dbt platform, GitHub Actions, or Airflow), and cloud infrastructure
  • Advanced dbt: modeling patterns, macros, incremental models, testing, and slim or state-based CI. Experience building SCD tables from multiple sources
  • Experience building the dbt developer experience for contributors outside a core engineering team: project structure, guardrails, and CI that lets people with mixed skill levels extend a codebase safely
  • Experience with layered warehouse architecture (medallion or equivalent) and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform, including state and environment promotion
  • You've built the access and governance layer somewhere that had to pass an audit
  • Track record building reliability practice from zero: freshness SLAs, alerting, incident response, schema change detection
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development such as Claude Code, including agentic pipeline design and skill-based workflows, and comfort integrating tools via MCP servers
  • Strong communication, a habit of mentoring, and comfort building where the playbook doesn't exist yet

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in a regulated or high-sensitivity data environment (legal, healthcare, financial services)
  • Experience supporting ML or GenAI workloads: feature stores, unstructured data, Snowflake Cortex
  • B2B SaaS, especially selling to small and mid-sized businesses or professional services firms

GaggleAMP is a profitable, bootstrapped company that has led the employee-advocacy category for over a decade. We're adding our second seller: a full-cycle closer who qualifies hard, sells on value, holds price, and would rather walk from a bad-fit deal than chase it.

This is a seat where your judgement and your pipeline are your own. If you've been closing well inside someone else's playbook and want the autonomy to run on your own, keep reading.

Why this role

  • You will be our second seller and the first real benchmark for what great looks like here. Your results will shape how we hire and coach the team that comes after you.
  • Real autonomy. You own your pipeline, your qualification calls, and your deal strategy, with leadership support when it counts.
  • A motion worth building. We have a documented sales framework, real pricing power, and a value story that wins, and you will help sharpen the tools as we scale.
  • A clear growth path. As the company grows, this role grows into larger and more strategic deals, including division-to-corporate and global expansion, at a higher quota.
  • A profitable, bootstrapped company. No venture clock and no death-march growth targets. Just durable growth and a category we have led for over a decade.


What you will own

  • Carry an individual new-business quota (1M in new ARR) and own the pipeline that gets you there, whether the leads come from marketing or from your own prospecting.
  • Qualify every opportunity hard. Confirm fit, find the person who controls the budget, and build a real value case before you invest your time. Disqualify fast when those are not there.
  • Run value-led discovery and tie our impact to the buyer's real numbers (revenue from social-driven pipeline, or the paid spend we offset) before price ever enters the conversation.
  • Hold price. We do not discount. You will sell our value at list and let unqualified deals go.
  • Keep a forecast people can trust. Advance deals on what the buyer actually does, not on activity, and keep your CRM honest in real time.
  • Partner cleanly with Marketing, Implementation, and Customer Success, and bring in leadership at the right moments on larger deals.


What we are looking for

  • You have carried and hit a full-cycle new-business quota at a company near our size, selling roughly 18k to 60k deals to senior marketing or revenue buyers.
  • You qualify against a real standard and you disqualify without drama. A clean no is a good outcome to you.
  • You build value cases from what the buyer actually tells you, in dollars, and you can pivot to clicks, reach, and traffic value when a buyer has no hard number.
  • You hold price and tie it to value rather than defending it.
  • You keep clean pipeline data and an honest forecast, and you advance deals on buyer commitment.
  • You generate your own pipeline and do not wait for leads to be handed to you.
  • You use a modern tech stack to create leverage, and you can name the specific AI tools (for example ChatGPT and Claude) and prospecting tools (for example Apollo) you use, and the exact workflows you run with them. Concrete, not abstract.


What we are not looking for

  • Reps who need an SDR team, heavy ops support, or a finished playbook to perform.

  • Sellers who move a deal forward because a call went well or a demo got booked, rather than because the buyer did something real.

160,000 OTE with uncapped commission. Remote within the United States.

How our process works

Our process includes a set of written questions and a Culture Index survey before we go deep. It is how we keep the process fair and consistent for everyone. If that feels like a barrier, this probably is not the right fit, and that is okay.

Finance Manager, Strategy & Operations

Your Mission As Finance Manager

Reporting to the Vice President of Finance, the Finance Manager, Strategy & Operations is a senior individual contributor responsible for helping scale the finance organization as the company grows through organic expansion and acquisitions. This role combines financial planning and analysis, technical accounting, international finance, systems implementation, and process improvement to support the Company’s long-term growth and day-to-day financial operations. Working closely with the Controller and other finance leaders, including the Director of Finance in India, this role will provide broad finance support, cross-functional partnership, and continuity across the global finance function

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced SaaS environment, enjoys building scalable finance infrastructure, and takes ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution. This is a hands-on role that requires the ability to balance strategic thinking with day-to-day financial operations. The successful candidate will serve as a strategic finance partner with primary ownership of FP&A, finance systems, process improvement, and other cross-functional initiatives, while providing practical operational support across the finance organization.

Accountability & Impact:In this role, you’ll...

Financial Leadership & Reporting

  • Support timely and accurate financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP, in partnership with the Controller.
  • Prepare, review, and analyze consolidated financial statements and management reporting for domestic and international entities.
  • Provide hands-on operational support for the monthly close, annual audit, technical accounting matters, and other accounting priorities as needed.
  • Support the Controller to maintain and enhance accounting policies, internal controls, and financial reporting processes.
  • Serve as a designated operational backup to the Controller for routine finance and accounting activities, helping maintain continuity during planned absences, major projects, and periods of increased business need.

Financial Planning & Strategic Analysis

  • Own the annual budgeting process, rolling forecasts, and long-range financial planning.
  • Develop and manage executive dashboards, KPI reporting, board materials, lender reporting, and other decision-support reporting.
  • Analyze financial and operating results, identify trends and risks, and provide actionable insights to executive leadership.
  • Build financial models and business cases to support strategic initiatives, resource allocation, investments, and acquisition-related decisions.
  • Partner with business leaders to evaluate opportunities, risks, operational performance, and progress against financial goals.

International Finance, Compliance & Revenue Operations

  • Coordinate financial reporting and finance activities across domestic and international operations, including foreign currency consolidations and statutory reporting support.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance in India and other internal and external stakeholders to coordinate international financial reporting, compliance, foreign currency matters, statutory requirements, and other cross-border finance initiatives, while respecting local functional ownership.
  • Support subscription accounting, ASC 606 revenue recognition, commission reporting, and recurring revenue analytics in partnership with the Controller and other finance stakeholders.
  • Coordinate global sales tax, indirect tax, and other regulatory compliance requirements with internal owners and external advisors.

Finance Transformation & Business Operations

  • Own finance transformation initiatives that improve scalability, efficiency, controls, and data integrity.
  • Lead the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of finance systems, ERP platforms, reporting tools, and related finance technology.
  • Partner cross-functionally to improve financial processes, automate workflows, strengthen data flows, and integrate business systems.
  • Develop and document standardized financial processes, operating procedures, and controls that support a scalable finance organization.
  • Manage and support finance integration activities for acquisitions and other strategic initiatives, including planning, systems, reporting, process alignment, and cross-functional coordination.

What You Bring to the Role:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • 8–10 years of progressive accounting and finance experience, with demonstrated breadth across FP&A, accounting, and finance operations
  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP with the ability to provide practical support across accounting and reporting matters
  • Strong FP&A experience, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and executive-level analysis
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and analyzing consolidated financial statements
  • Experience supporting multi-entity, international entities and foreign currency accounting
  • SaaS industry experience
  • Experience with subscription-based business models and recurring revenue
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and partner effectively across functions
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate financial information into clear business recommendations

Nice to haves:

  • Experience supporting finance integration for acquired companies or other complex business integrations
  • ERP implementation, finance systems, or finance transformation experience
  • NetSuite implementation experience
  • Salesforce, Zuora, or other subscription billing platforms
  • International tax and transfer pricing experience
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools (e.g., Sigma, Power BI, Tableau)

jobs.excerpt: This job posting is available in English and Canadian French.
jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.
Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote | U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

  • $150,000 USD (for U.S based candidates)
  • $150,000 CAD (for Canadian based candidates)

The Senior Strategy Director plays a central role in shaping how the agency thinks, plans, and delivers impact for clients. This role is responsible for defining strategic direction across priority accounts and ensuring that media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams are aligned to a unified business objective.

This role requires an insight-driven mindset and the ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic direction. The Senior Strategy Director will guide growth diagnosis, define strategic priorities, and create the connective tissue across disciplines that ensures execution consistently ladders up to clear intent and measurable outcomes.

At our agency, strategy is not a service line, it is how we work. The Senior Strategy Director ensures that insight, planning, and decision-making are embedded throughout the lifecycle of our client partnerships.

About Level

We’re an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.

We’ve been named one of Pittsburgh’s Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.

Your Role (and Impact)

What You’ll Own:

  • Strategic Direction for Priority Accounts: You’ll lead strategic direction on high-impact client engagements, ensuring that marketing activities align with clear business objectives and growth opportunities. You’ll guide discovery, develop strategy briefs, and translate business challenges into structured, actionable plans.
  • Strategic Planning & Roadmapping: You’ll contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles by developing growth roadmaps tied to measurable outcomes. You’ll clarify priorities, define success metrics, and ensure teams are aligned around a shared understanding of strategic intent.
  • Strategy Brief Development: You’ll own the development of strategy briefs that define business objectives, growth priorities, audience insights, positioning, channel approach, investment logic, and measurement frameworks. These briefs will serve as the foundation that aligns cross-functional teams before execution begins.
  • Audience, Market & Category Insights: You’ll lead the development of audience insights, competitive analysis, and market intelligence that inform strategic recommendations. You’ll translate research and performance data into clear implications that guide decision-making across teams.
  • Channel Strategy & Investment Planning: You’ll bring deep media strategy and planning expertise to define channel mix, sequencing, and investment logic that support growth objectives — fuelling full-funnel media plans that mature clients’ media programs beyond performance marketing and extend coverage across every stage of the customer journey, from awareness through retention. You’ll collaborate with media, CRM, SEO, and digital experience leaders to ensure channel decisions and budget allocation are aligned with the broader strategic framework.
  • Measurement Frameworks & Performance Interpretation: You’ll establish measurement frameworks that define success before activation begins. You’ll help teams interpret performance signals, ensuring insights drive decisions rather than simply informing reporting.
  • Strategic Performance Storytelling: You’ll lead strategic narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews and planning discussions, articulating what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what actions should follow. Your storytelling will connect data, insights, and business implications into clear recommendations.
  • Client Strategic Partnership: You’ll serve as a strategic partner for client stakeholders, confidently leading conversations around growth opportunities, planning priorities, and strategic recommendations. You’ll guide discussions beyond tactical execution toward long-term business impact.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Strategic Alignment: You’ll act as the connective tissue across media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams to ensure that strategy is consistently integrated into execution. You’ll align KPIs, messaging, channel strategies, and measurement frameworks to ensure clear business intent.
  • Strategy Enablement Across Teams: You’ll equip account and delivery teams with frameworks and guidance that elevate the quality and consistency of strategic thinking across the agency. Your work will help simplify planning and bring clarity to complex challenges.
  • Strategic Standards & Framework Development: You’ll contribute to the evolution of agency-wide strategy frameworks, playbooks, and planning tools. You’ll help embed strategy into briefs, planning cycles, and optimization rhythms so that it becomes a core operating discipline.
  • Thought Leadership & New Business Support: You’ll contribute to agency POVs, category playbooks, and growth narratives that strengthen our market differentiation. You’ll support new business opportunities through strategic storytelling and insight-driven positioning.

Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Strong experience developing integrated marketing strategies across multiple channels and disciplines.
  • Proven media strategy and planning experience, with the ability to architect full-funnel, multi-stage media plans that mature clients' programs beyond performance marketing into upper- and mid-funnel brand and demand strategies.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into clear strategic direction that guides cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from performance data, research, and market intelligence.
  • Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how messaging, channels, customer experience, and measurement connect.
  • Excellent storytelling and communication skills, able to frame complex ideas in a clear and compelling narrative.
  • Strong facilitation and collaboration skills, able to align cross-disciplinary teams around shared strategic priorities.
  • Executive presence and confidence when presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
  • Growth-oriented mindset with openness to feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple planning cycles and strategic initiatives simultaneously.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and bringing clarity to complex business challenges.

Education & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, integrated strategy, brand strategy, media strategy/planning, or growth strategy within an agency or client-side environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building and evolving media strategies across the full customer journey, not limited to lower-funnel performance channels.
  • Demonstrated experience developing cross-channel, integrated marketing strategies.
  • Experience guiding annual planning, strategic roadmapping, and growth discussions with clients.
  • Experience collaborating across media, creative, digital experience, CRM, and analytics teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field.
  • Industry experience in CPG or B2B is an asset but not required.
  • Experience in the education sector (for-profit and/or not-for-profit institutions) is strongly preferred.

AI Expectations

    • Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process.
    • Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine.
  • AI is not a shortcut—it’s a skillset. You’re expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level.

Our Core Values

Level Is Built on Inclusion

Le directeur principal ou la directrice principale de la stratégie joue un rôle central dans la façon dont l'agence réfléchit, planifie et génère de l'impact pour ses clients. Ce rôle est responsable de définir l'orientation stratégique des comptes prioritaires et de veiller à ce que les équipes média, création, SEO, CRM, web et analytique soient alignées sur un objectif d'affaires commun.

Ce rôle exige un esprit axé sur les insights et la capacité de traduire des défis d'affaires complexes en une orientation stratégique claire. Le directeur principal ou la directrice principale de la stratégie pilotera le diagnostic de croissance, définira les priorités stratégiques et créera les liens entre les disciplines pour que l'exécution soit toujours alignée sur une intention claire et des résultats mesurables.

Dans notre agence, la stratégie n'est pas une gamme de services, c'est notre façon de travailler. Le directeur principal ou la directrice principale de la stratégie veille à ce que les insights, la planification et la prise de décision soient intégrés à chaque étape du cycle de vie de nos partenariats clients.

À propos de Level

Nous sommes une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA — bâtie pour la précision, conçue pour évoluer et guidée par une mentalité scientifique. Chez Level, nous combinons stratégie, médias, création et intelligence machine pour livrer des résultats qui comptent. Chaque fois. À grande échelle.

Nous avons été nommés parmi les meilleurs lieux de travail de Pittsburgh et reconnus comme l’une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide du classement Inc. 500. Nos clients œuvrent notamment en B2B, en éducation, en santé, en services financiers, en commerce électronique et dans plusieurs autres secteurs.

Votre rôle et votre impact

Vos responsabilités :

  • Orientation stratégique des comptes prioritaires : Vous dirigerez l'orientation stratégique de mandats clients à fort impact, en veillant à ce que les activités marketing soient alignées sur des objectifs d'affaires clairs et des occasions de croissance. Vous piloterez la phase de découverte, rédigerez des briefs stratégiques et transformerez les défis d'affaires en plans structurés et concrets.
  • Planification stratégique et feuilles de route : Vous contribuerez aux cycles de planification annuels et trimestriels en élaborant des feuilles de route de croissance liées à des résultats mesurables. Vous clarifierez les priorités, définirez les indicateurs de succès et veillerez à ce que les équipes partagent une compréhension commune de l'intention stratégique.
  • Élaboration des briefs stratégiques : Vous serez responsable de l'élaboration des briefs stratégiques qui définissent les objectifs d'affaires, les priorités de croissance, les insights sur l'audience, le positionnement, l'approche par canal, la logique d'investissement et les cadres de mesure. Ces briefs serviront de fondation pour aligner les équipes multidisciplinaires avant le début de l'exécution.
  • Insights sur l'audience, le marché et la catégorie : Vous dirigerez l'élaboration des insights sur l'audience, de l'analyse concurrentielle et de la veille de marché qui alimentent les recommandations stratégiques. Vous traduirez la recherche et les données de performance en implications claires qui orientent la prise de décision dans toutes les équipes.
  • Stratégie de canaux et planification des investissements : Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en stratégie et en planification média pour définir le mix de canaux, le séquençage et la logique d'investissement qui soutiennent les objectifs de croissance. Vous alimenterez des plans média full-funnel qui font évoluer les programmes média des clients au-delà du marketing de performance et couvrent chaque étape du parcours client, de la notoriété à la fidélisation. Vous collaborerez avec les leaders média, CRM, SEO et expérience numérique pour que les choix de canaux et l'allocation budgétaire soient alignés sur le cadre stratégique global.
  • Cadres de mesure et interprétation de la performance : Vous établirez des cadres de mesure qui définissent le succès avant l'activation. Vous aiderez les équipes à interpréter les signaux de performance, pour que les insights guident les décisions plutôt que de simplement alimenter les rapports.
  • Récit stratégique de la performance : Vous dirigerez le récit stratégique des revues d'affaires trimestrielles (QBR) et des discussions de planification, en expliquant ce qui s'est passé, pourquoi, ce que nous avons appris et quelles actions doivent suivre. Votre récit reliera les données, les insights et les implications d'affaires pour en tirer des recommandations claires.
  • Partenariat stratégique avec les clients : Vous serez un partenaire stratégique pour les parties prenantes clients et mènerez avec assurance les conversations sur les occasions de croissance, les priorités de planification et les recommandations stratégiques. Vous amènerez les discussions au-delà de l'exécution tactique, vers un impact d'affaires à long terme.
  • Alignement stratégique multidisciplinaire : Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes média, création, SEO, CRM, web et analytique pour que la stratégie soit intégrée de façon constante à l'exécution. Vous harmoniserez les indicateurs clés, les messages, les stratégies de canaux et les cadres de mesure afin d'assurer une intention d'affaires claire.
  • Habilitation stratégique des équipes : Vous outillerez les équipes de comptes et de livraison avec des cadres et des conseils qui rehaussent la qualité et la cohérence de la réflexion stratégique dans toute l'agence. Votre travail aidera à simplifier la planification et à clarifier les défis complexes.
  • Normes et cadres stratégiques : Vous contribuerez à l'évolution des cadres, des guides et des outils de planification stratégique de l'agence. Vous aiderez à intégrer la stratégie aux briefs, aux cycles de planification et aux rythmes d'optimisation, pour qu'elle devienne une discipline centrale de nos opérations.
  • Leadership éclairé et soutien aux nouvelles affaires : Vous contribuerez aux points de vue de l'agence, aux guides sectoriels et aux récits de croissance qui renforcent notre différenciation sur le marché. Vous appuierez le développement des affaires par un récit stratégique et un positionnement fondé sur les insights.

Des déplacements occasionnels pourraient être requis pour des événements d’entreprise et des conférences de l’industrie.

Compétences et qualifications :

  • Solide expérience dans l'élaboration de stratégies marketing intégrées couvrant plusieurs canaux et disciplines.
  • Expérience démontrée en stratégie et planification média, avec la capacité de concevoir des plans média full-funnel à plusieurs étapes qui amènent les programmes des clients au-delà du marketing de performance, vers des stratégies de marque et de demande en haut et au milieu de l'entonnoir.
  • Capacité à traduire des objectifs d'affaires en une orientation stratégique claire qui guide les équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et capacité à tirer des insights pertinents des données de performance, de la recherche et de la veille de marché.
  • Pensée systémique et capacité à comprendre comment les messages, les canaux, l'expérience client et la mesure s'articulent.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en narration et en communication, avec la capacité de présenter des idées complexes de façon claire et convaincante.
  • Solides compétences en animation et en collaboration, avec la capacité de rallier des équipes multidisciplinaires autour de priorités stratégiques communes.
  • Prestance et assurance lors de la présentation de recommandations stratégiques à des parties prenantes clients de haut niveau.
  • Esprit de croissance, ouverture à la rétroaction et souci d'amélioration continue.
  • Solides compétences organisationnelles et capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs cycles de planification et initiatives stratégiques.
  • Aisance dans des contextes ambigus et capacité à apporter de la clarté à des défis d'affaires complexe

Formation et expérience :

  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en stratégie marketing, stratégie intégrée, stratégie de marque, stratégie et planification média ou stratégie de croissance, en agence ou chez l'annonceur.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l'élaboration et l'évolution de stratégies média couvrant l'ensemble du parcours client, sans se limiter aux canaux de performance en bas de l'entonnoir.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l'élaboration de stratégies marketing intégrées et multicanales.
  • Expérience dans la conduite de la planification annuelle, de l'élaboration de feuilles de route stratégiques et des discussions de croissance avec les clients.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes média, création, expérience numérique, CRM et analytique.
  • Baccalauréat en marketing, en administration des affaires, en communication ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Une expérience dans le secteur CPG ou B2B est un atout, mais n'est pas requise.
  • Une expérience dans le secteur de l'éducation (établissements à but lucratif ou sans but lucratif) est fortement souhaitée.

Attentes liées à l’IA

Chez Level, la maîtrise des outils d'IA est un élément central de votre rôle, pas un simple atout. Votre succès dans ce poste repose non seulement sur votre expertise, mais aussi sur votre capacité à intégrer activement l'IA dans votre façon de travailler.

Vous devrez :

  • Expérimenter continuellement avec des outils d'IA (p. ex. ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) pour améliorer la rapidité, la qualité et l'impact de votre travail (p. ex. rédiger des briefs, résumer de la recherche, analyser des tendances, générer des cadres stratégiques préliminaires, repérer des modèles dans de grands ensembles de données).
  • Documenter et partager de façon proactive ce que vous apprenez, comme vos requêtes, vos améliorations de processus et vos cas d'utilisation, pour que les autres en profitent et que nous progressions ensemble.
  • Aborder l'IA avec un esprit itératif en raffinant au fil du temps la façon dont vous l'appliquez à votre travail. La première idée est rarement la meilleure : tester, ajuster et améliorer fait partie du processus.
  • Accepter l'inconfort, surtout lorsque des outils ou des façons de faire vous semblent peu familiers. C'est en sortant de sa zone de confort et de sa routine qu'on grandit.

L'IA n'est pas un raccourci, c'est une compétence. Vous devrez l'utiliser comme multiplicateur de force pour la création, la stratégie et l'exécution, et non comme substitut à un travail réfléchi. À mesure que nos outils évoluent, votre capacité à vous adapter et à mener le changement jouera un rôle clé dans votre performance et votre croissance chez Level.

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • No Ego, All In
    Ici, on ne dit pas « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble, nous mettons la main à la pâte quand c’est nécessaire et nous nous soucions davantage du résultat que de l’organigramme.
  • Better Every Day
    Nous voulons recevoir la rétroaction — même quand elle pique. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons à élever la barre.
  • Relentless for Results
    L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Nous nous concentrons sur le travail qui fait avancer l’entreprise.
  • Driven by Truth
    Nous remettons les hypothèses en question, suivons les données et disons aux clients ce qu’ils doivent entendre — pas seulement ce qui est facile à dire.

Avantages et bénéfices

Chez Level, nous soutenons nos équipes aux États-Unis et au Canada avec des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

  • Télétravail complet aux États-Unis et au Canada, allocation mensuelle pour le travail à domicile et vendredis d’été
  • Congés généreux, incluant des congés payés illimités aux États-Unis, des vacances concurrentielles au Canada et des options de congé parental/familial
  • Avantages complets en santé, soutien en santé mentale et assurances invalidité et vie payées par l’entreprise
  • Cotisations de retraite de l’employeur, 401(k) aux États-Unis et contribution REER au Canada
  • Évaluations de performance trimestrielles et occasions d’avancement professionnel

Priorité au télétravail

Ce rôle est ouvert aux résidentes et résidents des États-Unis et du Canada et se fait entièrement à distance. Des déplacements occasionnels pourraient être requis pour des événements d’entreprise et des conférences de l’industrie. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de commanditer des visas pour le moment.

Level est fondée sur l’inclusion

Nous sommes engagés envers la diversité, l’équité, l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance. Level est fière d’être un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi — nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes. Level Agency offre des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables aux personnes candidates en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin d'une mesure d'adaptation, veuillez nous en informer lors de votre candidature ou de votre processus d'entrevue.

Prêt(e) à postuler?

Cliquez ci-dessous pour soumettre votre CV. Vous répondrez aussi à quelques questions réfléchies, alors prenez le temps de bien le faire.

Ce qui nous importe le plus, c’est votre façon de penser, de bâtir et de créer de l’impact — pas que votre parcours ait été parfaitement linéaire.

Bâtissons quelque chose ensemble.

Divulgation sur l'utilisation de l'IA dans l'embauche

Nous utilisons des outils assistés par l'IA pour appuyer certaines étapes de notre processus d'embauche, notamment la présélection des CV ainsi que la prise de notes ou la production de résumés d'entrevues. Ces outils soutiennent le jugement humain, mais ne le remplacent pas. Toutes les décisions d'embauche sont prises par l'équipe d'embauche de Level.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote - Anywhere in LATAM

Job Type: Full-Time - Independent Contractor

Compensation: USD

To be considered for this position, you must have an advanced level of English & Spanish

At GBS Group, we help entrepreneurs and executives start, run, and manage their businesses in the United States through Start-Up Services, Financial & Tax Advisory, and operational support solutions. As we continue scaling our internal capabilities, we are investing heavily in automation, AI-driven workflows, and internal platforms that improve how we operate, deliver, and scale. We are building a high-leverage internal systems layer powered by automation and AI—and this role is critical to that effort.

This role owns the design, development, deployment, security, and maintenance of internal tools, automation systems, and AI-driven workflows. AI is expected to be a core part of how this work is done, from development and testing to deployment and ongoing improvement. It combines internal product development, platform engineering, DevOps, and applied AI systems to improve operational efficiency and scale business processes. You will also be responsible for the security, reliability, and integrity of these systems, ensuring safe handling of data, access, and system interactions across all automation and AI workflows.

This is a high-ownership, builder role for someone who thinks beyond code and focuses on driving real business impact through systems.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Tools & Platforms

  • Build and evolve internal tools that support core business operations
  • Design systems that improve operational efficiency and scalability
  • Treat internal tools as products with long-term ownership

Automation & System Orchestration

  • Design and implement automation across workflows, systems, and data pipelines
  • Connect APIs, third-party tools, and internal systems into cohesive workflows
  • Continuously identify and execute high-impact automation opportunities

AI Systems & Workflows

  • Integrate AI tools, copilots, and agent-based processes into day-to-day operations
  • Design and manage AI-driven workflows that are reliable and production-ready
  • Establish guardrails for AI usage (data exposure, prompt injection risks, etc.)

Infrastructure, DevOps & Reliability

  • Own CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and environment management
  • Maintain infrastructure reliability, monitoring, and observability
  • Troubleshoot system failures, integration issues, and performance bottlenecks

Security & System Integrity

  • Implement and maintain security best practices across internal tools and AI workflows
  • Manage authentication, authorization, and access controls (RBAC, secrets, API keys)
  • Ensure secure handling of sensitive data across integrations and AI systems
  • Monitor for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and potential abuse
  • Protect systems against risks specific to AI-enabled environments

Cross-Functional Impact

  • Work closely with operations and leadership to translate business needs into systems
  • Improve how teams operate by reducing manual work and increasing leverage

What Makes Someone Successful Here

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a developer
  • Comfortable owning systems end-to-end (build → deploy → maintain → improve)
  • Strong at debugging messy, real-world system issues
  • Uses AI as a core development tool across the software lifecycle, while maintaining strong technical judgment and ownership of the final result
  • Understands tradeoffs between speed (AI-assisted builds) and reliability
  • Focused on business outcomes, not just technical elegance
  • Proactively identifies opportunities to improve systems and processes

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or similar roles
  • Proven experience building and maintaining internal tools, automation systems, or operational platforms
  • Strong backend and system design fundamentals, with the ability to design scalable, reliable systems
  • Experience with API integrations and system orchestration, connecting multiple tools and services into cohesive workflows
  • Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and infrastructure management
  • Familiarity with observability, logging, and monitoring systems to ensure reliability and performance
  • Strong experience designing and implementing workflow automation and system optimization
  • Ability to analyze processes and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency
  • Hands-on experience working with AI tools in production environments, including LLMs, agents, or automation platforms
  • Hands-on experience using AI across the software development lifecycle, including development, testing, debugging, deployment, and ongoing iteration
  • Ability to integrate AI into real business workflows with sound judgment
  • Understanding of agent-based systems and orchestration patterns
  • Solid understanding of security fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, encryption, and secrets management
  • Experience with secure API design and integration practices
  • Familiarity with common vulnerabilities (OWASP mindset) and ability to identify risks
  • Understanding of AI-specific security risks, such as data leakage, prompt injection, and over-permissioned agents
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, and integrations
  • Ability to navigate and resolve complex, real-world system issues
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, performance, and operational excellence
  • Ability to operate independently with high ownership and accountability

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing AI-powered internal platforms or automation layers
  • Experience with agent-based systems or workflow orchestration tools
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerized environments
  • Background in scaling internal systems in fast-growing companies

What We Offer You

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and impact
  • High-autonomy environment with strong ownership expectations
  • The opportunity to shape how GBS builds automation-first and AI-native systems
  • Flexible time off and company-wide holidays
  • Direct impact on business efficiency and scalability
  • A role focused on building systems that matter, not just shipping code

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a skilled and motivated Data Modeler (Snowflake) to support the integration of regional data warehouses into a centralized Snowflake-based data platform for our clients in the pharmaceutical industry.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Data Modeler (Snowflake) to support the integration of regional data warehouses into a centralized Snowflake-based data platform for our clients in the pharmaceutical industry. This mid-level role is ideal for candidates with a strong foundation in physical data modeling and implementation, particularly within Snowflake, and who can collaborate across data engineering, architecture, and governance teams. You'll play a vital role in ensuring the data platform is efficient, scalable, and compliant with best practices and governance standards.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Design and implement physical data models in Snowflake, focusing on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Translate conceptual and logical models into Snowflake-ready schemas, tables, and views.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to refine ETL/ELT processes and data integration patterns.
  • Align models and metadata with governance standards and tools, including Collibra.
  • Ensure all modeling and transformation logic is well-documented for traceability and compliance.
  • Support performance tuning and optimization of data pipelines.
  • Work in a distributed, global environment with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • 4–7 years of experience as a Data Modeler or similar role.
  • Proven expertise in Snowflake physical data modeling and SQL.
  • Understanding of data integration and ETL/ELT principles; experience with tools like dbt, Matillion, or Fivetran is a plus.
  • Experience with metadata and data governance platforms, ideally Collibra.
  • Familiarity with AWS services, particularly S3 is a plus
  • Solid grasp of data modeling best practices (e.g., star schema, normalization, data vault).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience in pharmaceutical/life sciences data and regulatory frameworks.
  • Familiarity with data quality tools such as Ataccama.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN FUSION:

At Fusion, you’ll join a diverse team of talented professionals from around the world, united by a passion for delivering impactful digital transformation in the life sciences industry. You’ll be part of a flat-structured, collaborative organization where decisions are made efficiently, and your expertise directly shapes client outcomes.

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

Joining Fusion means becoming part of a company that:

  • Builds strong, trusted partnerships with clients, delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.
  • Drives delivery excellence, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
  • Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
  • Operates with a truly global mindset, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

WHAT WE OFFER - FUSION BENEFITS

We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well-being, and global mobility.

Flexibility & Balance

  • Work from Anywhere: Enjoy up to 25 days per year of remote work from any global location.
  • Recharge Freely: Take the time you need with flexible time off—beyond standard holiday allowances.
  • Connect as a Team: Use your team’s integration budget to meet, collaborate, and bond.
  • Celebrate Your Birthday: Receive a special gift from Fusion on your birthday.

Growth & Development

  • Invest in Your Learning: Access CHF 1,500 annually for professional development.
  • Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
  • Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.
  • Shape an Inclusive Culture: Thrive in a workplace where your individuality is valued, and your voice drives meaningful change.

Recognition & Reward

  • Earn What You’re Worth: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package that reflects your impact.
  • Refer Talent: Get rewarded for recommending new hires through our referral program.
  • Stay Rewarded: Access loyalty-based benefits starting from your third year via the Unity Scheme.

Global Mobility & Local Support

  • Relocate with Ease: Receive financial assistance when moving for work.
  • Navigate Global Moves: Get help with visas, permits, and international assignments.
  • Benefit Locally: Enjoy perks tailored to your country of residence.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work in a diverse, inclusive culture where global teamwork drives success.

OUR SELECTION PROCESS:

Your time is valuable. That’s why our hiring process is clear, efficient, and focused on mutual fit:

Upload Your CV – Submit your application using the relevant button, depending on the job platform (approx. 3 minutes).

Wait for Profile Review – Our Talent Acquisition team will assess your CV and experience (approx. 2 weeks).

Join an Introductory Call – Our Talent Acquisition team will arrange a brief conversation (15–30 minutes via Teams or phone) to tell you more about Fusion, the role, and understand your expectations.

Attend a Technical Interview – Participate in a 30-minute session with one of our experts to discuss your skills and experience in more detail.

Participate in a Client Interview (if applicable) – For some roles, you may be invited to a client-facing discussion (30–60 minutes online).

Receive Final Feedback – We aim to share timely feedback and move forward quickly.

Fusion is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for all.

Swiss Delivery Excellence: Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

Alteryx is searching for a Sr. Architect, Professional Services - Agentic AI Solutions. This position is remote-friendly.


Position Overview:

The Senior Architect, Professional Services - Agentic AI Solutions is a highly technical, customer-facing

enterprise AI/ML architect responsible for designing, developing, and guiding production-ready Agentic AI solutions across the Alteryx ecosystem and broader enterprise technology landscape.


As part of a new Professional Services team focused on Agentic AI development and deployment, this role partners directly with enterprise customers to move from discovery and solution architecture through prototyping, development, deployment, and operationalization. The team will place particular emphasis on Office of Finance use cases and regulated business environments.


Senior Architects work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and customer

stakeholders to translate business needs into secure, scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable

outcomes while meeting enterprise requirements for governance, control, reliability, and adoption.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and guide deployment of Agentic AI solutions for enterprise customers, with particular emphasis on Office of Finance use cases and workflows.

  • Design and deploy Agentic AI solutions that leverage and integrate with Alteryx Designer, Server, and the Alteryx One enterprise analytics platform, alongside modern cloud data platforms, AI/ML services, and enterprise systems of record.
  • Establish production-ready patterns for human-in-the-loop controls, access management, evaluation, observability, auditability, reliability, and responsible AI governance.
  • Partner with customer technical and business stakeholders to define success criteria, validate solution feasibility, and guide solutions from proof of concept into production.
  • Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering to shape strategic AI opportunities, validate architecture and delivery feasibility, and connect technical solutions to customer business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to expand adoption and value by proactively recommending additional AI, automation, and data use cases.
  • Create customer-facing architecture documentation, implementation guidance, reusable solution patterns, and technical enablement materials.
  • Share technical knowledge internally and contribute to emerging Agentic AI standards, delivery practices, and accelerators across Professional Services.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, AI/ML Architect, Consultant, Technical Account Manager, Presales Engineer, or similar role.
  • 3+ years of experience in AI/ML enterprise architecture with a focus on Agentic AI development and deployment.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, data, analytics, or automation solutions.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of Alteryx Designer, Server, and the Alteryx One enterprise analytics platform is strongly preferred. Experience architecting and deploying solutions across comparable enterprise analytics platforms will also be considered.

Technical Expertise:

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise AI/ML architectures and Agentic AI development, including AI agents, agent orchestration, tool use, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and API-based integrations.

Rather than relying exclusively on traditional paid advertising, the company has developed a highly effective approach centered around authentic engagement, local online communities, compelling content, and organic social media strategies.

About the Role

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional who may not have many years of experience yet but has the drive, curiosity, creativity, and work ethic to learn quickly and take on increasing responsibility.

jobs.description:
Remote-based in the US

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

GoodPower seeks a Director, Development Operations & Systems to streamline and implement the infrastructure behind a rapidly growing, multi-entity fundraising operation. Reporting to the Senior Director of Development, this role owns the systems, data, and processes that allow the development team and executive leadership to raise, track, and steward revenue at scale—with our Salesforce CRM as the backbone.

This newly created position is a builder’s role, not a maintenance one. The Director will inherit a CRM that requires substantial cleanup and reconstruction, a moves management practice that needs better functionality, consistency, and automation, and a growing portfolio of vended services contracts that requires accurate and timely invoicing and compliance tracking. Their charge is to turn all three into systems that the team will use consistently—supported by documentation, training, and standards that outlast any one staffing configuration. Success in the first year looks like a clean, trusted Salesforce instance; a live, adopted moves management workflow; and robust dashboards for fundraising leadership to operate with confidence from real-time data.

The Director manages the Senior Development Manager, whose own responsibilities are expanding in parallel toward revenue reconciliation and financial operations leadership, alongside Salesforce and broader system architecture support and execution. Both roles are complementary, with the Director leading building and implementation of the systems, and the Senior Manager deepening the data discipline that runs through them.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce CRM Architecture and Data Integrity

In partnership with the Senior Director of Development, execution support of the Senior Development Manager and contracted Data Entry support, and in coordination with the organization’s Digital & Data team.

  • Lead a comprehensive assessment, cleanup, and rebuild (where needed) of GoodPower’s Salesforce instance including: data hygiene, deduplication, object, field and layout architecture, record types, permissions, and reporting structures across affiliated entities.
  • Establish Salesforce as the single source of truth for donor records, pipeline management, and revenue forecasting—aiming for the adoption and implementation by fundraising leadership.
  • Design and maintain Salesforce dashboards and reports that give development leadership, the CEO’s Office, and the Finance team real-time visibility into pipeline health, projections, and revenue-to-goal.
  • Own Salesforce configuration and its integrations with fundraising, email, and funder research tools; manage implementation partners and consultants as needed.
  • Set and enforce data entry standards, naming conventions, and coding practices that keep records accurate, consistent, and reportable across entities.
  • Serve as the development team’s primary liaison to IT, data, and technology colleagues on shared systems and integrations.

Moves Management

In service to the team’s frontline fundraisers, with execution support of the entire team.

  • Build and operationalize a moves management system in Salesforce and/or Jira—task-based cultivation tracking, stage definitions, next-action accountability, dashboard performance tracking, and recurring portfolio reviews. This role owns making the system/workflow live, adopted by the team, and sustained.
  • Partner with the CEO’s Office (Executive Assistant and Managing Director) to execute CEO fundraising coordination: moves management, pipeline expansion, follow-through tracking, and data capture on the organization’s highest-value relationships.
  • Work with development leadership on portfolio segmentation, prospect research workflows, and pipeline review cadence.

System and Tech Tool Adoption

In close collaboration with the Senior Development Manager.

  • Lead the development team’s adoption of Jira and Confluence—implement the Salesforce Jira connector in collaboration with the Data team, build the project tracking and documentation architecture, and drive the change management required for sustained uptake.
  • Serve as an internal change agent for systems adoption, meeting the team’s fundraisers where they are and designing workflows that will be sustainable.
  • Ensure alignment with the Senior Development Manager’s development system training and SOP documentation scope of work.

Contracts, Invoicing, and Compliance Systems

With strategic leadership from the Senior Director of Development and close collaboration with the Senior Development Manager.

  • Build and maintain a system for tracking business development invoicing, contracting, and compliance across GoodPower’s growing portfolio of vended services agreements.
  • Work closely with the Senior Development Director and Senior Development Manager who act as lead contacts for Finance, compliance, and program teams on executing contract lifecycle tracking, invoicing detail, and deliverable compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Minimum 7-10 years of progressively responsible development operations experience, including deep, hands-on Salesforce experience in a fundraising context (Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP), or a comparable fundraising implementation).

  • Demonstrated experience leading a CRM cleanup, migration, or rebuild—taking an underused or compromised instance to a functioning, trusted system of record.

  • Track record of designing moves management or pipeline systems that fundraisers adopt, including stage design, task workflows, and the change management that makes the system sustainable.

  • Strong data architecture and reporting skills: report and dashboard building, data hygiene protocols, revenue forecasting, and translating leadership questions into usable views.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing experienced professionals with a coaching orientation.

  • High level of comfort operating in a fast-growing organization where systems are built rather than inherited, with a bias toward pragmatic solutions.

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and comparable project management and documentation platforms, as well as experience leading team-wide tool adoption.

  • Working knowledge of nonprofit finance operations—gift processing, revenue reconciliation, contracts, invoicing, and compliance tracking.

  • Experience supporting fundraising across affiliated 501c(3) and 501c(4) entities, or demonstrated ability to learn entity-specific data, coding, and compliance requirements quickly.

  • Experience managing consultants, implementation partners, and relationships with vendors.

  • Experience with managing vended service revenue from contracting to invoicing.

  • Salesforce Administrator certification.

GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Annual salary range: $130,000 - $150,000 commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
  • 2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority

About the Role:

A highly detail-oriented and trustworthy Customs Compliance & Documentation Specialist is needed to support the company's Power of Attorney (POA) validation and client onboarding process.

The role will focus primarily on compliance verification, document review, company validation, and identifying potential red flags before new importers are approved. The specialist will review information provided by clients, verify business registrations and officer details, research company addresses, organize documentation, and escalate questionable or incomplete cases to the appropriate team member.

Because the role involves handling confidential client information, including identification documents, EINs, company information, and other sensitive records, security, discretion, accuracy, and attention to detail are critical.

The ideal candidate has customs brokerage, U.S. customs, logistics, or a related background, along with strong common sense, research skills, written communication, and the ability to recognize inconsistencies or potential compliance concerns. Extensive industry experience is preferred, but the client will provide training on their specific validation process and red flags.

Key Responsibilities:

Customs Compliance & POA Validation

  • Review POA documents and supporting information for completeness and accuracy.
  • Verify company registration, business status, officer information, and addresses using appropriate online sources.
  • Research and identify potential red flags, inconsistencies, or indicators of shell companies.
  • Follow established compliance rules and escalate questionable cases for further review.
  • Conduct additional research when information requires clarification or verification.

Documentation & Records

  • Organize and save new client documents in the designated folders according to established procedures.

Client Communication

Confidentiality & Security

  • Handle sensitive client information, including identification documents, EINs, and company records, with strict confidentiality.
  • Follow access controls and security procedures when handling client information.
  • Use only the systems and folders necessary for assigned responsibilities.

Qualifications & Ideal Traits:

Must-Have

  • Previous experience in customs brokerage, logistics, import/export, compliance, documentation, or a related field.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies or red flags.
  • Excellent written English and professional email communication skills.
  • Strong research, organizational, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to follow detailed procedures while exercising sound judgment.

Preferred

Copywriter & Social Media Manager

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
