About the Role

We are looking for a Copywriter & Social Media Manager to create compelling content, manage social channels, and help strengthen Spacestation Labs' online presence.

This role combines copywriting, social media management, Reddit community engagement, campaign coordination, and performance reporting. You’ll own content and social initiatives end-to-end while maintaining a consistent brand voice across every written touchpoint.

What You’ll Own

Content Creation

  • Write clear, compelling copy for social media posts, blog content, ad copy, and product messaging.
  • Adapt content to Spacestation Labs' voice, audience, and the requirements of each platform.
  • Adjust tone from technical and informative to conversational and witty depending on context.

Social Media Management

  • Own the day-to-day management of Spacestation Labs' social channels.
  • Schedule and publish content across platforms.
  • Monitor performance, respond to community engagement, and flag anything that requires attention.

Reddit Community

  • Build and maintain an authentic presence on Reddit.
  • Identify relevant subreddits and participate meaningfully in discussions.
  • Contribute useful content without making Spacestation Labs feel overly promotional.

Campaign Coordination

  • Manage marketing campaigns from execution through completion.
  • Coordinate timelines, assets, and deliverables across stakeholders.
  • Keep projects organized and on track while communicating proactively when priorities shift.

Brand Voice & Messaging

  • Apply and evolve Spacestation Labs' tone of voice across written content.
  • Maintain consistent messaging across product pages, social posts, Reddit discussions, and other written touchpoints.

Performance Reporting

  • Track engagement metrics and content performance across channels.
  • Review performance data and identify what is resonating with the audience.
  • Translate insights into clear takeaways that inform future content decisions.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in copywriting and social media management.
  • Portfolio demonstrating range across different content formats and platforms.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines independently.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Reddit and an understanding of how online communities operate.
  • Understanding of what drives meaningful engagement and authentic participation on Reddit.
  • Experience with social media scheduling and analytics tools such as Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or comparable platforms.
  • Excellent written English.
  • Strong ability to adapt tone across technical, informative, conversational, and witty content.
  • Strong attention to detail in both copy quality and project coordination.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy participating in online communities and bring that curiosity into your writing.
  • You take ownership of your workload from start to finish.
  • You proactively identify gaps and communicate when priorities or timelines change.
  • You are comfortable working with ambiguity and making sound editorial decisions without needing every detail defined in advance.
  • You are receptive to feedback and view revision as a natural part of the creative process.
  • You can balance creative thinking with strong organization and execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Content is clear, engaging, and consistent with Spacestation Labs' voice.
  • Social channels are actively managed, organized, and responsive.
  • Reddit engagement feels authentic and contributes meaningfully to the brand's visibility.
  • Campaign deliverables are coordinated effectively and completed on time.
  • Performance data is regularly reviewed and translated into actionable content insights.
  • Content decisions become increasingly informed by audience engagement and performance.
  • Projects are owned proactively with clear communication and minimal supervision.

Typical Day

Your morning might start with a scan of Spacestation Labs' social channels, responding to comments and flagging anything worth escalating.

From there, you may draft a batch of posts for the week, refine copy for an upcoming campaign, or participate in a Reddit discussion where Spacestation Labs can contribute something useful.

Mid-day often involves coordinating with teammates in the Marketing department to align on campaign timelines or review assets before they go live.

You’ll wrap up by checking performance dashboards, identifying what is resonating and what needs adjustment, and updating the content calendar so the next day starts with clarity.

The role is remote and async-friendly, with touchpoints built around the team's rhythm.

Managing modern technology has become increasingly complex. As organizations scale across clouds, endpoints, and hybrid environments, IT operations and cybersecurity often remain fragmented, creating gaps in visibility, slowing response times, and increasing risk.

Logically closes that gap.

For more than 20 years, Logically has partnered with mid-market and enterprise organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and improve resilience, acting as a true extension of their teams with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.

Logically. Cyber-First. Future-Ready.

Why Work for Us

  • A culture built on doing the right thing
  • Work at the forefront of cybersecurity and emerging technologies
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement

Job Summary:

The Project Manager II (PMII) is responsible for the successful delivery of customer-facing technical projects from initiation through closure. The PMII owns project scope, schedule, financials, resources, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication while ensuring a high-quality customer experience. The PMII also serves as a mentor to less-experienced Project Managers and contributes to the continued improvement of PMO standards and practices.

About our PMO:

At Logically, Project Management is a profession, not simply a job title. Our Project Managers own the full project lifecycle, including scope, schedules, financials, risks, resources, deliverables, and the customer experience. We’re looking for someone who wants Project Management to be their career, not simply their current job. Someone who takes pride in the craft, continually develops their skills, shares what they know, and helps make the team around them better.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Project Ownership & Customer Experience: Take ownership of assigned projects from Sales handoff through successful completion and closure, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring a best-in-class customer delivery experience.
  • Scope Management: Validate project scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, and customer expectations during the transition from Sales to Delivery. Manage scope throughout the project lifecycle and identify, document, and communicate changes or potential scope conflicts.
  • Schedule Management: Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), including milestones, dependencies, critical path, resource assignments, and forecast completion dates. Proactively identify and address issues that may impact the project schedule.
  • Resource Management: Coordinate internal and external resources required for successful project delivery, proactively addressing resource constraints, conflicts, or dependencies and escalating when necessary.
  • Risk & Project Health Management: Continuously evaluate project health and proactively identify, document, mitigate, and escalate risks before they materially impact the customer, schedule, scope, budget, or successful delivery. Develop and drive recovery plans for at-risk, stalled, or challenged projects.
  • Financial Management: Manage project financial performance, including budgets, expenditures, time entries, procurement activity, and invoicing alignment, ensuring projects remain financially aligned with approved scope and expectations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear, timely, and proactive communication with customers and internal stakeholders regarding project status, accomplishments, upcoming activities, risks, decisions, and changes. Lead difficult conversations and de-escalate issues when necessary.
  • Project Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate and timely project information within Logically’s project management systems, including schedules, forecasts, risks, milestones, financial information, decisions, and communications to support effective project management and leadership reporting.
  • Project Governance & Escalation: Apply established PMO standards, procedures, and escalation processes while using sound judgment to identify when additional leadership involvement is required to protect the customer experience and successful project delivery.
  • Mentorship & Team Development: Provide mentorship and guidance to Project Coordinators and Project Manager I’s, helping develop their project management capabilities and promoting consistent application of PMO standards and best practices.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify and contribute to opportunities to improve PMO processes, tools, reporting, customer communication, and project delivery practices.

Qualifications:

  • Associate’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience required.
  • 5+ years of progressive project management experience, including experience independently managing multiple concurrent customer-facing projects. Experience within technology, cybersecurity, managed services, or professional services is preferred.

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Software Engineer

As a Software Engineer at Upsun, you will build and maintain the backend services behind our customers' billing. Billing is your main focus: invoices, taxes, usage reporting, and the integrations that connect our platform to the commercial systems behind it. These systems handle tens of millions in revenue each year across multiple products, entities, and currencies. Accuracy matters, and your work reaches customers directly.

You will own components in this space and act as a key link between engineering, Finance, and Product. Every new offering Upsun launches needs a billing component, and you will help build it. Over time, you will become a long-term owner of the systems you build. You may also contribute to adjacent services such as project provisioning and account management.

What to expect

  • Build billing integrations: Develop and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go that connect our platform to external billing systems.

  • Ship usage-based billing features: Build features such as usage tracking, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing. Work with other engineering teams to understand how new features are measured and charged.

  • Complete billing migrations: Help finish moving billing to external systems while keeping data accurate and customers unaffected.

  • Troubleshoot and fix issues: Investigate and resolve billing issues raised by Support and Finance, from incorrect usage data to failed integrations.

  • Protect customers and data: Contribute to anti-abuse measures and keep security in mind when working with sensitive customer and payment data.

  • Work across teams: Partner with Finance, Product, and Support, and communicate clearly and asynchronously with a team spread across Europe, North America, and India.

  • Build with good practice: Write tested, well-documented code, take part in pair programming and code review, and use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully in your workflow.

What you bring

  • Go development experience: 3+ years of professional backend development in Go.

  • Relational databases: Hands-on experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB.

  • Third-party API integration: Experience integrating with external REST APIs, including handling errors, retries, and rate limits.

  • Care for accuracy: Attention to detail in systems where a mistake can reach a customer's invoice, and an interest in concepts like idempotency and consistency in distributed systems.

  • Testing and reliability: A habit of writing unit and integration tests, including for failure paths, and thinking about how your code behaves in production.

  • Security awareness: An understanding of common security vulnerabilities and how to avoid them in backend services.

  • Interest in billing: You enjoy working on billing and financial systems and want to make them your focus.

  • Clear async communication: You write clearly and collaborate well across teams and time zones.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

You can expect 3 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners.   2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager

All roles require background checks.

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🛜 Internet reimbursement

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. Job Summary:
Melink Solar is a leading commercial solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) organization specializing in designing and building solar PV and battery energy storage systems (BESS). We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Director of Sales & Marketing to lead the company's commercial growth strategy as an executive member of the leadership team.
Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director of Sales & Marketing owns strategy, revenue growth, brand building, team leadership, aligning sales and marketing to accelerate Melink Solar’s vision to transform the world with an improved global economy, security, and environment for ourselves and future generations The ideal candidate is a proven business builder who can turn strategy into execution, develop high-performing teams, build trusted industry relationships, and drive profitable growth aligned with Melink Solar’s mission.

Duties/Responsibilities:
Executive Leadership & Strategy
  • Serve as the executive leader responsible for the integrated sales, marketing, and partnership functions; building the long-term commercial roadmap to drive top-line growth, market share expansion, new market development, and alignment with Melink Solar's financial and mission goals.
  • Work closely with the CEO, CFO, and executive team to set vision, strategy, and growth objectives.
  • Partner closely with operations, estimating, engineering, procurement, and project management to align growth plans with company capacity and margin expectations; establishing clear handoff standards so scope, schedule, pricing, risks, and customer commitments are fully understood before projects move into delivery.

Sales & Market Growth
  • Serve as architect and oversee the entire sales process, from lead generation through deal closure, ensuring consistent revenue delivery and customer satisfaction.
  • Conduct strategic market analysis to identify the highest-opportunity geographic areas to enter and the vertical markets Melink Solar should prioritize, then build data-driven expansion plans that position the company as the partner of choice for commercial and utility-scale solar solutions.
  • Serve as the company’s expert in national account sales, developing and executing strategies to win multi-site, national account customers rather than one-off projects, and building long-term programmatic relationships that drive repeatable revenue.
  • Drive data-driven sales management through CRM adoption, pipeline accuracy, sales stage discipline, and a regular forecasting cadence; with KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that provide full transparency to the executive team.
  • Oversee proposal and RFP strategy for priority opportunities, coordinating with estimating, engineering, finance, procurement, and operations to create compelling, accurate, and commercially sound responses.
  • Develop and manage partnerships with Independent Power Producers (IPPs), advocates, financiers, utilities, developers, and community organizations to advance Melink Solar’s market position.
  • Develop new revenue channels and collaborative opportunities that strengthen Melink Solar’s position in the renewable energy value chain.
  • Build influence by representing Melink Solar at executive roundtables, trade associations, and policy discussions.

Team Leadership
  • Lead with high standards; coaching and mentoring team members regularly, conducting structured performance reviews with clear expectations and actionable development plans, and holding direct, candid conversations when needed to address gaps and maintain accountability.
  • Recruit, build, and scale high-performing sales and marketing teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and shared success where every team member is empowered to reach their full potential.

Marketing & Brand
  • Define the annual and long-term marketing strategy aligned with revenue goals and brand positioning, then empower the marketing team to execute against it.
  • Set the strategy and hold the marketing team accountable to SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) performance goals, making Melink Solar the #1 ranked and easiest-to-find company on Google within its target markets.
  • Establish marketing KPIs and a regular reporting cadence, holding the team accountable to lead volume, campaign conversion rates, and brand visibility metrics; continuously evaluating ROI and reallocating resources toward the highest-impact channels.
  • Own the sales and marketing budget, including lead generation investments, digital marketing spend, events, trade shows, sponsorships, CRM tools, and other resources needed to support profitable growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field (Master’s Degree or MBA preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive sales and marketing leadership with executive-level responsibility for revenue growth, including a proven track record of building and leading teams that consistently exceed growth targets.
  • Deep understanding of renewable energy markets, EPC services, or infrastructure industries, with strong experience developing strategic partnerships with IPPs, developers, financiers, and utilities.
  • Solid understanding of C&I solar EPC fundamentals including utility bill analysis, solar proposal creation, roof mount, ground mount, and parking canopy project types, and working knowledge of interconnection and permitting processes.
  • Working knowledge of battery energy storage systems (BESS) and hybrid solar+storage solutions, including how they are sold, scoped, and positioned in the C&I market.
  • Ability to balance high-level strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and influencing skills with C-suite, board-level, and industry audiences.
  • Proven people leader with a track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated success selling to and managing national accounts; including multi-site and enterprise-level customers, with experience owning CRM discipline, sales forecasting, proposal/RFP strategy, and sales process accountability in a project-based or technical services environment.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing performance, including website traffic analytics, SEO, and GEO optimization, with the ability to hold a marketing team accountable to measurable search-ranking goals.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across sales, marketing, estimating, engineering, finance, operations, and project management to balance customer needs, capacity, risk, and profitability; including experience managing budgets and allocating resources toward the highest-impact growth initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Familiarity with financial modeling for renewable energy projects.
  • Experience in utility-scale PV and distributed generation markets.
  • Hands-on experience in scaling businesses and launching new programs, service lines, or market initiatives.
  • Familiarity with renewable energy policy, incentives (IRA, OBBBA, ITC, Domestic Content, FEOC), and financing structures.

Physical Requirements:

Qualified candidates are encouraged to submit a resume and a brief cover letter describing their sales and marketing leadership experience and their interest in Melink Solar’s mission.

What You’ll Do

About You

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 and $130,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

This job family is focused on a series of clinical and administrative processes that healthcare providers utilize to capture, bill, and collect patient service revenue in a manner that is compliant with payer rules and requirements. The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient intake and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero. This team also encompasses a payer administration function that ensures we are successfully operationalizing payer rules and requirements as well as facilitating payer relations and escalation efforts.

Job Summary

The Manager, Revenue Cycle – Cash Applications & Payment Integrity will lead cash application, deposit reconciliation, credit balance, and refund operations across the NewCo DME and Pharmacy businesses.

This role is responsible for ensuring payments and remittances are accurately received, routed, reconciled, posted, and resolved across a complex environment of multiple businesses, systems, banking relationships, clearinghouses, and payer payment methodologies. This leader will play a critical role in designing scalable processes and controls for an increasingly complex multi-system payment environment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Cash Applications across DME and Pharmacy businesses, ensuring timely and accurate posting and reconciliation.
  • Own end-to-end deposit reconciliation across bank deposits, EFTs, lockboxes, clearinghouses, remittance files, and Revenue Cycle platforms.
  • Establish controls to ensure cash is accounted for from deposit/EFT through 835 receipt and final system posting.
  • Identify and resolve missing, duplicate, misrouted, unapplied, or unreconciled payments.
  • Standardize reconciliation processes, controls, SLAs, and reporting across businesses.
  • Serve as the RCM operational SME for 835 ERA/EFT workflows, including receipt, routing, posting, and reconciliation.
  • Understand and oversee EDI/remittance splitter functionality used to route 835 transactions across multiple businesses and systems.
  • Partner with IT, clearinghouses, vendors, Treasury, and Finance to resolve missing or unmatched payments and remittances.
  • Establish monitoring for failed files, splitter exceptions, unmatched EFTs, missing 835s, and reconciliation breaks.
  • Understand complex transactions including PLBs, recoupments, reversals, offsets, takebacks, and $0 remits.
  • Lead Cash Applications requirements and workflow design through Revenue Cycle system implementations, integrations, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
  • Design scalable future-state processes for remittance routing, posting, reconciliation, and exception management.
  • Drive increased ERA/EFT adoption, auto-posting, automated reconciliation, and straight-through processing.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify and automate manual processes.
  • Oversee credit balance identification, validation, and resolution.
  • Ensure appropriate handling of payer and patient refunds, recoupments, overpayments, and unapplied cash.
  • Establish controls to prevent duplicate refunds, posting errors, and inappropriate adjustments.
  • Partner with Finance and Compliance on financial controls and audit requirements.
  • Lead and develop Cash Applications teams across multiple businesses.
  • Establish productivity, quality, reconciliation, and performance standards.
  • Develop KPIs around posting timeliness, reconciliation, unapplied cash, exceptions, credits, and refunds.
  • Proactively identify operational risks and drive issues through resolution.
  • Partner effectively across Revenue Cycle, Finance, Treasury, IT, Pharmacy, and other functions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle, with a specific focus on leading the entire Cash Applications function preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred.
  • Comprehensive understanding of the payment lifecycle, including EFT/deposit and 835 receipt, EDI routing/splitting, reconciliation, posting, credits, refunds, and final financial control.
  • Deep Revenue Cycle expertise, an automation-first mindset, and the ability to independently identify issues and drive solutions with minimal oversight.
  • Strong expertise in 835 ERA/EFT transactions, EDI remittance workflows, payment/remittance splitting, and deposit-to-post reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated aptitude in EDI/remittance splitting and complex deposit reconciliation.
  • Proficiency in managing credit balances and refund processes within a healthcare environment.
  • Experience with system conversions relevant to revenue cycle operations.
  • A track record of implementing or leveraging automation to enhance revenue cycle efficiency.

jobs.description:
GTI is a contract manufacturing partner supporting customers in renewable energy, power generation, infrastructure, and industrial systems.
We fabricate custom designed, purpose-built enclosures and skids for our customers and perform mechanical and electrical integration in-house, delivering a true turn-key product to our customers. Our scope spans Engineering, prototype builds, through full production, requiring teams that can move fast, adapt, and execute with precision.
GTI Values: Safety I Quality I Customer Obsession I Speed I Agility

Position Overview

    The Global Customs Compliance Manager is responsible for GTI's customs compliance, tariff strategy, and trade documentation across approximately 200 active import transactions annually, serving a diverse product portfolio including fabricated enclosures, structural components, electrical/mechanical assemblies, and raw materials such as wood, metals, electronics, etc. The Customs Compliance Manager works closely with Finance, Logistics Coordinators, Procurement, Engineering, and external brokers to ensure timely, compliant, and cost-effective customs clearance while mitigating regulatory risk.

Key Responsibilities

    Customs Entries and Broker Coordination

    • Coordinate customs clearance requirements with customs brokers, freight forwarders, suppliers, and internal teams across 200+ annual import transactions
    • Review customs entries (CBP Form 7501) and entry summaries for accurate classification, country of origin, declared value, duties, and applicable tariff provisions
    • Resolve entry discrepancies with brokers and track corrections through completion; escalate clearance risks that could delay shipments or create cost overruns
    • Maintain comprehensive entry register linking customs entries to GTI load numbers, purchase orders, projects, and supporting documentation for audit trail and compliance
    • Manage relationships with brokers and freight forwarders; evaluate broker performance and address recurring errors or compliance gaps

      Tariff Classification & Trade Strategy

      • Maintain centralized, current product classification database with HTSUS codes, product descriptions, countries of origin, classification rationale, and applicable duty rates
      • Work with Engineering, Procurement, suppliers, and brokers to obtain technical specifications and documentation needed for accurate tariff classification
      • Monitor tariff changes, CBP guidance, preferential trade program requirements, and Section 232/301 duties affecting GTI products and suppliers
      • Maintain tariff watch list; communicate effective dates, affected products, estimated cost impacts, and required company actions to Finance and Operations
      • Support duty estimates for new purchases, projects, and supplier negotiations; clearly identify assumptions and unresolved questions
      • Review eligibility and documentation requirements for preferential treatment, including USMCA qualification and supporting supplier documentation

        PMS, Duties & Refund Management

        • Manage review and reconciliation of Periodic Monthly Statements (PMS) from brokers; match charges to entry records and investigate discrepancies
        • Coordinate timely payment of customs duties with Finance and brokers; maintain visibility into outstanding obligations and estimated cash flow
        • Track entry liquidation, correction, and protest deadlines; identify and pursue refund opportunities with brokers or qualified trade counsel
        • Maintain documentation of submissions and monitor claims through final resolution and receipt of refund funds
        • Provide Finance with regular reporting on duty spend, trends, and cost-saving opportunities

          ACE, Compliance & Record Management

          • Manage authorized company access to the Automated Commercial Environment (ACE), including account maintenance, data integrity, and CBP issue resolution
          • Maintain current importer records, CBP Forms 5106, broker powers of attorney, customs bonds, and all required trade documentation
          • Monitor customs bond sufficiency; coordinate renewals and increases with bond broker, Finance, and Logistics leadership
          • Track CBP notices, audit requests, and response deadlines; ensure timely, complete responses
          • Maintain organized customs records in accordance with retention requirements and audit standards; prepare for CBP audits and examinations

            • Process Ownership and Internal Support

            • Develop and document customs compliance procedures, checklists, internal controls, and audit protocols to ensure consistent, accurate entry practices
            • Conduct routine entry audits and address recurring broker, supplier, or internal documentation errors
            • Train Logistics Coordinators, Procurement, and project teams on documentation, country of origin marking, and information required for compliant imports
            • Provide regular compliance reporting to leadership on duty spend, entry discrepancies, pending refunds, upcoming deadlines, and regulatory risks
            • Identify opportunities to optimize tariff classification, reduce duty costs, or streamline customs processes
            • Escalate complex legal interpretations, trade program questions, or tariff disputes to qualified customs brokers or trade counsel

Requirements

    Required Qualifications

    • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on customs compliance, customs brokerage, or importer compliance experience
    • Demonstrated experience supporting multiple clients, suppliers, or companies (not limited to single-company background); comfort with diverse product types and geographies
    • Strong practical experience with ACE, PMS reconciliation, entry summaries (CBP Form 7501), HTSUS tariff classification, customs valuation, and country of origin requirements
    • Proven experience researching tariff changes, exclusions, and trade program rules; translating tariff changes into operational impact and cost estimates
    • Experience with USMCA or preferential trade program documentation and qualification
    • Strong Excel, data reconciliation, recordkeeping, analytical, and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple deadlines independently
    • Excellent communication skills; ability to coordinate across Operations, Finance, Procurement, and external partners
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and prioritize competing demands

      Preferred Qualifications

      • Licensed Customs Broker or Certified Customs Specialist credential
      • Experience in manufacturing, industrial equipment, structural steel/aluminum products, and assembly/fabrication operations
      • Experience managing imports from Mexico and other major sourcing regions; knowledge of USMCA sourcing and documentation
      • Experience with Chapter 99 provisions, Section 232/301 duty applications, post-entry corrections, and tariff protests
      • Experience managing multiple brokers and evaluating broker performance
      • Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, NetSuite, etc.) and customs management platforms

Benefits & Perks

    GTI offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support employees and their families while providing long-term career growth opportunities within a fast-growing manufacturing organization. Benefits may include:

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match (where applicable)

    • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays

    • Sick time in accordance with state and local requirements

    • Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage

    • Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing organization

    • Exposure to advanced manufacturing, modular infrastructure, and large-scale industrial projects

    • Collaborative, fast-paced environment with strong operational and engineering leadership

    • Employee-focused culture centered on safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

    Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on position, location, and employment classification.

The Customer Success Executive is accountable for the strategic leadership and execution of post-sales activities within our most valuable accounts. This position plays a crucial role in driving ServiceNow’s long-term value by accelerating customers’ journey to success, ensuring predictable renewals, and maximizing the impact of ServiceNow across their business transformation initiatives.

As a trusted advisor, you’ll partner with C-level executives, guide seamless delivery of business transformation, and foster collaboration with ServiceNow’s teams and strategic partners.

What You Get to Do in This Role:

  • Drive Post-Sales Success: Own and lead the customer’s post-sales transformation, aligning ServiceNow’s offerings to customer goals, and bringing relevant industry thought-leadership to the table. Foster strong relationships with C-Level executives to deliver on business outcomes.
  • Collaborate Strategically: Partner with Account Executives to create and execute integrated pre- and post-sales strategies, delivering long-term value for both the customer and ServiceNow. Leverage the right resources at the right time to ensure success.
  • Mitigate Risks and Drive Value: Proactively identify potential risks to success and work with the customer and internal teams to develop strategies to overcome them, ensuring a smooth path toward value realization.
  • Focus on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Guide and inspire the Customer Success team to meet critical operational KPIs—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Work closely with customers to align their roadmap and drive new revenue opportunities.

  • Set Success Metrics and Milestones: Establish clear, measurable success metrics with the customer, and regularly review progress. Refine business transformation plans as needed to ensure milestones are met and value is realized.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.

  • Business Acumen: Strong experience in identifying and solving complex business problems and aligning solutions with customer business objectives.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: A history of working across multiple functions and driving alignment in large, matrixed environments.
  • C-Level Relationships: Strong experience building relationships with C-level business leaders, including within some of the world’s largest enterprises.

  • Execution Focus: Ability to create repeatable processes for scalable execution while maintaining a hands-on approach to ensure critical tasks are completed efficiently.

  • Customer Focus: Deep understanding of customer needs, challenges, and motivations, with a keen ability to address concerns and ensure satisfaction.

jobs.description:
Construction Management Project Manager – Disaster Recovery

Disaster Management Division

Colorado, U.S.


Join the ICF team and make a difference! Our growing Disaster Management Division makes BIG things happen every day. ICF is seeking a Construction Project Manager to assist the Colorado Department of Local Affairs (DOLA) with managing federal grants to carry out strategic and high-impact activities to rebuild its housing stock, mitigate disaster risks, and reduce future losses in its communities.


The right candidate will have experience with the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development’s (HUD) Community Development Block Grant Mitigation (CDBG-MIT) and Community Development Block Grant – Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) programs, as well as expertise with other federal disaster recovery programs and applicable cross-cutting requirements. You will work onsite with other senior staff, subject matter experts, and junior staff to develop and deliver construction processes and procedures, work with clients to develop policies, and manage all construction-related activities in support of DOLA’s disaster recovery and mitigation efforts.


This position requires thinking on one’s feet and adjusting to an ever-changing environment. Some travel may be required to provide programmatic and contractual support, community events, and various other client requests.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Work as part of a team providing expert services to support disaster recovery and mitigation efforts with a focus on construction, inspections, cost estimating, and environmental requirements (lead-based paint, asbestos, mold, section 106).
  • Provide leadership for construction oversight and quality control on housing rehabilitation, reconstruction, and new construction projects funded by CDBG-DR and CDBG-MIT programs.
  • Coordinate with state and local officials, environmental teams, and program managers to ensure compliance with HUD requirements and the building, energy, and wildland-urban interface codes adopted by each Colorado jurisdiction.
  • Develop SOPs for construction standards, environmental hazard mitigation, green/resilient building strategies, and field QA/QC procedures.
  • Support procurement teams in contractor scoring and selection processes, and ensure contractor performance aligns with key performance indicators.
  • Manage training staff to facilitate training sessions and technical assistance workshops for local partners, builders, and internal teams.
  • Oversee the resolution of construction-related issues, homeowner concerns, and ensure proper documentation is maintained for all construction phases.
  • Assist with the development or refining of program procedures and processes for implementation.
  • Manage staff reviews of environmental requirements and ensure these items are properly incorporated into scopes of work to ensure environmental compliance.
  • Ability to interpret and apply HUD requirements, local building codes, green building standards, and program policy as it relates to disaster recovery and mitigation construction activities.
  • Manage client contracts and work order requirements to ensure profitability.
  • Monitor and allocate resources as necessary.
  • Coordinate with each authority having jurisdiction (AHJ) to confirm adopted code editions, permitting sequences, and inspection requirements, recognizing that Colorado is a home rule state in which building code adoption and contractor licensing occur at the local level.
  • Ensure scopes, specifications, and field work comply with the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code (8 CCR 1507-39) where properties fall within mapped wildland-urban interface areas, including fire intensity classification, structure hardening, ignition-resistant assemblies, and defensible space provisions.
  • Verify that rehabilitation, reconstruction, and new construction scopes meet the applicable Colorado energy code requirements, including the adopted IECC edition, the Colorado Model Electric Ready and Solar Ready Code, and the Model Low Energy and Carbon Code (MLECC).
  • Confirm elevation and flood-resistant design compliance with the CWCB Rules and Regulations for Regulatory Floodplains (2 CCR 408-1) and HUD floodplain management requirements at 24 CFR Part 55, including freeboard minimums and No-Rise Certification where work is proposed in a regulatory floodway.
  • Support Duplication of Benefits determinations under Section 312 of the Stafford Act by validating scopes, awards, and change orders against FEMA, SBA, insurance, and other recovery proceeds.
  • Review and approve change orders, document cost reasonableness, and maintain construction files sufficient to withstand HUD monitoring, State audit, and OIG review.
  • Support DRGR data entry, quarterly performance reporting, and construction closeout documentation for assigned activities.
  • Other tasks, as assigned

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience managing federally funded construction programs, specifically CDBG-DR/CDBG-MIT housing recovery programs.
  • Experience managing large-scale residential construction programs in Colorado, including floodplain, high-wind, and wildland-urban interface (WUI) compliance.
  • Strong understanding of HUD requirements, locally adopted Colorado building and energy codes, green building standards, and Section 3/MBE/WBE participation goals.
  • Demonstrated leadership managing multidisciplinary teams including inspectors, engineers, subcontractors, and administrative staff.
  • Familiarity with cost reasonableness review, Xactimate or RSMeans estimating tools, and Davis-Bacon compliance.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across government agencies, community stakeholders, and internal teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, and program/project management platforms (e.g., Smartsheet, QuickBase, Salesforce).
  • Proven experience managing CDBG-DR, CDBG-MIT, or other HUD-funded construction programs and effectively coordinating tasks across multiple locations.
  • Ability to assist in the development of a comprehensive construction management monitoring plan.
  • Expert knowledge of the Building, Fire, Residential, green, and energy codes adopted by Colorado jurisdictions, and of the statewide minimum codes that overlay them, including the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code (8 CCR 1507-39).
  • Expert knowledge of ADA and accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Knowledge of the IRC and IBC (2021 and 2024 editions, as adopted by the local jurisdiction) and resilient residential construction and building practices.
  • Proficiency in reading residential and commercial building plans.
  • Oral communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to explain building codes, procedures, and resolve issues between multiple parties.
  • Ability to work across several projects or tasks simultaneously.
  • Working knowledge of CDBG-DR cross-cutting requirements, including 24 CFR Part 570, 2 CFR Part 200, environmental review under 24 CFR Part 58, floodplain management under 24 CFR Part 55, the Uniform Relocation Act and Section 104(d), Section 3, Section 504/ADA, Section 106, and Duplication of Benefits.
  • Understanding of Colorado’s home rule code environment, in which there is no single statewide general building code or statewide general contractor license, and adopted code editions, amendments, and licensing requirements vary by municipality and county.
  • Knowledge of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code (8 CCR 1507-39), the statewide Wildfire Resiliency Code Map and fire intensity classifications, and the structure hardening and defensible space requirements local jurisdictions have been required to enforce since July 1, 2026.
  • Knowledge of Colorado energy code requirements established under HB22-1362, including the Model Electric Ready and Solar Ready Code and the Model Low Energy and Carbon Code, which became the state minimum energy code on July 1, 2026.
  • Familiarity with the CWCB floodplain rules at 2 CCR 408-1, including the one-foot minimum freeboard for residential structures, the two-foot standard for critical facilities, and No-Rise Certification requirements in regulatory floodways.
  • Experience with Front Range and high-altitude construction conditions, including ground snow and wind loads, expansive and bentonite soils, structural fill and foundation design, freeze-thaw exposure, radon mitigation, and high-wind assemblies consistent with the straight-line wind exposure documented in the Marshall Fire event.
  • Working knowledge of lead-safe practices under 24 CFR Part 35 and the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule, asbestos requirements under CDPHE Air Quality Control Commission Regulation No. 8, and mold assessment and remediation protocols.
  • Familiarity with Colorado procurement requirements, including the State Procurement Code (CRS Title 24, Articles 101-112) and State Fiscal Rules, and how they interact with the federal procurement standards at 2 CFR 200.317-200.327.
  • Experience overseeing subrecipients, local government partners, and third-party inspectors, and preparing construction documentation that supports HUD monitoring and single audit requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any contractor, inspector, or trade registrations required by the local jurisdictions in which work is performed, and to pass a background check.
  • Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel to project sites across impacted Colorado jurisdictions, including in winter driving conditions and at elevation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ICC certification as a Residential Building Inspector, Combination Inspector, or Certified Building Official, or a locally recognized equivalent.
  • Certified Construction Manager (CCM), PMP, or comparable construction or project management credential.
  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction certification.
  • EPA Lead Renovation, Repair and Painting Certified Renovator, or HUD Lead-Based Paint Inspector or Risk Assessor certification.
  • Training in wildland-urban interface construction, the International Wildland-Urban Interface Code, or the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code.
  • Prior experience on Colorado CDBG-DR programs administered by DOLA, including the DR-4634 Marshall Fire and Straight-Line Winds recovery in Boulder County or the DR-4145 2013 flood recovery in Boulder, Larimer, and Weld Counties.
  • Experience with HUD DRGR, the DOLA grant portal, and construction management platforms such as Procore, Smartsheet, or Salesforce.
  • Working knowledge of green building certification frameworks used in HUD-funded new construction, such as ENERGY STAR, Enterprise Green Communities, or the ICC 700 National Green Building Standard.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish.

Project Name:

Digital Regulatory Assurance System

Scope:

Modernization initiatives across the Government of Alberta are fundamentally changing how ministry users collect, manage, analyze, and use data as legacy systems are transformed into modern Data Management and Geospatial Platforms. This shift requires dedicated analytical capacity to ensure that the value of modernized data assets is fully realized.

DRAS is a Government of Alberta regulatory transformation initiative led by Environment and Protected Areas (EPA) to modernize, digitize, and streamline environmental and natural resource regulatory processes. DRAS supports the full regulatory lifecycle, from application and authorization to monitoring, compliance, remediation, and closure through a single, consolidated digital platform

As DRAS development continues, the volume, variety, and complexity of structured data continue to grow, creating a sustained need for dedicated data engineering and data product expertise. The Data Product Analyst role is critical to ensuring that modernization delivers tangible business value. This role will design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data into the DMP, apply standardized transformations, enforce data quality and governance controls, and produce trusted, analytics‑ready datasets that support regulatory oversight, compliance monitoring, and evidence‑based decision‑making aligned with DRAS objectives.

The Data Product Analyst provides operational support and continuous improvement (CI) services for DRAS data products and platform solutions. The role focuses on ensuring the ongoing reliability, availability, and performance of DRAS data assets, integrations, reports, and analytics products.

Duties:

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and product owners to understand data product objectives, requirements, and success criteria
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance data architecture on Microsoft Azure, supporting both cloud-native and hybrid environments.
  • Lead the development of data ingestion, transformation, and integration pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
  • Work with the Data Architect and manage data lakes and structured storage solutions using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, ensuring efficient access and governance.
  • Integrate data from diverse source systems including ServiceNow, and geospatial systems, using APIs, connectors, and custom scripts.
  • Develop and maintain robust data models and semantic layers to support operational reporting, analytics, and machine learning use cases and downstream consumption.
  • Build and optimize data workflows using Python and SQL for data cleansing, enrichment, and advanced analytics within Azure Databricks.
  • Design and expose secure data services and APIs using Azure API Management for downstream systems.
  • Implement data governance practices, including metadata management, data classification, and lineage tracking.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy and regulatory standards (e.g., FOIP, GDPR) through role-based access controls, encryption, and data masking.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across the platform.
  • Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline data engineering workflows, including pipeline development, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools for code generation, optimization, and review to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Design and curate standardized, high‑quality datasets that are suitable for advanced analytics and future AI use cases.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Finance Manager serves as a senior financial leader supporting Commercial Services operations within CBRE Government Services. This role blends Program Finance leadership, FP&A, accounting oversight (AP/GL close), and decision support to ensure strong financial governance, profitability, and operational alignment across multi-site, labor-intensive service contracts.

The position partners closely with Operations, Program Management, Contracts, Procurement, and Executive Leadership to drive financial performance, manage risk, and support growth across complex CSS portfolios.

Position is remote. Preference for candidates in Central (CT) or Eastern (ET) time zones.

Primary Job Functions

Financial Leadership & Strategic Support

  • Act as a trusted financial advisor to CSS operational leadership, providing insight on profitability, margin drivers, and cost structure.
  • Lead annual operating plan (AOP), budget development, forecasts, outlooks (EAC/ETC), and variance analysis.
  • Translate financial results into actionable operational and strategic recommendations.

Program Finance / Contract Financial Management

  • Oversee financial performance of government and/or commercial service contracts, ensuring compliance with contract terms, FAR/CAS/GAAP, and internal controls.
  • Manage or review labor accruals, subcontractor accruals, vendor costs, and SOX-compliant revenue recognition.
  • Support contract setup, WBS structures, charging practices, and ERP configuration (e.g., JAMIS, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite).
  • Monitor funding, billed/unbilled AR, subcontractor costs, and margin performance.

FP&A, Reporting & Analytics

  • Lead preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for leadership.
  • Perform trend, KPI, and margin analysis across labor, self-performed services, subcontracted work, and indirect cost pools.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate contract changes, pricing scenarios, staffing changes, and productivity initiatives.

Accounting Oversight (AP & GL Integration)

  • Provide leadership oversight to AP/GL-related activities impacting IFM/FM portfolios, including journal entries, reconciliations, and close activities.
  • Ensure accurate financial records, strong internal controls, and timely period-end close.
  • Partner with Accounting to support audits, reconciliations, and compliance activities.

People Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead, mentor, and develop finance team members (Finance Managers, Analysts, or Accountants as applicable).
  • Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Contracts, HR, Procurement, and Treasury.
  • Present financial results, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Education, Experience and Certification

  • Education
    • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
    • Preferred: Master’s degree (MBA or Finance-related)
  • Experience
    • 7–12+ years of progressive finance experience
    • 3+ years in a leadership or supervisory role
    • Experience supporting government contracting and/or outsourced facilities management, IFM, O&M, or BOS environments strongly preferred
  • Certifications (Preferred)
    • CPA, CMA, or equivalent
    • Microsoft / financial systems certifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and margin analysis
  • Experience with labor-intensive, multi-site service contracts (janitorial, maintenance, grounds)
  • Understanding of government and/or complex commercial contract types (FFP, CPAF, CPFF, T&M, IDIQ, LOE)
  • Advanced Excel skills (financial modeling, pivot tables, scenario analysis)
  • ERP experience (JAMIS, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar)
  • Power BI and/or equivalent experience in developing & maintaining aggregated financial dashboards.
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex financial concepts to non-financial leaders

Travel Requirements

  • Minimal to occasional (≤10%), as required for site reviews, audits, or leadership meetings

CBRE Government Services is thrilled at the opportunity for you to apply to one of our roles. The base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $160,000. This position may also be eligible for a wide range of competitive benefits that can include but not limited to: medical, well-being, financial planning and short-term incentives benefits.

Requirements stated represent the minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities to qualify and satisfactorily perform this job.

  • Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Extracts/Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery.
  • Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value.
  • Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, including consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Position:

Technical Solutions Architect


Job Description:

Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next.


Working across functions and technologies, you'll build lasting partnerships, deliver value beyond products, and help customers transform ideas into real-world solutions while growing your own career in a global technology organization.


Role Overview

Arrow is seeking a Technical Solutions Architect II to provide technical leadership, solution architecture expertise, and business guidance to our channel partner community across North America. This role is primarily focused on Juniper Networks solutions, with secondary responsibility for HPE Aruba Networking technologies.

The Technical Solutions Architect II is responsible for enabling partners, driving technical sales engagement, and architecting innovative networking solutions that accelerate pipeline growth and opportunity closure. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to channel partners, Arrow sales teams, and supplier organizations by delivering technical consultation, solution design, demonstrations, and competitive positioning across enterprise networking environments.


This position requires a strong background in enterprise networking, including campus, branch, wireless, data center, security, automation, and network management solutions.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Provide technical enablement and architectural guidance to channel partners and Arrow sales teams in the development of integrated networking solutions centered on Juniper Networks and Aruba technologies.
  • Assist channel partners in demand generation activities including workshops, assessments, technical events, webinars, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept engagements that generate qualified opportunities and expand pipeline.
  • Qualify networking opportunities by understanding customer business objectives, technical requirements, competitive landscape, budget considerations, and decision-making processes.
  • Lead technical sales engagements focused on discovery, architecture design, demonstrations, solution validation, and technical strategy to accelerate opportunity progression and closure.
  • Design and recommend enterprise networking solutions spanning wired access, wireless infrastructure, routing, switching, SD-WAN, network automation, cloud-managed networking, network security, and AI-driven operations.
  • Demonstrate technical leadership and subject matter expertise on Juniper Networks solutions, including Mist AI, Campus and Branch networking, Data Center networking, SD-WAN, and related technologies.
  • Support Aruba networking opportunities involving Aruba Central, campus switching, wireless infrastructure, edge networking, and network management solutions.
  • Deliver compelling technical presentations and workshops to partner sales teams, engineers, architects, and end-customer stakeholders.
  • Provide competitive positioning and market differentiation guidance against competing networking vendors and architectures.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to channel partners and internal Arrow teams while helping align technical solutions to business outcomes.
  • Collaborate closely with supplier teams, Arrow sales organizations, partner account managers, and engineering resources to drive strategic initiatives and revenue objectives.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging networking technologies, market trends, supplier roadmaps, and industry best practices.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking architectures and best practices.
  • Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, wireless networking, and network security technologies.
  • Experience designing and positioning networking solutions in customer-facing environments.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to align technical solutions with customer outcomes.
  • Ability to influence technical and business decision makers.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Results-oriented mindset with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional organizations.
  • Technical leadership and mentoring capabilities.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, customer-focused, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced environment.

Education/Experience

  • 7-10+ years of experience in networking architecture, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or related technical consulting roles.
  • Strong experience with enterprise networking technologies including routing, switching, wireless networking, network security, automation, and cloud-managed infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Juniper Networks solutions.
  • Experience with HPE Aruba Networking solutions highly desired.
  • Experience with network automation, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code methodologies preferred.
  • Ability to effectively present technical concepts to audiences ranging from engineers to executive leadership.
  • Industry certifications such as JNCIP, JNCIS, JNCIA, Aruba Certified Professional (ACP), Aruba Certified Design Expert (ACDX), CCNP, or equivalent preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Work Arrangement

Fully Remote: Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.


What’s In It For You

At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans, and a solid benefits package.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • 401k, With Matching Contributions
  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options
  • Paid Time Off (including sick, holiday, vacation, etc.)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Growth Opportunities
  • And more!

About Arrow

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better.


At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges.


Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next.

As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.


Life at Arrow

At Arrow, we believe innovation starts with people. We create an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning help our employees grow and make a meaningful impact every day.


From your first day, you'll have opportunities to build new skills, work alongside talented teams around the world, and contribute to technology that helps shape a better future. Because when our people grow, innovation moves forward

jobs.description:

As Business Development Manager, Repair and Remodel, you will focus on a specialized segment of dealers and partners who take building products directly to the homeowner, often through an in-home selling model. These businesses sell windows, doors, siding, roofing, decking and other exterior building products. Understanding how they generate leads, how they sell in the home, and how they deliver the complete homeowner experience will be critical to your success.

You will become an integral part of your customers' businesses, serving as the connector between our specialty dealers, distributors, sales teams and internal resources. You will help partners grow through product knowledge, training, business support, and access to the right people across Fortune Brands.

This is a highly visible, relationship-driven role for someone who understands the repair and remodel channel, knows how specialty dealers operate, and can turn strong partnerships into measurable growth. About the Role

We are seeking an energetic, commercially minded Inside Sales Representative to join our revenue team. In this role, you will act as a key commercial partner to our Client Managers, driving revenue growth through precise quoting, deal progression, renewal management, and active vendor coordination.

This is not a passive administrative position—it is a proactive sales role where you will share accountability for quote quality, customer responsiveness, pipeline velocity, and team revenue outcomes. You will work alongside Client Managers while also liaising directly with customers on quotes, renewals, add-on opportunities, and solution inquiries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Quote Preparation & Execution: Prepare precise, timely, and commercially sound quotes for hardware, software licensing, and professional services aligned with company standards.
  • Transaction & Pipeline Ownership: Manage transactional sales from initial customer request through quote acceptance, order processing, and handover to delivery, finance, or operations teams.
  • Vendor & Distributor Management: Liaise with vendor partners and distributors to secure competitive pricing, confirm availability/lead times, process deal registrations, and leverage vendor promotions.
  • Renewals & Opportunity Identification: Track and manage upcoming solution and licensing renewals. Proactively spot simple add-on, cross-sell, and upgrade opportunities based on client buying history.
  • Customer & Internal Alignment: Follow up open quotes, handle customer inquiries professionally, and collaborate with internal subject matter experts to support complex solution builds.
  • CRM & Process Discipline: Maintain strict accuracy across all sales records, opportunities, and activities using HubSpot, D-Tools, and Microsoft 365, ensuring zero untracked sales activity.
  • RFP & Tender Support: Assist with gathering product specs, pricing structures, and vendor information for major client proposals and tenders.

Requirements

Required Skills & Working Style

  • Detail & Commercial Focus: Exceptional attention to detail when compiling pricing, margins, and commercial conditions.
  • Strong Communication: Confident, clear written and verbal skills when dealing with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership Mindset: Strong follow-through to take assigned requests from initial draft all the way through to completion.
  • Agility & Adaptability: Ability to prioritize multiple requests, grasp technical solution details quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A team-first attitude with shared accountability for achieving gross margin and revenue targets alongside Client Managers.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 1–2 years in inside sales, sales support, technology distribution, procurement, or a related commercial B2B environment.
  • Technical Aptitude: Experience with technology, cloud, or Microsoft solutions is highly regarded (though not strictly required).
  • Tooling: Prior experience navigating CRMs (e.g., HubSpot), quoting tools, or distributor/vendor portals is desirable.
  • Education: Tertiary qualifications are welcomed, but proven commercial discipline, customer focus, and quick-learning capability are prioritized.

Benefits

  • Remote / WFH
  • Full time
  • AU Business Hours

A future cyber security expert! You're passionate about security and ready to dive in, using your growing technical skills to help protect client data and infrastructure from threats. Day-to-day, you’ll focus on monitoring, initial investigation, and following established procedures, while leveraging the expertise of your team to solve problems and learn new things.
