• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you’ve got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit.

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team using best-in-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level.

What you’ll do:

  • Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes.

  • Full-Stack Engineering: Ability to flex across backend, frontend, data pipelines, AI tools, Python, React. When you aren’t a pro at something, you can use AI effectively to deliver and you know how to make sure that the engineering stays excellent along the way.

  • AI Solutions Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to design, build, and deploy production solutions to accelerate non-technical stakeholders.

  • Product Sense and Impact: Ability to rapidly understand and develop a solution without having curated requirements. You can step into a problem space with little context, rapidly understand what needs to be done, and deliver impact.

  • Empathy and Customer Communication: Strong ability to communicate in non-technical language to stakeholders from entry to executive level. Proven ability to both manage expectations and keep customers up to date.

  • AI Solutions Engineering: Familiarity working with AI tools such as Gemini, Cortex Code, and Genie Code, and you can wield them to turn solution delivery from weeks into hours.

  • Be Curious and Adaptable: You are eager to explore new technologies and you are happy to flex across a variety of problems and domains by the day. You are comfortable with dozens of different problems for different stakeholders at any given time.

  • Stay Aligned: Proven ability to contribute to standards and leverage existing tools and systems to ensure the FDE solutions are aligned with the Data and Insights engineering roadmap.

Who you are:

  • Experienced, Scrappy, and Creative: You have at least 3 years of software engineering experience. An ideal candidate will have exposure to customers, experience with Python, experience with data pipelining (e.g., ETL) and either Snowflake and/or Databricks (we build on both but one is sufficient for candidates). Ideally, you’ve already used Genie Code or Cortex Code, Notebooks, and Streamlit to some extent to deliver solutions. You’re imaginative and can think of ways to rapidly solve problems.

  • Biased to Action and Impact: You have a strong focus on the customer with a bias to action to deliver value quickly. You are deeply motivated when you see pain points to fix them. You can take a manual, scrappy workflow that involved copy-pasting between tools and use AI to make it feel seamless.

  • Lifelong Learner: You have a passion for learning and yearn for feedback, valuing the opportunity for daily growth.

  • Mission-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.
Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.
Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

Instead, this engineer serves as the primary escalation point for the most challenging service issues and plays a critical role in strengthening overall service delivery.

This position exists to eliminate recurring escalations, reduce cross-team dependencies, and raise the technical maturity of the service organization. The Senior Systems Engineer partners closely with L1/L2 engineers, service leadership, and project teams to troubleshoot advanced issues, improve standards, and ensure stable, scalable client environments.

The ideal candidate has strong, practical networking expertise and solid mid-to-high level experience across standard MSP support, including servers, cloud services, identity, endpoint management, and core business applications. Networking escalations will be a key responsibility, but day-to-day work will span a wide range of service issues and technical mentorship.

Core Focus of the Role

  • Act as a senior escalation engineer responsible for resolving the most complex service issues across client environments, regardless of technology domain
  • Own issues through to resolution, reducing ticket reassignment, repeated escalations, and dependency on multiple teams
  • Provide deep technical support across core MSP platforms and infrastructure, including servers, cloud services, identity, endpoints, and networking
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for advanced networking and firewall issues when they arise, ensuring rapid and accurate resolution

Service Impact & Operational Efficiency

Common Sense Privacy is defining the standard for privacy and trust in software. Our software provides independent privacy evaluation for companies that handle sensitive user data. We help businesses keep up with fast evolving regulations, customer expectations, and implement best practices. As global regulations and customer expectations evolve at breakneck speed, we empower businesses to not only stay compliant but to lead with best practices.
Companies who pass our rigorous assessment can apply for the privacy seal. The Common Sense Privacy Seal has become the credential that matters: the mark that tells buyers a company has been thoroughly evaluated and meets the highest privacy standards.
We're backed by Andrew Ng's AI Fund and built on the 20-year trusted foundation of Common Sense Media.
We've moved beyond early traction. We have revenue, and paying enterprise customers. We started in educational technology and are now expanding into additional verticals where privacy differentiation creates competitive advantage.

The Role

You’ll sell our privacy evaluation services—helping companies earn our seal and demonstrate credible privacy practices to their customers. Your job is simple: find companies who understand the importance of customer trust, show them how our seal differentiates them, and close contracts.
This is a full-cycle sales role. You’ll prospect, qualify, demo, negotiate, and close—working with warm inbound leads and identifying your own targets. You’ll carry quota and be measured on revenue.
Initially, you’ll focus on our established education technology market while exploring adjacent verticals. As you identify promising opportunities in new markets, you’ll test and validate them.

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

You’ll spend your time on calls. Prospecting calls with companies that need credible privacy differentiation. Discovery calls understanding how our seal helps them compete. Demo calls walking through our evaluation process and what earning our seal means. Negotiation calls working through contract terms. You’ll update the CRM, forecast your pipeline, and collaborate with marketing on target account campaigns.
You’ll travel occasionally (15-20%) to attend conferences where you can meet prospects face-to-face—not just edtech events, but also healthcare IT, fintech, and HR tech conferences as we establish our standard in new markets.
This role reports directly to the CEO with responsibilities in the following areas:

Pipeline Generation (40%)

  • Work warm inbound leads from companies requesting to be evaluated for our seal
  • Identify and prospect target accounts: companies in education, healthcare SaaS, fintech, HR tech, or other verticals where our trust standard creates value
  • Use intent signals: companies responding to RFPs with privacy requirements, recently funded companies entering regulated markets, vendors facing buyer questions about trust and privacy
  • Leverage demand generation: when buyers ask vendors “how can we trust your privacy practices?”, you help those vendors earn our seal
  • Conduct outreach via email, LinkedIn, phone, and conference connections
  • Run discovery calls to qualify fit and understand how our seal helps them win deals

Deal Management (50%)

  • Run demos showing our evaluation process and what companies receive when they earn our seal
  • Navigate multiple stakeholders: product, legal, compliance, marketing, sales leadership
  • Position our seal as competitive differentiation: show how it helps companies win deals and build trust with privacy-conscious buyers
  • Handle objections around timing, cost, and ROI
  • Structure deals: seal evaluations, ongoing monitoring,, multi-product assessments
  • Coordinate with delivery team on evaluation timelines and seal issuance
  • Show ROI: our seal helps companies win competitive deals by proving their privacy practices

Market Development (10%)

  • Refine positioning of our seal and trust standard in new verticals beyond education
  • Identify patterns: which industries value our credential most, what triggers buying decisions
  • Share insights with leadership about market opportunities
  • Help refine how we position our seal for different buyer personas

Requirements For the Role Include:

  • 5+ years full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience
  • Track record consistently hitting or exceeding quota ($750K-$ annually)
  • Experience selling deals in the $25K-$100K range
  • Experience selling across multiple industries—you can adapt your pitch for different markets
  • Proficiency with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and sales engagement tools
  • Strong discovery skills: can uncover pain, understand buying process, identify decision-makers
  • Effective demo and presentation skills
  • Ability to position credentials, certifications, or trust signals as competitive advantage
  • Self-motivated and disciplined in managing your own pipeline

Nice To Haves Include:

  • Experience selling privacy, compliance, security, or trust/safety solutions
  • Experience selling certification, assessment, or credential programs
  • Background selling to regulated industries (healthcare, finance, education)
  • Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes
  • Experience in early-stage or growth-stage startups where you helped develop new markets
  • Comfort with market ambiguity—you can test new approaches without perfect clarity

Compensation & Benefits

Common Sense Privacy offers a competitive compensation, equity and benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and flexible PTO

What Makes This Role Different

You’re selling something buyers actually want to see: credible proof that a company takes privacy seriously. Our seal matters because it’s backed by Common Sense Media’s 20-year reputation and rigorous independent evaluation.
When companies earn our seal, they can prove their privacy practices to skeptical buyers. When buyers see our seal, they know it means something. You’re not just selling software—you’re helping companies earn a credential that builds trust.
You’ll have the opportunity to shape which markets we pursue. You’ll help define our expansion strategy. You’re not just executing someone else’s plan—you’re discovering where our trust standard creates the most value.
The seal is real. The initial market is proven. Your job is to execute in education while building our next growth markets.
If you’re a closer who wants to sell something meaningful and help define a new standard, let’s talk.

Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

Summary

As a Software and Integration Architect at Smarsh, you will define and execute the software and integration architecture that connects Smarsh’s operational systems and 12+ product platforms. This role blends general software and cloud architecture with integration architecture, requiring strong system design skills across backend services, cloud infrastructure, and user-facing applications.

You will serve as the technical leader for custom application development on Smarsh’s custom IT platform, delivering applications for users across the business, not just the backend systems that support them. This includes the systems responsible for provisioning all Smarsh products, tracking and billing more than $120M in annual revenue from customer overages and growing, and enabling the reliable flow of telemetry data across the platform. You will also be the technical leader for all integrations across IT and Operations at Smarsh, owning the end-to-end integration landscape company-wide, excluding only integrations built into Smarsh’s own products.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. Expert-level AWS and software architecture skills are the priority: you will lead the design and build of scalable, cloud-native architectures leveraging AWS services, microservices-based designs, distributed systems, and modern web applications. Integrations are built primarily on AWS and MuleSoft, with Python as our core language, and you should expect to be hands-on-keyboard alongside the team.

Central to this role is our AI-SDLC methodology, an AI-native software development lifecycle in which we use a variety of AI models alongside AI coding tools as a core part of how we design, build, test, and ship software. As an architect, you will not just work within this methodology but help define and advance it, setting the standard for how the team builds with AI. We work with Claude as well as ChatGPT, Ollama, and other leading and open-source tools, and we expect you to stay invested in the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bring the best of it into the team’s day-to-day work.

You will work closely with all areas of Smarsh’s business to ensure seamless connectivity across systems and platforms, from backend services through customer- and internal-facing user experiences.

How will you contribute?

    • Operate as a technical leader of the team, working alongside the Sr. Full Stack Developer and Engineering Manager to drive the technical direction of projects from design through delivery.

    • Lead the architecture and development of custom applications on Smarsh’s custom IT platform, serving users across the business.

    • Own the architecture, standards, and delivery for all integrations across IT and Operations, built primarily on AWS and MuleSoft with Python as the core language.

    • Own the systems that support provisioning, billing, telemetry, product usage tracking, and revenue streams across Smarsh’s product ecosystem.

    • Lead observability and operational readiness across systems, including metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and cloud cost awareness.

    • Translate architectural designs into clear Jira epics, stories, and tasks, and guide technical prioritization in collaboration with Engineering leadership within Agile delivery.

    • Design testing strategies for large, distributed systems, including integration, end-to-end, performance, and failure scenario testing.

    • Provide architectural direction and technical mentorship across the team, and establish and maintain software and integration architecture standards, governance, and best practices.

What will you bring?

jobs.excerpt: Product Owner – Finance Systems & Projects Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para atuar como elo entre as áreas de Finanças e Tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, evolução e melhoria contínua dos sistemas financeiros da organização.
jobs.description:
Product Owner – Finance Systems & Projects Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para atuar como elo entre as áreas de Finanças e Tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, evolução e melhoria contínua dos sistemas financeiros da organização.

Este profissional será responsável por liderar a gestão de demandas, incidentes e melhorias sistêmicas, assegurando rápida resposta às necessidades do negócio, além de atuar na condução de projetos estratégicos de transformação e automação de processos financeiros.

A posição exige forte interação com stakeholders de diversas áreas de finanças, capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos e habilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

Principais Responsabilidades Sustentação de Sistemas Financeiros

  • Atuar como responsável funcional pelos sistemas de finanças, garantindo sua operação contínua e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Gerenciar e priorizar demandas, incidentes e problemas críticos, assegurando tratamento adequado dentro dos SLAs definidos.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz e coordenar planos de ação para mitigação de recorrências.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de TI para temas relacionados à sustentação.
  • Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais.
  • Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.

Gestão de Relacionamento com o Negócio

  • Manter relacionamento próximo e constante com as áreas de Finanças.
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de alinhamento, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas.
  • Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas.
  • Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia.

Gestão de Projetos

  • Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras.
  • Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção.
  • Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status.
  • Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança.

Gestão de Backlog e Priorização

  • Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado.
  • Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio.
  • Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas.

Conhecimento dos principais processos financeiros, incluindo:

  • Contratação e Faturamento (Billing)
  • Contas a Receber (Accounts Receivable)
  • Revenue Recognition
  • Cobrança e aplicações de recebimentos
  • Controles financeiros e contábeis
  • Inglês avançado obrigatório

Sistemas e Ferramentas

  • Gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares)
  • Ferramentas de documentação (Confluence ou similares)
  • Power BI e IA (desejável)
  • Experiência com ERP, sistemas financeiros e integrações

Metodologias

  • Agile / Scrum
  • Kanban
  • Gestão de Projetos

Competências Comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva
  • Forte capacidade de priorização
  • Senso de urgência
  • Organização e gestão simultânea de múltiplas demandas
  • Perfil colaborativo e orientado ao cliente interno
  • Capacidade de negociação com stakeholders
  • Visão de processos e resolução de problemas
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com constante mudança de prioridades

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em áreas de Finance Systems, Finance Transformation ou Product Ownership em Finanças.
  • Conhecimento de processos O2C, P2P e R2R.
  • Experiência em sustentação de aplicações corporativas críticas.
  • Participação em projetos de implementação ou transformação de sistemas financeiros.

Esta é uma posição exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Como parte do nosso compromisso com a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades, aqui na Serasa temos diversas iniciativas, como por exemplo: intérpretes de libras, tecnologias assistivas, cordão girassol (deficiências ocultas), entre outras ações. Na Serasa Experian temos o grupo Aspire que visa construir para um ambiente acessível e de oportunidades justas para os profissionais com deficiência.

Venha fazer parte dessa transformação!

Caso você não se identifique com este grupo, convidamos você a explorar outras oportunidades em nossa página de carreiras. Temos diversas vagas que podem se conectar com seu perfil e interesses.

Atuamos em diversos mercados, como serviços financeiros, saúde, automotivo, agronegócio, seguros, entre outros. A Experian investe em pessoas e em novas tecnologias avançadas para liberar o poder dos dados. Contamos com uma equipe incrível de 25.200 colaboradores em 32 países.

Nossa singularidade é valorizar a sua. A cultura da Experian, centrada nas pessoas, inclusiva e orientada por propósito, é reconhecida por diversos prêmios — incluindo World’s Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Top 25 global da Fortune) e Great Place To Work™ em 26 países, entre outros. jobs.title: Engenheiro(a) de IA – Especialista ll
jobs.excerpt: Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista II em AI Engineering para acelerar a adoção de Inteligência Artificial na estrutura de Marketing Services, conectando profundidade técnica em GenAI com oportunidades concretas de produto, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a BU.
jobs.description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista II em AI Engineering para acelerar a adoção de Inteligência Artificial na estrutura de Marketing Services, conectando profundidade técnica em GenAI com oportunidades concretas de produto, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a BU.

Essa posição terá papel central na evolução de soluções baseadas em LLMs, RAG e agentes, apoiando a identificação de casos de uso, a definição de abordagens técnicas e a tradução de aprendizado experimental em recomendações acionáveis para Produto, Engenharia e Liderança.

Mais do que uma referência em experimentação, buscamos alguém com experiência prática em aplicar IA para acelerar estratégias de produtos digitais, melhorar jornadas e apoiar decisões de negócio com foco em impacto real.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir experimentos comparativos com diferentes LLMs, agentes e arquiteturas de GenAI aplicados a casos reais de negócio;
  • Projetar, otimizar e evoluir pipelines de RAG, incluindo estratégias de chunking, embeddings, retrieval e avaliação contínua;
  • Estruturar frameworks de avaliação e benchmarking para aplicações GenAI, considerando qualidade, relevância, confiabilidade, custo, latência e aderência ao caso de uso;
  • Medir performance, custo e ROI de soluções baseadas em IA, apoiando decisões de priorização e escala;
  • Apoiar decisões sobre quando utilizar Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-Tuning ou arquiteturas multiagentes, avaliando trade-offs técnicos e de negócio;
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Produto, Engenharia, Dados e Liderança para identificar onde IA pode acelerar estratégias de produtos digitais e ampliar valor para a BU;
  • Traduzir resultados técnicos em recomendações claras para roadmap, arquitetura, governança e evolução de capacidades;
  • Contribuir para boas práticas, padrões técnicos e uso responsável de GenAI dentro da estrutura;
  • Apoiar a construção de uma visão aplicada de IA para Marketing Services, conectando tendências tecnológicas a necessidades reais de clientes, parceiros e produtos.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, MLOps ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prática com GenAI e LLMs em contexto real de negócio;
  • Experiência no desenho, avaliação e evolução de soluções com RAG, embeddings, retrieval e/ou agentes;
  • Vivência em iniciativas que conectaram IA a produto digital, eficiência operacional, automação ou aceleração de jornadas;
  • Proficiência avançada em Python;
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Base consistente em estatística, análise de dados e experimentação;
  • Experiência com avaliação de modelos generativos, incluindo métricas tradicionais e abordagens LLM-based;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e ecossistemas de LLMs, como OpenAI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI ou equivalentes;
  • Capacidade de documentar trade-offs e transformar conclusões técnicas em recomendações acionáveis.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em acelerar a adoção de IA dentro de uma Business Unit, conectando tecnologia a estratégia e execução;
  • Vivência com produtos digitais, personalização, automação, Martech ou jornadas orientadas a crescimento;
  • Experiência com Fine-Tuning, Transfer Learning, Hugging Face, PyTorch ou TensorFlow;
  • Familiaridade com AWS Bedrock Agents / AWS Agent Core;
  • Experiência com automação e orquestração de fluxos GenAI, usando n8n, Flowise, LangFlow ou equivalentes;
  • Vivência com Prompt Optimization, incluindo DSPy ou abordagens similares;
  • Capacidade de navegar bem entre exploração técnica e priorização executiva.

Competências esperadas

  • Pensamento analítico e forte orientação a evidências;
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar exploração em direcionamento prático;
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Autonomia, senso de dono e responsabilidade técnica;
  • Forte colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade contínua e leitura crítica para separar hype de valor real;.
  • Capacidade de conectar profundidade técnica com impacto de negócio

Escopo esperado para Especialista II

  • Influência relevante em decisões de arquitetura e estratégia de GenAI;
  • Atuação como referência técnica para iniciativas aplicadas à BU;
  • Papel ativo na aceleração da curva de adoção de IA em Marketing Services;
  • Capacidade de conectar excelência técnica com direcionamento de produto e negócio.

O que deve diferenciar esse perfil

Buscamos alguém que una excelência técnica em GenAI com visão aplicada de negócio, e que consiga transformar capacidades de IA em iniciativas concretas para produtos, jornadas e prioridades estratégicas de Marketing Services.

Qualifications

  • Experiência prática com GenAI e LLMs em contexto real de negócio;
  • Vivência em aplicar IA para acelerar produtos digitais e jornadas;
  • Experiência com RAG, embeddings, retrieval e avaliação de soluções;
  • Capacidade de conectar decisões técnicas com impacto de negócio, custo e ROI;
  • Proficiência em Python, SQL e análise de dados/experimentação;
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas técnicos para stakeholders.

A Serasa Experian é muito mais do que você imagina. Com o propósito de criar um futuro melhor, ampliando oportunidades para pessoas e empresas, no Brasil somos mais de 4 mil pessoas que atuam em diversos times e especialidades. Aqui, cada conhecimento e diversidade se complementa e você pode trabalhar no que mais ama, estamos comprometidos a construir uma cultura inclusiva e um ambiente no qual pessoas possam equilibrar a carreira com seus compromissos e interesses pessoais, prezando pelo bem-estar.

At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

jobs.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
jobs.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

About the role

AI agents at Honeycomb investigate, reason, and act on real observability data. They live in Canvas: the agentic workspace where engineers go to understand their systems.

The Agentic Intelligence team has shipped Canvas, the Honeycomb MCP server, and the Canvas Agent and Canvas Skills surfaces. What we're looking for today is someone who brings deep agent expertise and uses it to expand what the team can build: new agents, new surface area in Canvas, memory, spatial awareness, improved performance on our Bedrock loop.

Honeycomb's data store is fast and accepts high cardinality data; that's what makes agents built on top of it different from anything built on a conventional observability backend. This role is about taking advantage of that building agents that can do things no other observability product can do because the underlying data makes it possible.

Some of this work will start as a prototype. The expectation is that the code makes it through the full arc, from the rough first version through to something that holds up in production.

What you'll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade agents. Build agents that investigate, reason, and act on live observability data inside Canvas. These agents must be trustworthy to engineers in high pressure situations, including mid-incident. Take one from rough first version to something that holds up under production traffic.
  • Own the agent work; support the whole product. Scope, build, ship, and maintain the agents including the evals that tell you whether they got better or are just different. This role is agent-focused and also includes some fullstack development.
  • Build agents only Honeycomb can build. Use a data store that returns high-cardinality queries in seconds to reason over signal a conventional backend can't serve at this fidelity correlating across services, drilling into a single trace, comparing before and after a deploy.
  • Extend the surface, and decide what's next. Ship new capability into Canvas, the MCP server, and Canvas Skills memory, spatial awareness, a faster Bedrock loop and make the case for what comes after with working code. Distinguish hype from signal in a field with plenty of both.
  • Define what "good" means for agents here. Set the bar: measurable against real evals, maintainable, and honest about their limits.

Example projects

  • Multiple agents collaborating on one shared Canvas investigation each claiming a hypothesis, publishing findings, and narrowing the search space for the others so it resolves faster (blog).
  • Auto-investigation the moment an SLO burn alert fires the agent forms hypotheses and prepares visualizations before a human looks, cutting mean-time-to-insight for on-call (o11ycon 2026).
  • Skills that encode a team's domain expertise e.g. Kubernetes thresholds so agents and human colleagues can lean on them (o11ycon 2026).

What you'll bring:

  • AI and agent engineering experience. You've shipped LLM-based systems people relied on in production not demos, not fine-tuned models in a research context. You know where agent systems break and how to design around it.
  • End-to-end ownership. On a small team there's no handoff queue. You can take something from rough prototype to production-grade without needing someone behind you to do the durable engineering.
  • Current judgment, not just past experience. You have informed opinions about what's shifted in agent design in the last six to twelve months that would change how you'd build today.
  • Agent architecture depth. You understand how a fast, high-cardinality data store changes what an agent can reason about, and how to design for that.
  • Product judgment. You can look at what the agent layer does today and see what it should do next and make that case with a prototype, not a deck.

Even better

  • Observability or developer-tools background. Engineers are your users; you'll ramp faster with fluency in that world, and the work is better.
  • Familiarity with eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, and prompt engineering.
Base Salary based on level of experience
$183,340—$206,000 USD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information for consideration for other roles, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions. We’re not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here. LeoLabs is seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer to support strategic growth opportunities across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This role serves as a critical technical partner to Business Development, helping customers understand how LeoLabs' Space Domain Awareness capabilities can solve complex operational challenges and support mission objectives.

The Senior Solutions Engineer will lead technical engagement throughout the customer lifecycle – from early opportunity shaping and technical discovery through proposal development, demonstrations, evaluations, contract award, and transition into implementation.

Working closely with Business Development, Engineering, Product, Operations, and customer stakeholders, you will translate customer missions and requirements into compelling technical solutions. The ideal candidate brings experience supporting government, defense, aerospace, or commercial space customers and has the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Solutions Engineering & Capture

  • Partner with Business Development and Account Executives to shape strategic opportunities across government, defense, civil, and commercial markets.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer missions, operational needs, acquisition requirements, and technical challenges.
  • Develop mission-focused solution approaches that align LeoLabs capabilities with customer objectives.
  • Support capture activities by identifying technical differentiators, competitive advantages, and customer value propositions.
  • Serve as the technical lead throughout opportunity development, ensuring solutions align with customer evaluation criteria and mission priorities.
  • Support customer engagements, technical exchanges, industry events, and executive briefings.

Proposal Development & Procurement Support

  • Coordinate proposal inputs across Engineering, Product, Operations, Security, and leadership teams.
  • Support proposal reviews, compliance checks, and improvements to strengthen technical positioning.
  • Provide technical insight during contract discussions and customer negotiations.

Technical Solutions & Customer Engagement

  • Deliver technical demonstrations, workshops, and presentations tailored to customer missions and operational workflows.
  • Design solutions leveraging LeoLabs' platform, APIs, analytics, and data products.
  • Support proof-of-concept activities, technical evaluations, and customer adoption initiatives.
  • Help customers incorporate Space Domain Awareness insights into operational decision-making.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer engineers, operators, program managers, acquisition teams, and leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Security, and Business Development teams to support customer opportunities.
  • Provide customer feedback and market insights to influence product strategy and roadmap development.
  • Help develop reusable technical content, solution messaging, proposal materials, and customer-facing collateral.
  • Ensure alignment between customer needs, technical solutions, and delivery commitments.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Space Systems, or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Capture Management, Technical Business Development, Systems Engineering, or Technical Program Management.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting government, defense, aerospace, intelligence, or commercial technology customers.
  • Experience supporting competitive procurements, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, Statements of Work, proposal development, and technical evaluations.
  • Strong technical writing skills with experience developing proposals, technical documentation, white papers, or customer-facing technical content.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams to develop complex technical solutions.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to engage technical, operational, acquisition, and executive audiences.
  • Ability to understand customer missions and translate technical capabilities into meaningful operational value.
  • Professional proficiency in English.
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% throughout Europe and occasionally internationally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the commercial space, satellite, aerospace, intelligence, or defense sectors.

  • Experience supporting European Ministries of Defence, NATO organizations, defense primes, or government agencies.
  • Understanding of defense acquisition processes and competitive capture strategies.
  • Experience developing technical proposals for complex government procurements.
  • Familiarity with APIs, cloud technologies, Python, SQL, or modern software architectures.

What Success Looks Like

What You'll Bring

  • The ability to connect technical solutions with customer mission outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Commercial Finance
jobs.excerpt: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

The Senior Manager, Commercial Finance will be a strategic finance partner to business and commercial leaders, helping BetterHelp make better decisions across growth, revenue, marketing investment, pricing, health plan partnerships, unit economics, margin, and long-term business performance. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

This individual will support a business that spans both cash-pay subscription dynamics and insurance-covered healthcare economics. The ideal candidate must bring experience in digital / online mental health or closely related healthcare businesses, with a strong understanding of how healthcare revenue models work, including payer relationships, reimbursement dynamics, revenue cycle management, claims, collections, and the operational drivers that influence insurance revenue realization.

This is not just a reporting role. It is about understanding what is happening in the business, why it is happening, what it means, and what actions we should take. The Senior Manager will own key areas of planning, forecasting, performance management, business casing, and strategic analysis, while translating complex financial and operational data into clear recommendations for senior leadership.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial fundamentals with commercial curiosity, healthcare business acumen, analytical depth, business judgment, and strong communication skills. This person should be comfortable working through ambiguity, challenging assumptions, influencing cross-functional partners, and creating executive-ready work that helps drive real business decisions.

What will you do?

  • Serve as a strategic finance partner to commercial, operational, and business leaders, helping evaluate growth opportunities, investment decisions, business performance, and key trade-offs across both cash-pay and insurance-covered areas of the business.
  • Own and improve planning and forecasting for key areas of the business, including revenue, acquisition, retention, pricing, insurance mix, reimbursement, unit economics, marketing efficiency, margin, and other core business drivers.
  • Build and maintain driver-based financial models that support forecasting, scenario planning, resource allocation, business cases, and long-term strategic planning.
  • Analyze actual performance versus forecast / budget, identify the key drivers of variance, and translate findings into clear implications and recommended actions.
  • Develop business cases for new initiatives, products, pricing changes, partnerships, payer / channel opportunities, marketing investments, bundles, or other commercial opportunities, including financial impact, key assumptions, sensitivities, risks, and decision points.
  • Partner with business leaders to understand the underlying economics of their areas, including input metrics, output metrics, operational drivers, and how business activity flows through to revenue, margin, cash collection, and the P&L.
  • Support analysis of insurance-related business drivers, including payer mix, reimbursement rates, session economics, utilization, provider supply, claims performance, denial / rejection trends, collections, DSO, and revenue realization.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses on complex business questions, such as customer acquisition economics, conversion, retention, cohort performance, CPA, LTV, channel mix, pricing, supply / demand dynamics, payer economics, and ROI.
  • Prepare executive-ready materials for weekly business reviews, operating reviews, quarterly updates, board discussions, and strategic decision-making forums.
  • Develop KPI reporting and performance management tools that help leaders understand business health, identify trends, and make better decisions.
  • Translate large datasets and complex analyses into simple, crisp narratives, charts, and recommendations that clearly answer the “what, why, so what, and now what.”
  • Partner effectively with Revenue Cycle, Operations, Data Science, Analytics, Accounting, and broader FP&A teams to ensure financial analysis is accurate, consistent, and grounded in reliable data and metric definitions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve models, reporting, processes, and decision-making tools, with a focus on scalability, accuracy, and business value.
  • Drive financial discipline across monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles, ensuring clear targets, accountability, ownership, and visibility into risks and opportunities.
  • Support ad hoc strategic projects and executive analyses that inform company-level decisions.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • 5–7+ years of relevant experience in corporate finance, FP&A, investment banking, management consulting, or a similarly analytical role.

jobs.description:
About the Role:

BWZ is looking for an Off-Page SEO Manager to build our link-acquisition engine from the ground up. We're investing in a more diversified, sustainable authority acquisition strategy. You'll manage existing vendor relationships while building and scaling off-page link acquisition initiatives. Reporting to our Senior SEO Manager, you'll partner closely with our Content team to turn our tools and resources into genuine linkable assets.

Who you are:

You're a self-starter who's comfortable operating with more ambiguity than structure — you'll need to generate ideas, test them, and figure out what works with limited playbook to lean on. You understand what separates a good link from a bad one, and you're not precious about starting with unglamorous, manual work (vendor management, reclamation, cold outreach) while building toward something more systematic. You think in terms of repeatable processes, not one-off wins — you're the kind of person who turns "we got a link" into "here's how we get links like this every month."

What you'll be doing (responsibilities):

  • Own the end-to-end vendor relationship lifecycle, including sourcing, negotiation, quality review, performance tracking, and ongoing optimization
  • Build and scale BWZ's earned and owned link acquisition capabilities — including reclamation, partner and reciprocal link-swap relationships, and outreach tied to linkable assets
  • Partner with our Content team to turn calculators, templates, and resource pages into outreach-ready linkable assets — owning the recipient lists, outreach, embed tracking, and reporting for each campaign
  • Evaluate external link partnership platforms and provide recommendations on long-term partnership strategy
  • Track and report clear numbers monthly: total links acquired, cost per link, and the shifting split between sources
  • Grow the contribution of earned and owned acquisition channels over time

How your success will be measured:

  • New Quality Links Acquired: Total new links per month meeting our quality bar across all channels — reclamation, partner swaps, data outreach, and linkable-asset/badge campaigns
  • Channel scale & diversity — Growth in the number of durable, repeatable acquisition channels producing quality links, so authority comes from a resilient mix of sources rather than any single dependency
  • Acquisition efficiency — Blended cost and effort per quality link trending down over time as owned and earned channels scale and mature.

Your skillset includes:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in link building, link acquisition, or a closely related SEO discipline
  • Strong relationship-building instincts — comfortable initiating and nurturing recurring partnerships with external stakeholders (editors, SEO managers, site owners, agencies) over time, not just one-off transactional outreach
  • Working understanding of what makes a link valuable (relevance, authority, placement) versus low-quality or risky
  • Comfort with outreach and SEO research tooling (e.g., Pitchbox, Ahrefs/SEMrush, email outreach platforms)
  • A self-directed, experimental approach — able to propose an idea, test it, and iterate without heavy oversight
  • Strong organization and reporting instincts — you naturally track what's working, what isn't, and why

Nice to haves:

  • Experience specifically with vendor/paid-link program management
  • Familiarity with link-swap or marketplace platforms
  • Experience building or promoting "linkable assets" (calculators, tools, badge/award campaigns) as a growth channel
  • Background in B2B media, SaaS, or content-driven organizations

Salary Statement:

This full-time position is available as either a remote or hybrid position (depending on location), with an annual salary in the range of $80,000 to $100,000 CAD. The range is a guide for the expected skills, knowledge, and experience for new hires based in Canada only. Seniority level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, and alignment with market data. This means ranges will vary for candidates based outside of Canada and/or at different seniority levels. In addition to annual salary, full-time employees are also eligible for a discretionary bonus and a comprehensive benefits package.

About Us:

We’re a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work.
Our brands cover thought leadership for executives in project management, people management, product management, tech, marketing and many others - with the goal of connecting people with knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally in the age of AI.
We got our start in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by our CEO Ben Aston. Since then, we’ve grown into an international team of 70+ creators, strategists, and innovators with a portfolio of more than 15 online publications. We enjoy an impact-driven environment that combines the agility of a startup with the creativity of an agency and the diversity of a global company.
We’ve previously ranked #30 in The Globe and Mail’s Fastest Growing Companylist as well as Deloitte'sFast 50 program, received a CMI award for Best Digital Publication for The Digital Project Manager—and we’re listed in both Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers, and Best Employers in BC!
All of this growth is driven by our commitment to our mission: In a world of evolving skills, practices, and technology, we’re creating a playbook for the future of work and empowering communities to create it with us.
Want to learn more?Watch this video to learn why the team love working at BWZ!

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

Job Description

Olsson is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Project Structural Engineer to join our Federal Engineering and Design Team, where your expertise will directly support the development of mission-critical infrastructure across the country. From military installations and VA hospitals to federal campuses and secure facilities, you’ll help shape the structural backbone of projects that serve national interests and improve lives.

This is more than a design role — it’s an opportunity to lead, collaborate, and innovate within a team that values technical excellence, client service, and community impact.

As a Project Structural Engineer, you’ll take ownership of structural design and coordination across a range of federal projects. Your day-to-day will include:

  • Lead structural engineering efforts for vertical infrastructure projects including barracks, hospitals, administrative buildings, and specialized federal facilities.
  • Perform detailed structural analysis and design of steel, concrete, masonry, and wood systems. Develop construction documents including plans, specifications, and calculations.
  • Work closely with architects, civil engineers, mechanical/electrical teams, and federal stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of structural systems.
  • Apply design standards including UFC (Unified Facilities Criteria), IBC (International Building Code), ASCE, AISC, and other federal and industry codes.
  • Support proposal writing, scope development, and participate in federal RFP responses to help grow Olsson’s federal portfolio.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, review work for quality and accuracy, and foster a collaborative learning environment.

Why Olsson?

  • Contribute to projects that serve national interests and make a difference in communities.
  • Choose from remote, hybrid, or in-office arrangements that support your lifestyle and productivity.

  • Advance your career through leadership roles, technical training, and exposure to high-profile federal clients.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $6000 - $11000 per month, negotiable based on the skills and experience being brought to the table. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level.

This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. You get principal-level scope and ownership at a growing fintech, competitive compensation, and no relocation or commute attached to it. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Principal Software Engineer to own and lead the evolution of authentication and authorization at Sezzle. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is investing in the next generation of its authentication and authorization platform, centered on a purpose-built API auth gateway and a clean set of identity and access management services. As the Principal Software Engineer leading this effort, you will own the technical vision, architecture, and migration strategy for this transformation.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Security, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with engineering teams across the organization to deliver auth capabilities that are safe, incremental to adopt, and invisible to customers. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering gateway and identity services, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates. Your work will generally focus on foundational platform capabilities, security-critical paths, and performance at the edge.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted development is a standard part of how we build, paired with the rigorous review and security discipline the auth-critical path demands. As a principal engineer, you will help set the pattern for how AI tooling is used well on security-sensitive systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the technical vision and roadmap for Sezzle’s authentication and authorization platform, including a dedicated API auth gateway and supporting identity services.
  • Architect, design, and build scalable, highly-available auth services and gateway components primarily in Golang, leveraging AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns.
  • Design and lead phased, zero-downtime migrations of auth traffic and functionality, with clear rollback and safety mechanisms at every step.
  • Establish and evolve authentication and authorization standards across the platform: OAuth2/OIDC flows, token strategy (JWT, opaque, refresh), service-to-service auth (mTLS, workload identity), and fine-grained authorization models (RBAC/ABAC/policy engines).
  • Drive consistency and scalability across a distributed microservices architecture while maintaining the performance, reliability, and latency budgets expected of an edge gateway.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure the new platform meets fintech-grade security and regulatory requirements, and champion secure-by-default patterns across engineering.
  • Establish and evolve engineering best practices for observability, security, and CI/CD across teams, with particular rigor on the auth-critical path.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own, and help lead incident response and postmortems on the auth-critical path.
  • Mentor engineers and champion a culture of learning, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver results that matter.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
  • Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in authentication and authorization systems: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT and session-based auth, token lifecycle management, and modern authorization patterns (RBAC, ABAC, policy-as-code).
  • Experience designing, building, or operating an API gateway or auth proxy at scale: whether a commercial/open-source gateway (e.g., Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, Traefik) or an in-house edge service.
  • Proven track record leading a large-scale service extraction or migration: decomposing a monolith or large legacy service into well-bounded services with zero or minimal customer impact.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.
  • Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e.g., transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, queues) and the specific challenges of high-throughput, low-latency edge services.
  • Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives across many teams.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and help teammates adopt AI-assisted workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required).

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with identity platforms and standards implementations (e.g., Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, Ory, or in-house IdPs), and familiarity with fine-grained authorization approaches (policy-as-code, relationship-based access control) as we centralize authorization over time.
  • Experience with service mesh and edge technologies (Envoy, Istio, mTLS, rate limiting, WAF integration).
  • Familiarity with threat modeling, secure design review, and common auth attack vectors (token theft, replay, CSRF, session fixation, privilege escalation).
  • Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic), especially for latency-sensitive edge services.
  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending - familiarity with financial compliance (PCI-DSS, SOC 2), credit decisioning, or transaction processing systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized microservices (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Track record of shipping commercial APIs and platform infrastructure in high-growth environments.
  • Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling engineering organizations.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country.
jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

We’re seeking a skilled a Director of Quality Assurance Engineering to join our team!
The Director of Quality Engineering owns the quality function across the full software development lifecycle — from strategy and organizational design to the technical standards that govern how software ships. This is a strategic leadership role for someone who is leading the rethinking of what quality means in an era where AI generates the majority of code, and who can build the systems, culture, and team to match.

The Ideal candidate is...

  • A leader who has a pulse on industry AI best practices and is already transforming quality for the AI-accelerated development era.
  • Someone who relishes impact through roles no longer defined by traditional QA boundaries: you operate at the intersection of platform, engineering, MLE, and product.
  • A quality advocate who can hold the bar on rigor without becoming the bottleneck on velocity.
  • A data-driven leader who develops meaningful metrics and uses them to drive decisions — not just report status.
Does this sound like the right opportunity to explore?... Lets connect!

What You’ll Do

Strategy & Leadership

  • Rethink the QA team methodologies and skillsets/training in a world where AI generates the majority of code — evaluation methodologies, coverage metrics that account for AI-generated tests, and scaling to validation of multiplying volumes of code and use cases, without proportional headcount growth.
  • Lead, grow, and inspire a high-performing team of Quality Engineers; own hiring targets, career ladders, and a high impact, innovative culture; Grow leadership muscle in your team.
  • Represent quality to executive leadership and regulators with meaningful metrics and auditable evidence; be the organizational quality gate.

Technical Quality Strategy

  • Own an AI-driven technical quality architecture: test data strategy in PHI-constrained environments, CI/CD-integrated gate design, and the automation framework philosophy across unit, integration, and end-to-end surfaces.
  • Establish release quality standards and exit criteria that balance engineering velocity with production confidence; Define defect triage and escalation protocols used across teams.
  • Partner with platform and MLE to integrate AI/LLM evaluation methodology into the delivery pipeline.
  • Deep familiarity with the test automation landscape across languages and stacks

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of software quality engineering experience, with 4+ years in a leadership role and 2+ years driving strategy and execution in an AI-accelerated development environment.
  • Track record of building or transforming a quality function at scale — org and role design, not just team management.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated tests for correctness of intent and coverage fidelity — able to distinguish tests that pass from tests that actually verify the right behavior.
  • Experience showing measurable impact with mutation testing, risk-based testing, and production observability as a continuous quality gate.
  • Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA or equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Excitement to make an impact in rewiring US healthcare!

What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings
  • FSA/HSA
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Additional health and wellness benefits and perks
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

Pay range: 225,000-245,000 + meaningful equity package

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Machinify is an employment at will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by applicable law.
