jobs.excerpt: Defuse Labs develops NEAR Intents to enable seamless cross-chain interactions in an automated world—connecting AI, services, and financial applications.
jobs.description:
Defuse Labs develops NEAR Intents to enable seamless cross-chain interactions in an automated world—connecting AI, services, and financial applications. At Defuse Labs, we design intent-driven liquidity layers where smart contracts breathe, AI transacts, and chains sync in real time. With expertise in AI, cryptography, and decentralized finance, our team is redefining how intelligent agents interact across blockchain networks.

We are looking for a technically exceptional Alpha Researcher to help build and scale Defuse's quantitative strategies and infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of market making, quantitative research, software engineering, and decentralized markets, working hands-on on systematic trading strategies, signal generation frameworks, and execution systems that power the next generation of intent-based liquidity. You will report to the Head of Alpha and work closely with protocol engineering, product, and ecosystem teams. The ideal candidate combines a strong quantitative and engineering background with hands-on trading experience and a track record of turning research into profitable production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design game theoretical models of interaction between the NEAR Intents protocol, distribution channels, market makers and the end users

  • Research, design, test, and iterate quantitative trading strategies across on-chain and cross-chain competitive markets

  • Build frameworks for signal generation, alpha discovery, and performance attribution

  • Develop systematic trading and liquidity optimization capabilities for Defuse's Alpha Platform

  • Partner closely with protocol engineering to translate research into production-grade systems

  • Develop analytical infrastructure, simulation environments, and tooling for strategy research and execution

  • Monitor market conditions, execution quality, and portfolio performance, continuously improving trading models

  • Collaborate with product and ecosystem teams to identify new market opportunities and monetization strategies

  • Contribute to metrics, reporting, and experimentation frameworks to measure strategy effectiveness and business impact

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market making, or systematic investing (7+ years for the Senior level)

  • Strong background in mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field

  • Experience developing and deploying systematic trading strategies in crypto or traditional financial markets

  • Strong programming skills (TypeScript required; Rust, Python, or Go are a plus)

  • Deep understanding of market microstructure, execution algorithms, liquidity dynamics, and risk management

  • Experience working with large datasets and building analytical pipelines

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers and protocol developers

  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to translate research into profitable strategies

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and business audiences

Nice to Have

  • Experience building alpha generation or signal discovery engines

  • Knowledge of MEV, cross-chain execution, and decentralized exchange infrastructure

  • Experience with high-frequency or low-latency trading systems

  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning techniques applied to quantitative trading

  • Experience operating market-making or liquidity provision strategies

  • Contributions to open-source quantitative or blockchain infrastructure projects

  • Experience with Apache Airflow and dbt (data build tool)

  • Basic understanding of ELT processes and how they differ from traditional ETL workflows

Recruitment Disclaimer

All personal data submitted by you as part of a job application, whether through our website, will be processed exclusively for recruitment and selection purposes. By submitting such data, you acknowledge and consent to its use for assessing your qualifications, contacting you regarding relevant opportunities, and maintaining a candidate profile for potential future openings.

For more detailed information about how your data is processed in the context of recruitment, including your rights under applicable data protection laws, please refer to our Privacy Policy, or contact us at

jobs.excerpt: Reporting to the Technical Director and serving as a member of the Technical Direction and Process Validation (TDPV) team, the Senior Process Engineer will collaborate with Process Engineers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to evaluate potential projects and opportunities involving new construction, fleet-based solutions, and the utilization of existing customer assets.
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Technical Director and serving as a member of the Technical Direction and Process Validation (TDPV) team, the Senior Process Engineer will collaborate with Process Engineers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to evaluate potential projects and opportunities involving new construction, fleet-based solutions, and the utilization of existing customer assets.

Key responsibilities include preparing detailed process design calculations; developing and reviewing Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P providing technical guidance and support to Sales and Commercial Engineering teams; conducting site and field audits of existing plants to evaluate performance and troubleshoot operational issues; and providing operational safety input to field services, engineering, and design teams.

The Technical Direction and Process Validation team works with a wide range of water and wastewater treatment technologies, including clarification, media filtration, dissolved air flotation (DAF), ultrafiltration (UF), reverse osmosis (RO), remineralization, ion exchange (IX), electro-deionization (EDI), membrane bioreactors (MBR), degasification, adsorption, and solids dewatering systems.

Pure water applications include municipal and industrial water treatment for drinking water, boiler feedwater, process makeup water, desalination, and microelectronics manufacturing. The team also supports industrial wastewater treatment applications for discharge and reuse, cooling tower makeup and blowdown, food and beverage processing, semiconductor manufacturing, and municipal and industrial wastewater treatment.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate with Sales and Commercial Engineering (CE) Teams to support opportunities including screening new opportunities during WIN reviews for regional and global projects
  • Provide technical and process support to meet Sales and Commercial Engineering team’s respective needs. Represent Veolia at customer meetings from a process perspective to answer technical questions during bid discussions and project questions.
  • Be responsible for the creation, development, and/or assessment of process design estimates and/or calculations, and block flow diagrams (BFD) and/or process flow diagrams (PFDs) for new and unique applications within the MWIS business, including but not limited to new greenfield projects, retrofit projects on existing sites, and upgrades to acquired assets.
  • Prepare P-table (Process) documentation (feedwater design basis, mass balance, process design calculations, simulations, and projections, chemical injection rates and consumption, consumables, power consumption and redundancy and sparing strategies. This information is required to be prepared in advance and in preparation for detailed process review during a P-Table meeting.
  • Participate in P-table (Process) reviews prior to proposal submission to ensure your proposed solution is capable of meeting and achieving the treatment system’s goals and product specifications over the entire duration of the contract.
  • Participate in P-Table reviews of other SME team member’s projects as a peer reviewer, as required.
  • For qualifying deals, meeting certain financial thresholds, prepare and submit P-table documentation to the Business Sustainability and Performance (BS&P) Technical Validation team to Veolia headquarters in Paris, France. Provide timely technical and process responses to the BS&P technical team as they complete their validation reviews.
  • Coach and mentor other TDPV team members, sharing your expertise, knowledge, and background in your specific subject matter area of expertise to develop and elevate the entire team’s working knowledge
  • Provide remote and/or sometimes on-site process training to field operations team members, helping them to understand a particular system’s design and how it is intended to operate and function.
  • Support lifecycle cost analysis while comparing, and contrasting, different flowsheets to arrive at the best technical and economic solution
  • Work with Sales and CE teams to apply process design strategies in order to position the company well in the early stages of project development, to increase the probability of success.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with Regional Sales Managers and Local Representatives and other Commercial Engineering teams.
  • Support new MWIS fleet asset development from a process and operational safety perspective

  • people to contribute their best
  • Recognition and rewards for your hard work and achievements
  • Opportunity for new challenges - We are growing and love to promote from within
  • An excellent leadership team and a collaborative culture that values innovation
  • At all levels of the organization, we recognize talent and want to help you build your
  • sustainable career!

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in an Engineering discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, or Environmental Engineering is preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in water & wastewater process engineering or equipment supply field, preferably with 3 -5 years of hands-on working knowledge on process equipment or in a water treatment plant environment.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in detailed process design and the ability to read and understand proposal documents and specifications, both from a technical and commercial perspective.

  • Self-motivated, quick to deliver and a team player.
  • Demonstrated dedication to safety.

Overview

Responsibilities | What you will own...

The Survey Programming team is measured on the following metrics…

  • 100% of projects are optimized for display and for analysis in Knit once we hit go in soft launch (e.g. question type, filters/cuts, HVs, etc.)

Required Skills & Experiences

Required:

Benefits

Our Company Values

jobs.excerpt: About AlphaSense: The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making.
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The User Management team owns the full identity lifecycle at AlphaSense — from creating and provisioning users, through managing their identities, to authenticating who they are and authorizing what they can do in the system. Our work spans three core domains:

  • User Management — creating, provisioning, and managing user identities
  • Authentication — verifying who users are
  • Authorization — determining what users can do in the system

We are a product platform team, not a product team: we build the identity and access infrastructure that other engineering teams build on top of, rather than shipping user-facing features ourselves. We also act as a security guardrail for AlphaSense, since identity and access sit at the center of how the platform stays secure.

The team is well-established and senior, based in Helsinki, Finland. We're now expanding into North America — with roles based in both Canada and the US — to build follow-the-sun coverage, so our customers get proper support around the clock, and to push deliberately toward a true platform model — scaling our authentication and authorization systems so they can be safely self-served by teams across the company.

About the Role:

This is a Staff Engineer role on the team that manages identity and access for AlphaSense's entire, and constantly growing, customer base, and that nearly every product engineering team depends on for user and entitlement data. You'll work across all three pillars of identity: creating and managing users, authenticating them, and authorizing what they can do — designing systems built to scale with a constantly growing number of users. Security is core to this role, not adjacent to it — you'll work closely with our security teams to make sure what we build is secure by design, in an environment governed by SOC2 and GDPR.

We're looking for a genuinely senior, self-sufficient engineer with strong experience building and operating identity, authentication, or authorization platforms at scale, ideally in a platform/product-platform engineering context. This is someone who doesn't just execute a roadmap, but helps understand the needs behind it, shapes it, and then drives execution — largely autonomously, and in close collaboration with our core team based in Helsinki. You're genuinely interested in security, comfortable partnering closely with security teams on secure-by-design systems, and comfortable working in a distributed, cross-timezone setup — based in North America, collaborating closely with a Helsinki-based team.

Who You Are:

  • Backend: Java 2X, Spring Boot 3.X.X, WebFlux, Maven
  • Data & APIs: SQL, GraphQL, gRPC, REST
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Helm
  • Identity & Security Protocols: RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC; OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and JWT; SAML 2.0 and enterprise SSO federation (assertion validation, signature/encryption handling, IdP- vs. SP-initiated flows); SCIM for user provisioning and deprovisioning
  • Engineering Practices: Event-driven architecture patterns; TDD or a genuine passion for automated testing

[Nice to Have]

  • Auth0 experience
  • SpiceDB / Zanzibar-style authorization system experience
  • Apollo Federation
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Experience operating within SOC2 and/or GDPR-compliant environments

What You’ll Do:

This role spans all three pillars of our identity platform in equal measure — this is not an authorization-only or authentication-only role.

  • Design, build, and evolve our authorization platform (RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC), enabling teams across the company to answer "what can this user do?"
  • Design, build, and evolve our authentication platform, covering authentication patterns across our range of use cases, working closely with our Auth0 integration
  • Design, build, and evolve our user management platform — creating, provisioning, and managing user identities and entitlements — supporting our entire customer base
  • Partner closely with security teams to ensure our authentication, authorization, and user management platforms are secure by design and aligned with SOC2 and GDPR requirements
  • Design and implement highly scalable systems that keep pace with a constantly growing number of users and customers
  • Help define the long-term roadmap across all three domains — authentication, authorization, and user management — not just execute against one handed to you
  • Build self-service systems and APIs (GraphQL, gRPC, REST) that make authentication, authorization, and user data consumable by product engineering teams across the company
  • Drive projects autonomously from North America while staying closely aligned with our Helsinki-based team
  • Champion strong testing, observability, and reliability practices across the platform

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

Compensation Range
$202,400—$278,300 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.description:
Staff Data Engineer

About the role

Fora is in the process of modernizing its data stack to build the foundation for agentic products and analytics. To lead this effort, we are hiring a Staff Data Engineer to build and own the platform backbone for governed reporting and trusted AI workflows.

This is a hands-on Staff IC role on a small Data & AI team. You will make strategic architecture calls—from ingestion patterns and Snowflake design to data contracts and SLAs—and then get into the weeds to build, harden, or rebuild pipelines.

We are looking for a systems thinker who understands business impact and operational burden, and who can partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, and vendors to turn fragmented source systems into trustworthy data products.

What you will own

Architecture & Strategy

  • Data platform architecture: ingestion patterns, warehouse design, environment strategy, orchestration, access governance, and reliability standards.
  • Freshness & ingestion strategy: Deciding when to use streaming versus batch based on business value, cost, and operational burden.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Partnering with Platform Engineering to ensure our data infrastructure integrates securely and reliably with core operational systems.

Execution & Reliability

  • Data Integrations: requirements → source profiling → ingestion design → QA → documentation → support.
  • Pipeline reliability: dependencies, retries, alerts, backfills, incident response, runbooks, monitoring, and support expectations.
  • Legacy migration: helping retire brittle reporting paths such as Azure Data Factory, SQL backup workflows, and other duplicate pipelines.

Governance & Quality

  • Snowflake governance: roles, permissions, service accounts, connector ownership, environment separation, performance, cost, and governance.
  • Data contracts: schema-change handling, new-field availability, upstream SLAs, source defects, and escalation paths.
  • Data observability: freshness, volume movement, nulls, duplicates, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and critical business-rule checks.
  • AI-enabled leverage: using AI and automation to accelerate debugging, documentation, pipeline scaffolding, and operational workflows.

What we are looking for

  • Deep data engineering judgment. You have designed, built, and operated production platforms, not just individual pipelines.
  • Hands-on depth. You move seamlessly from high-level architecture to writing production code, standing up CI/CD workflows, and debugging pipeline failures.
  • Strong ingestion fundamentals. APIs, CDC, backfills, idempotency, schema drift, and failure recovery.
  • Snowflake fluency. Warehouse design, RBAC, performance tuning, and cost controls.
  • Data quality discipline. You know which checks matter and make quality visible before users find issues.
  • Ownership & communication. You can sequence ambiguous work, write useful design docs, align technical decisions with business outcomes, and carry problems to resolution.
  • Cross-functional partnership. You work with stakeholders across Engineering, Analytics, and the business to understand needs, define clear requirements, and build trust.
  • AI leverage. You use LLMs and agents to accelerate your own work, and you build data products that agents can consume safely.

Nice to have

  • Lending, fintech, or financial-services data experience.
  • CDC, Debezium, dbt Cloud, Dagster, Airflow, or equivalent tooling.
  • Fluency with Azure data services such as Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, and Azure DevOps.
  • Data observability with Monte Carlo, Elementary, dbt tests, custom monitors, or similar.
  • Data contracts, source SLAs, or schema-change processes with Engineering teams.
  • AI-native analytics, semantic layers, MCP servers, agentic orchestration, or governed context retrieval.
  • Familiarity with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg.

Compensation and logistics

  • Base salary: $175,000–$200,000
  • Fully remote within the US; Eastern or Central time zones preferred.
  • Reports to the VP of Data & AI.
  • Final compensation is based on scope of past ownership, technical judgment, and ability to set direction independently.

Benefits of working at Fora Financial

  • Company-subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Life insurance at no cost to employees.
  • Generous time off plan, including rollover vacation days.
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts.
  • Commuter benefits.
  • Remote working model.
  • Weekly breakfast, snacks, and Friday lunches provided onsite.

About Fora Financial

Fora Financial is a technology-enabled provider of flexible financing to small and medium-sized businesses. Since 2008, we have supported more than 55,000 merchants nationwide with over $4 billion in capital for operating expenses, cash-flow management, and growth.

Our proprietary technology helps deliver capital through a streamlined process that can be completed in as little as 24 hours, compared with the weeks or months often required for a traditional bank loan. Fora has grown from two founders in a small Manhattan workspace to a company of nearly 200 employees with a collaborative, partner-centric culture.

jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

Antora is hiring a Director of Grid Policy to lead regional and state-level regulatory advocacy on transmission, interconnection, and resource adequacy issues that are critical to the commercial success of Antora's long-duration storage and 24/7 energy products. This person will manage high-level negotiations and policy advocacy with RTOs, public utility commissions, and state legislatures, partnering closely with Antora's policy team and the energy commercial team (led by the Director of Energy) to ensure Antora's technology receives accurate, favorable regulatory treatment as the company scales into new products, states, and RTOs.

Roles & Responsibilities
  • Lead advocacy and stakeholder/regulator negotiations on transmission interconnection, resource adequacy, ELCC, microgrid, and long-duration storage policy issues across multiple RTOs and states.
  • Represent Antora in RTO stakeholder processes, FERC proceedings, and state PUC/legislative engagements (e.g., SPP, CAISO, and other RTOs as Antora expands).
  • Partner with the energy commercial team to ensure Antora's storage and 24/7 energy products are accurately valued (RA/ELCC) so customers receive full value and are willing to pay accordingly.
  • Develop and drive policy proposals in coordination with other clean energy stakeholders, building coalitions where interests align.
  • Track and respond to relevant FERC rulemakings/orders (e.g., large-load interconnection 205 orders) and state proceedings (e.g., SB 943 in California).
  • Collaborate with and support the head of regulatory and state affairs, who will remain engaged across these issues as the portfolio scales.
Key Qualifications
  • 8–12+ years of specific experience in transmission, interconnection, and/or resource adequacy policy
  • Demonstrated experience leading advocacy in an RTO, ISO, or FERC proceeding.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills tailored to political, regulatory, and policymaker audiences.
Additional Qualifications Desired
  • Experience with storage procurement and resource adequacy or ELCC proceedings in any jurisdiction.
  • Familiarity with long-duration energy storage procurement policy design.

Work Location: Remote, US

Salary Range: $213,000 USD - $255,000 USD

Salary Basis: Annual

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

    • Collaborate with Sales to craft competitive proposals and win business without compromising profitability

    • Analyze risk factors and make informed, data-driven decisions—balancing risk tolerance with growth goals

jobs.description:
Clinical Pharmacist

Job Purpose:

Provide integrated support to patients and physicians by providing a "hands-on" approach to improve the quality of patient care. This is accomplished by developing personalized relationships with patients and prescribers to improve medication adherence and promote evidence-based care.

Job Duties:

  • Reviewing and interpreting clinician's patient care note/assessments for supportive clinical data needed for prior authorization approvals and development of care plan recommendations.
  • Develop and refine disease and drug specific clinical protocol to maximize patient adherence and promote evidence-based cost-effective care.
  • Monitor on-going patient adherence (PDC reports, patient assessment data, and mobile platform data) across all sites and disease categories with focus on oncology and other specialty specific disease states.
  • Evaluation of EMR to review: drug and disease interaction, medication selection, labs/vitals, allergies, RX orders/renewals and direct MD communication, and other relevant information important to maximize medication adherence and optimize patient outcomes.
  • Recommending alternative therapeutic drug regimens and disease specific treatments according to guidelines as appropriate.
  • Monitor and evaluate therapies for side effects or other medication related issues, recommend drug therapy changes to prescribers as appropriate.
  • Medication therapy management (MTM): including reviewing and monitoring of medication regimens, advising clinicians on evidence based therapy as indicated, documenting interventions; assessing patient adherence rates.
  • Clinical interventions including but are not limited to comprehensive pharmacist consultation, motivational interviewing/coaching, drug regimen optimization, medication reconciliation, medication lists or reminders, medication synchronization, coordinate home nurse visits, transitions between liaison/PSC, use of mobile app or other technologies.
  • Productivity monitoring and reporting weekly stats for growth development
  • Overseeing tech's daily activities and verification for accuracy on: delivery coordination slips, prior authorizations submitted, ongoing PA log activity and proactive management care utilization within each specialty as per protocol.
  • Identifying and resolving insurance related issues, recognizing situations where financial assistance can be applied.
  • Supervising communication of support personnel compliant with HIPPA rules and regulations;
  • Maintaining current registration and all remote pharmacist activity to comply with local, state and federal drug laws as regulated by each state board of pharmacy and the DEA.
  • Direct communication with other health professionals as necessary regarding patient care;
  • Develops own knowledge by participating in education programs; training pharmacy staff, students, interns, externs, and health care professionals;
  • Manage, organize, and update relevant data using database applications;
  • Apply observations and recommendations to operational issues, increased productivity, quality, and customer-service standards;
  • Assist with research projects and peer reviewing articles as needed.
  • Identify trends, resolves problems; recommend improvements; implements change;
  • Actively participates in process improvement initiatives;
  • Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential;
  • Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations;
  • Willing to do whatever is necessary for the betterment of the Company;
  • Other duties as assigned;

Skills: Analyze information, exercise good judgment, possess strong verbal and written communication skills, have deep knowledge of specialty medication pharmacology, local/state/federal pharmacy regulations, able to manage processes, exhibit strong technical and clinical skills, excellent leader and manager of people, constant focus on legal compliance, highly productive, quality focused and attention to detail. Must be computer literate with proficiency and working knowledge of database and reporting tools such as: Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.(***Knowledge using EPIC/QS1/WILLOW software a plus***) Must have the ability to identify barriers to medication adherence and implement and monitor plans to improve medication adherence. The ability to motivate and coach patients to help them achieve better outcomes and identify goals of therapy.

Traits: Organized, high-integrity, attention to detail, dependable, quality focus, empathetic, good listener/communicator

Other: Energetic, highly motivated, team player with strong personal and communication skills; discretion and confidentiality essential as position deals with highly sensitive and private data

Specialties: Knowledge of complex/chronic diseases states and therapies used within specialty pharmacy: Oncology, Transplant, Hepatitis C, Infectious Disease (including HIV), Multiple Sclerosis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, GI disorders (including IBD), Cystic Fibrosis, Psoriasis, Hyperlipidemia and many various inflammatory conditions (including Lupus) preferred.

Experience/ Education:

Required Licensure/Certification: Applicant must hold a Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or equivalent advanced degree and be a licensed Pharmacist

Years of Experience: 1+ years' experience is strongly preferred but not required. Should additional licensure need to be obtained, the applicant will commit to obtaining the required licensure within a mutually agreed upon timeframe. Continued employment is contingent upon meeting these requirements.

Education: PharmD or equivalent advanced degree required

Job Salary:An employee in this position can expect a salary rate between $122,000 and $128,000 plus bonus pursuant to the terms of any bonus plan if applicable. The actual salary will depend on experience, seniority, geographic location, and other factors permitted by law

You

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you lead the frontend implementation of Seed's digital experience. Build and Ship

  • Partner early with Design and Product to assess feasibility and resolve ambiguity.

Contribute to the Design System

  • Build composable, reusable React components into our shared library, following its architecture, APIs, and documentation standards.
  • Use design tokens and theming consistently so that a component built once is available everywhere.
  • Document what you add via usage guidelines, code examples, and Storybook stories.

Raise the Bar

  • Conduct thoughtful code reviews that hold the squad to a high standard in component design, accessibility, and visual fidelity.
  • Mentor engineers on the team through pairing.
  • Champion consistent use of the shared component library across our web applications.

Skills You Bring

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level React and Next.js (TypeScript required).
  • Strong understanding of design systems, design tokens, and component API design.
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, data fetching, rendering performance (Core Web Vitals), and testing.
  • Comfortable working from Figma designs and specs.
  • Experience with Storybook and at least one of CSS-in-JS, CSS Modules, or Tailwind CSS.
  • Working knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG).

Collaboration

  • Clear communicator; able to articulate design and technical trade-offs to engineering, design, and product partners.
  • Comfortable building within an architecture someone else owns while still bringing an independent point of view.
  • Experience giving and receiving constructive feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience translating motion design concepts into production-ready animations (Framer Motion, GSAP).
  • Experience in high-growth DTC or e-commerce companies, ideally on a headless Shopify stack.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar).
  • Knowledge of A/B testing frameworks and experimentation methodologies.
  • Background in health, wellness, or science-focused consumer brands.
  • Experience at a consumer brand known for design craft and obsessive attention to detail.

Enjoy access to top-tier virtual care and a complimentary Aaptiv membership for fitness and mental wellness. We also provide an HSA with employer contributions, along with Fullscript discounts for supplements.

Mental Health Support: All employees and eligible dependents receive 12 free therapy sessions per year, plus coaching, meditation, and 24/7 access to Spring Health’s digital tools and care navigation.

Long Term Wealth Planning: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan through Betterment, featuring a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of contributions—fully vested from day one.

Supporting Families: Our Parental Leave Policy includes 18 weeks of fully paid leave, with the flexibility to phase your return. We also offer four weeks of paid transition time at 80% capacity or four days per week.

Time to Recharge: Seed offers 15 vacation days, 7 sick/safe days, 2 personal days, 10 Recharge Days (Summer + Winter), and 15 paid company holidays each year.

Work Flexibly: Thrive in a remote-first culture that prioritizes autonomy and clarity. You’ll also receive a $750 one-time remote work setup stipend and ongoing access to a $450 quarterly wellness and workplace stipends via JOON.

And More: Access pet insurance, life and disability coverage, learning & development, and a vibrant culture rooted in science and impact.

Administrative Assistant

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and customer-focused Administrative Assistant to support lead intake, customer outreach, appointment scheduling, and CRM management.

This role is highly focused on keeping the lead pipeline organized and moving. You’ll communicate with prospective customers, schedule appointments for the sales representative, maintain accurate CRM records, and help ensure leadership has a clear view of pipeline performance.

What You’ll Own

Lead Intake & Management

  • Receive and accurately log incoming leads.
  • Ensure every new inquiry is captured in the CRM promptly and without gaps.
  • Maintain complete and accurate lead records.

Lead Outreach & Scheduling

  • Call prospective customers to understand and qualify their needs.
  • Answer initial questions and introduce the company professionally.
  • Book appointments for the sales representative to visit customers and present estimates.

CRM Workflow Management

  • Move leads through each stage of the pipeline consistently.
  • Keep lead statuses current and accurate.
  • Maintain CRM data so the team can track set rate, close rate, and other key metrics in real time.

Customer Communication

  • Serve as a professional and knowledgeable first point of contact.
  • Answer customer questions and set appropriate expectations.
  • Represent the company positively on every call.

Reporting Support

  • Keep records clean, organized, and up to date.
  • Support leadership in pulling accurate pipeline data.
  • Help identify where leads are converting or falling off.

Process Adherence

  • Learn and consistently follow the company's established workflow.
  • Identify and flag bottlenecks in the process.
  • Help maintain consistency across daily operations.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 1–2 years of experience in an administrative, customer-facing, or operations support role.
  • Familiarity with CRM software and managing contacts, deal stages, and records.
  • Experience in painting, residential or commercial construction, or another home service trade is a strong plus.
  • Clear and confident spoken English.
  • Comfortable communicating with homeowners and prospective customers by phone.
  • Strong organizational habits and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple active leads simultaneously.
  • Ability to learn new workflows quickly and apply them consistently without close supervision.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of your pipeline and proactively follow up when leads go cold.
  • You communicate proactively when something is unclear or a process breaks down.
  • You are comfortable on the phone and can adapt your communication style to different customers.
  • You bring structure to a busy day and can prioritize a full call list effectively.
  • You keep CRM records organized and consistently up to date.
  • You can work independently while staying reachable for important questions and decisions.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every incoming lead is captured accurately and promptly.
  • Prospective customers are contacted and qualified consistently.
  • Appointments are booked efficiently for the sales representative.
  • CRM stages accurately reflect the current status of every lead.
  • Follow-ups happen consistently without leads being overlooked.
  • Leadership has reliable pipeline data for tracking set rates, close rates, and lead conversion.
  • Processes are followed consistently and bottlenecks are identified early.
  • Customers receive a professional and positive experience throughout the initial interaction.

Typical Day

Your day starts by reviewing new leads that came in overnight and making sure each one is properly logged.

You’ll work through a call list, reaching out to prospective customers to introduce the company, answer initial questions, qualify their needs, and schedule appointments for the sales representative.

Throughout the day, you’ll update the CRM as each lead progresses, ensuring stages reflect reality and the pipeline data remains accurate.

You’ll also check on leads that are pending follow-up, re-engage where needed, and keep the schedule organized.

Most of your work is async and self-directed, but you’ll stay reachable for quick questions and proactively flag anything that requires a decision from leadership.

At PicnicCare, we are transforming healthcare by bridging the gap between patient needs and clinical services through our unique integration with PicnicHealth. We empower patients by giving them control of their health data and enhancing care coordination with personalized insights. Leveraging cutting-edge technology, real-time access to comprehensive medical records, and a dedicated clinical team, we ensure patients receive proactive, personalized care. Our platform provides clear, actionable insights to help patients and their care teams make informed decisions, addressing care gaps and improving outcomes. We are building a world where healthcare is not only data-driven but deeply personalized and where every patient is empowered to be their own best advocate.

Role Overview:

PicnicCare is actively expanding its clinical team and recruiting multi-state licensed Registered Nurses (RNs) to support our growing Virtual Clinic. As an RN, you will collaborate with healthcare providers and assist patients in navigating their care journeys, addressing health concerns, and helping ensure seamless access to the resources they need for better health outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work in a flexible, tech-forward environment and contribute to developing innovative care solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support patient care by providing expert guidance, answering health-related questions, and facilitating care follow-ups
  • Collaborate with the Virtual Care team to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care
  • Assist in care coordination between patients and healthcare providers
  • Educate patients on care plans, treatments, and preventive health practices
  • Ensure compliance with multi-state regulations and maintain updated licenses
  • Utilize technology to provide efficient and empathetic remote care

Qualifications:

  • Active RN license in multiple states
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical experience (telehealth experience a plus)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a face-paced, remote environment
  • Proficient with a range of EHR systems and documentation requirements
  • Committed to providing high quality, non-judgemental care to our patients
  • Compassionate, patient-first approach to care

We expect all team members to be motivated to be amazing in their roles and, ultimately, to move the PicnicCare mission forward.

This is an independent contractor position.

Equal Opportunity Statement

PicnicHealth is committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value a diverse and balanced team where everyone can belong.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior Embedded / Firmware Engineer(RTOS, komunikacja, systemy krytyczne, secure embedded systems) Zakres obowiązkówTo nie jest typowa rola embedded.
jobs.description:
Senior Embedded / Firmware Engineer

(RTOS, komunikacja, systemy krytyczne, secure embedded systems)

Zakres obowiązków

To nie jest typowa rola embedded. To projektowanie systemów, deterministyczna komunikacja, real-time oraz odpowiedzialność za kluczowe elementy produktu.

Będziesz pracować od niskopoziomowego firmware po komunikację z backendem.

W praktyce oznacza to:

  • Rozwój firmware dla komponentów bezpieczeństwa oraz modułów komunikacyjnych

  • Projektowanie i usprawnianie komunikacji między dwoma MCU

  • Praca z logiką czasu rzeczywistego, maszynami stanów i obsługą błędów

  • Tworzenie i utrzymanie sterowników sprzętowych (UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO)

  • Projektowanie i rozwój systemów komunikacji bezprzewodowej (BLE onboarding, provisioning, data exchange)

  • Zapewnienie stabilnej komunikacji z backendem poprzez OCPP over WebSocket (lub podobne protokoły device-cloud)

  • Praca nad OTA i odpornością systemu w środowisku produkcyjnym (rollback, recovery, bezpieczeństwo aktualizacji)

  • Niskopoziomowe debugowanie z użyciem profesjonalnych narzędzi (JTAG, SWD, analizatory logiczne itp.)

  • Projektowanie API i warstw komunikacyjnych pomiędzy modułami systemu

Technologia i architektura

System składa się z dwóch głównych jednostek:

  • Kontroler bezpieczeństwa / mocy: nRF5340 lub podobny MCU klasy low-power (RTOS / embedded firmware)

  • Kontroler komunikacji / aplikacji: i.MX RT1061 lub podobny MCU klasy application-grade (RTOS / embedded Linux optional)

MCU komunikują się poprzez autorski protokół zaprojektowany pod kątem deterministyczności i spójności.

Komunikacja z backendem realizowana jest w oparciu o protokół typu OCPP over WebSocket lub równoważny protokół device-cloud.

Wymagania

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość C/C++ w systemach embedded

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z MCU (np. STM32, nRF, ESP32 lub podobne)

  • Znajomość protokołów komunikacyjnych: UART, SPI, I2C oraz BLE (lub inne wireless)

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu systemów embedded (architektura, nie tylko implementacja)

  • Umiejętność debugowania systemów HW/SW (JTAG, SWD, logi systemowe)

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu interfejsów i API pomiędzy komponentami systemu

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w secure embedded systems (device identity, secure update concepts, integrity, tamper resistance)

  • Doświadczenie z OTA / bootloaderami (rollback, recovery, update safety)

  • Znajomość systemów RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr lub inne)

  • Doświadczenie z komunikacją device ↔ backend (WebSocket, MQTT, REST)

  • Automotive / industrial embedded background

  • Znajomość systemów provisioning / fleet management / BLE onboarding

Nice-to-have (ale nie wymagane)

  • Doświadczenie z OCPP

  • Zephyr RTOS

  • Embedded Linux (Buildroot / Yocto)

Warunki pracy

  • 100% praca zdalna - możesz pracować z dowolnego miejsca

  • B2B: do 8 000 EUR netto miesięcznie

  • Elastyczne godziny pracy

  • Współpraca z doświadczonym zespołem system/firmware

  • Realny wpływ na architekturę i kierunek rozwoju produktu

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: CallMiner is seeking a strong B2B content marketer and writer to develop compelling content that supports the company’s global demand generation programs and broader marketing strategy.
jobs.description:
CallMiner is seeking a strong B2B content marketer and writer to develop compelling content that supports the company’s global demand generation programs and broader marketing strategy. Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Demand Generation & Marketing, this role will work closely with the wider Demand Generation team, Events and Webinars team, external social media agency, subject matter experts and other teams across Marketing.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn complex technology, AI and customer experience topics into clear, engaging content for different audiences and channels. The successful candidate will be an exceptional writer who understands how content contributes to campaign engagement, lead generation and pipeline. They must be comfortable using AI as a collaborative tool to support research, ideation, repurposing and optimization, while applying their own expertise, judgment and editorial skills to ensure the final content is accurate, differentiated and distinctly human.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, optimize and repurpose content that supports global demand generation campaigns, thought leadership, events, webinars, social media and the wider buyer journey.
  • Collaborate with teams across Marketing and internal subject matter experts to translate business priorities, customer insights and campaign themes into compelling content that drives audience engagement, lead generation and pipeline.
  • Coordinate external content partners, including CallMiner’s freelance writer and social media agency, by setting clear briefs and priorities and ensuring consistent quality, messaging and brand alignment.
  • Use AI responsibly to support research, ideation, optimization and repurposing, while bringing strong independent judgment, original thinking and meaningful editorial oversight to all work.
  • Maintain a consistent and distinctive brand voice, applying SEO, AEO and GEO principles where appropriate to improve content visibility and performance.
  • Manage multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines effectively, using available performance data to identify insights and improve future content.

Requirements

Requirements & Preferred Qualifications

  • 4 + years of content marketing, copywriting or editorial experience, including significant experience within B2B technology or SaaS.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to turn complex technology, AI and customer experience topics into clear, credible and engaging content across multiple formats and channels.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, English or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating long-form and short-form B2B technology writing across several channels and content formats.
  • Experience writing about artificial intelligence, customer experience, contact center technology, enterprise software, analytics or related technology topics is a strong advantage.
  • Experience working with external writers, freelancers, agencies or other content partners.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation, project management, content management and collaboration platforms.
  • A working understanding of demand generation, buyer journeys, account-based marketing and how content supports marketing and sales outcomes.
  • Strong interviewing and research skills, with the confidence to work directly with senior leaders and subject matter experts.
  • Naturally collaborative, highly organized and comfortable taking ownership of work from initial brief through to final delivery.
  • Curious, adaptable and motivated to grow into broader content strategy and campaign responsibilities over time.

Candidate Portfolio & Writing Exercise

As part of the interview process, shortlisted candidates will be asked to provide a portfolio of at least three relevant B2B writing samples that demonstrate range and versatility. Ideally, samples will include:

  • One long-form asset, such as a whitepaper, report, eBook, or similar content
  • One blog or thought leadership article
  • One promotional or demand-generation example, such as an email campaign, webinar abstract, or event description

Final candidates may also be asked to complete a brief writing or editing exercise relevant to the role

Benefits

About CallMiner

Does the possibility of using artificial intelligence to improve human connection excite you? We agree! CallMiner is the global leader in AI-powered conversation intelligence and customer experience (CX) automation. Our captures and analyzes 100% of omnichannel customer interactions delivering the insights organizations need to improve CX, enhance agent performance, and drive automation at scale. By combining advanced AI, industry-leading analytics, and real-time conversation intelligence, we empower organizations to uncover customer needs, optimize processes, and automate workflows and interactions. The result: higher customer satisfaction, reduced operational costs, and faster, data-driven decisions. Trusted by leading brands in technology, media & telecom, retail, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, and travel & hospitality, we help organizations transform customer insights into action

CallMiner's core set of values – from teamwork and ownership to success and joy – serve as a touchstone for what we strive to create in a workplace culture and weave through everything we do as a company. We believe that by building a team of brilliant, inspired people, we can truly accomplish amazing things together. We are committed to providing an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone feels accepted, valued, and understood. Our strong commitment to a positive workplace has earned us the recognition of a 2021 & 2022, 2024 and 2025 Top Place to Work by the Boston Globe and a 2022 Top Workplace USA by Energage.

Benefits + Perks
At CallMiner, we believe having a work-life balance is key to being able to deliver your best every day. We strive to offer a well-rounded and generous benefits package designed to provide the coverage options and flexibility to meet both individual and family needs. This includes quality medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, reimbursement programs for both fitness and tuition, 401k matching, generous PTO including an annual volunteer day, paid maternity and parental leave, and more.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, ancestry, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

W B3 uwalniamy potencjał firm dzięki outsourcingowi IT w unikatowym, skandynawskim modelu, a naszą długofalową wizją jest uczynienie z Polski wiodącego centrum innowacji cyfrowych w Europie. To wszystko robimy w duchu "Care" - skupiamy się na zrozumieniu potrzeb konsultantów , dopasowaniu ich do optymalnych dla nich projektów i otoczeniu ich odpowiednią troską. Energia, logika i doświadczenie - tym właśnie kierujemy się na co dzień.

Szukamy doświadczonego Backend Engineera, który lubi pracować przy realnych systemach produkcyjnych, gdzie liczy się nie tylko dowożenie feature’ów, ale również wydajność, skalowalność, stabilność i bezpieczeństwo.

W tym projekcie backend developer odpowiada za cały cykl życia rozwiązania — od implementacji, przez deployment, aż po działanie systemu na produkcji.

To środowisko dla osób, które chcą rozwijać się jakosoftware engineers, a nie tylko implementować zadania z backlogu.

Jeśli ceniszrealne problemy techniczne, odpowiedzialność za produkcję i współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem, będzie to dla Ciebie bardzo dobre miejsce.

Start: maj 2026 rok.

✨ Twoja rola

Senior w tym projekcie nie jest tylko wykonawcą zadań. Oczekujemy realnego wpływu na rozwój systemu i standardów pracy.

W szczególności:

  • ownership nad rozwiązaniami technicznymi

  • prowadzenie decyzji technicznych i tworzenie ADR (Architecture Decision Records)

  • dekompozycja zadań i wsparcie zespołu w planowaniu pracy

  • mentoring i podnoszenie jakości kodu

  • współpraca zProduct Ownerami i interesariuszami

  • szacowanie prac i identyfikowanie ryzyk

  • proaktywne identyfikowaniedługu technicznego i obszarów do poprawy niezawodności systemu

Będziesz pracować nad backendem w środowisku JVM oraz systemami działającymi w infrastrukturze kontenerowej.

Twoja praca obejmuje m.in:

  • rozwój backendu wKotlin / Spring Boot

  • projektowanie i rozwijanie systemów działających w Kubernetes

  • pracę z pipeline’amiCI/CD i praktykami GitOps

  • dbanie owydajność i stabilność usług

  • rozwiązywanie problemów produkcyjnych i analizę incydentów

  • rozwijanie standardów jakości kodu, testów i bezpieczeństwa

W skrócie:you build it, you run it.

✨ Czego potrzebujesz by odnieść sukces? (must have)

Backend / JVM:

  • bardzo dobra znajomość Kotlin lub Java (JVM)

  • doświadczenie produkcyjne w Spring Boot

  • umiejętnośćdebugowania i profilowania JVM

Infrastruktura i delivery:

  • doświadczenie w pracy z Kubernetes lub innym orchestrator workloadów

  • praktyczna znajomość CI/CD

Szczególnie cenimy doświadczenie z:

  • GitLab CI

  • Argo / ArgoCD

  • Helm

  • GitOps

  • strategie deploymentów (canary, blue-green)

Bazy danych

  • dobra znajomośćrelacyjnych baz danych

  • rozumienie modelowania danych i pracy z zapytaniami w systemach produkcyjnych

Security

znajomość standardów bezpieczeństwa aplikacji:

  • OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML

  • JWT

  • zarządzanie rolami i autoryzacją

  • dobre praktyki OWASP

  • doświadczenie z bezpiecznym przechowywaniem sekretów (np. Vault, KMS)

Testowanie

  • bardzo dobra znajomość testów automatycznych

  • umiejętność testowania kodu w nowoczesnym środowisku developmentu (w tym pracy z AI tools)

✨ On-call i odpowiedzialność za produkcję

Zespół pracuje w modelu on-call (PagerDuty).

Oznacza to udział w dyżurach produkcyjnych, reagowanie na alerty oraz analizę incydentów. Dzięki temu developerzy mają pełny wgląd w działanie systemu i realny wpływ na jego stabilność.

Najlepiej odnajdzie się tutaj osoba, która:

  • lubidiagnozować problemy i optymalizować systemy

  • czuje się komfortowo pracując blisko infrastruktury

  • bierze odpowiedzialność za jakość rozwiązań

✨ Na pokładzie B3 znajdziesz/otrzymasz:

Sales Account Executive (B2B Sales)

Full-Cycle Sales | Account Executive | Business Development | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica, Brazil
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Account Executive to own the complete B2B sales cycle—from generating new business opportunities to negotiating contracts, closing deals, and building long-term client relationships.

This is a true full-cycle sales role where you’ll work directly with business owners, executives, and key decision-makers to understand their challenges, present tailored solutions, and drive measurable revenue growth.

If you’re motivated by hitting quotas, closing deals, and owning your sales pipeline from start to finish, this is an excellent opportunity to join a high-performing, growth-focused team.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle Sales

  • Own the entire sales process from prospecting through deal closure.
  • Generate new business through outbound outreach and inbound lead follow-up.
  • Conduct discovery calls to identify client needs, goals, and challenges.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and sales presentations.
  • Build customized proposals aligned with customer objectives.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Relationship Management

  • Build strong relationships with business owners, executives, and decision-makers.
  • Develop trust through consultative, value-driven sales conversations.
  • Maintain professional relationships throughout the sales process.
  • Ensure a seamless transition to onboarding following deal closure.
  • Represent the company with professionalism and integrity.

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Accurately manage opportunities through every sales stage.
  • Keep CRM records current and organized.
  • Track:
    • Pipeline health
    • Forecast accuracy
    • Deal progression
    • Conversion rates
  • Identify opportunities to improve win rates and sales efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Success, Operations, and Leadership teams.
  • Ensure smooth onboarding and client handoffs.
  • Share customer feedback and market insights internally.
  • Contribute ideas to improve sales messaging and positioning.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in:
    • B2B Sales
    • Account Executive
    • Business Development
    • Full-Cycle Sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
  • Demonstrated success closing new business and driving revenue growth.
  • Experience managing the complete sales cycle independently.

Core Skills

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong consultative selling and relationship-building abilities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar systems.
  • Strong pipeline management and forecasting skills.
  • Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote sales environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience selling SaaS, professional services, or B2B solutions.
  • Experience selling into SMB or mid-market organizations.
  • Experience mentoring SDRs or junior sales representatives.
  • Strong sales forecasting and reporting experience.
  • Stable career progression within sales-focused roles.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Competitive and results-driven mindset.
  • Strong closer with exceptional relationship-building skills.
  • High ownership and accountability.
  • Consultative sales approach focused on solving customer challenges.
  • Comfortable managing multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated and thrives in performance-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Prospect new business opportunities and follow up with qualified leads.
  • Conduct discovery calls and product demonstrations.
  • Present tailored solutions to prospective clients.
  • Negotiate pricing and close new business.
  • Update CRM records and manage pipeline activity.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful client onboarding.
  • Review sales performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

In short: You own the complete sales cycle, build lasting client relationships, and consistently generate revenue by closing high-quality B2B opportunities.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Monthly and quarterly revenue attainment.
  • Lead-to-close conversion rate.
  • Pipeline health and deal velocity.
  • Forecast accuracy.
  • CRM accuracy and reporting consistency.
  • Client retention and satisfaction.
  • Consistent quota achievement.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Full ownership of the complete sales cycle.
  • Opportunity to work directly with executive-level decision-makers.
  • High-impact role with direct influence on company growth.
  • Collaborative, high-performance sales culture.
  • Clear career progression into Senior Account Executive, Sales Manager, or Revenue Leadership roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a driven Sales Account Executive who enjoys building relationships, managing the full sales cycle, and consistently closing new business, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and take ownership of revenue growth while advancing your B2B sales career.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

PatientIQ is the leading outcomes intelligence platform for healthcare — purpose-built to help health systems, specialty practices, medical device companies, and medical societies collect, analyze, and act on patient-reported outcomes data at scale. Our platform — ClinicalPRO, ResearchPRO, and DataPRO — powers clinical research, post-market surveillance, registry management, and value-based care programs across hundreds of provider organizations and some of the largest device manufacturers in the world.

ABOUT THE ROLE

PatientIQ is hiring its first VP of Customer Growth — a revenue-generating commercial leader who will own net revenue retention, expansion ARR, and the strategic account program across our full customer base. This is not a traditional CS role. The VP Customer Growth carries expansion quota, builds a CS-as-revenue model, and leads a team that includes Customer Success-Enterprise, Outcomes Research & Registries, and Customer Success-Specialty Practice. The incoming leader will inherit a strong team, a clear structure, and a commercially ambitious mandate: grow NRR to 120%+ while protecting and expanding relationships with some of the most consequential health systems and specialty practices in the country.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

jobs.description:
Managing Consultant, MarTech (EMEA)

Location: Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

Clients: Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

Employment: Full time contractor, engaged directly. This is our standard outside the US.

Reports to: VP of Solutions

Salary Range: $70,000 - $125,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission

Own client engagements end to end. Hold the relationship, set the strategy, design the solution, and deliver it with a team you direct. Grow the accounts you hold and help win the next ones.

Why this role exists

This is a player-coach hybrid. Splitting a senior consultant into a strategist and a technical lead costs more than it saves, and the accounts that need both do not respect the split anyway.

This person is credible in a CMO's office and credible in a CDP workspace. They present a roadmap on Tuesday and debug identity resolution on Wednesday.

Three problems this role solves:

  1. Clients get relationship coverage and technical coverage from different people, and outside North America, at the wrong hour.
  2. Expansion happens late, because the person who sees the opportunity cannot price it.
  3. Pre-sales competes with delivery for the same few senior people.

Responsibilities

Account ownership

  • Own the relationship. You are the primary contact and the person an executive calls when they are unhappy.
  • Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews.
  • Keep three or more months of planned work on the roadmap for every account.
  • Protect the budget. Flag pacing, overages, and under-use as soon as the trend appears.

Strategy

  • Find where the client's revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Tie every recommendation to a metric and a business outcome.
  • Build growth roadmaps with the client, not at them.
  • Show what moving to a stage of maturity is worth to them.

Technical leadership and hands-on work

  • Design the stack architecture: CDP, analytics, lifecycle messaging, warehouse, and the integrations between them.
  • Do the strategic hands-on work yourself: taxonomy design, measurement plans, attribution modeling, segmentation logic, QA of critical builds.
  • Direct engineers and contract developers. Review their work before it reaches the client.
  • Delegate on purpose. Your time is worth more on strategy than on tag deployment. Know where that line sits on each account.

New business

  • Supports some pre-sales discovery to identify opportunities and needs.
  • Build the proposal: scope, phasing, level of effort, and the business case. Present it live. We do not send proposals cold.
  • Price work so it stays profitable. An accurate estimate beats a heroic recovery in month four.
  • Support the Sales team through the close, and take the account into delivery where it makes sense.

Commercial

  • Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
  • Drive expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on it.

Skills and experience

Required

  • Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
  • 8+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 4 owning client relationships directly.
  • Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth. You can tell a client which stage is costing them money, and why.
  • Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
  • Advise on the systems below, not just use them. Which tool fits, how the pieces connect, what each costs to run badly, and how to get more from what a client already owns. High-level familiarity is not enough here.
  • Review a funnel report, a cohort, and an attribution model, and challenge what they claim.
  • Track record retaining and growing accounts, with numbers you can describe.
  • Pre-sales experience: discovery, scoping, and proposals you then delivered against.
  • GDPR and consent handled as part of the work.

Systems. Depth in at least three groups, working familiarity with the rest.

  • Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
  • Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
  • Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
  • Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
  • Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
  • CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
  • Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

Preferred

  • Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
  • Engagements across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
  • Work across both European and North American clients.

What you get out of this

  • Many stacks in a year instead of one stack in five. Different industries, scale, and failure modes.
  • The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You build on the new pattern.
  • We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. You see how it all fits together, which is where the hard problems are visible.
  • You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
  • Both the European and North American markets from one seat.

Observable indicators

Month 2

  • Onboarded onto your accounts and current on every tool in their stacks.
  • Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
  • Every account has a current-state assessment and named client objectives.

Month 4

  • Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, scope conversations.
  • Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
  • Zero undocumented scope changes.
  • Labor efficiency ratio of 2.5 or better across your portfolio.
  • Contributing scope and estimates to proposals.

Month 6

  • 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
  • Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
  • Labor efficiency ratio of 3.0 across your portfolio.
  • Running discovery and writing proposals end to end.

Month 9

  • 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
  • One account expanded in scope or revenue, sourced and priced by you.
  • Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.

What this role is not

  • Not a pure strategy seat. You will be in the tools. If you have not touched an implementation in three years, this will not go well.
  • Not a pure technical seat. About half your week is relationship, strategy, and commercial work.
  • Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write proposals, own expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
  • Not a management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Direct reports come later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values

  • Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
  • Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
  • Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
  • Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
  • Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits

Engaged as a full time contractor. These follow our current international contractor terms.

  • Flexible PTO
  • Flexible hours
  • Work remotely
  • Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
  • Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
  • National holidays off.
  • Radically transparent workplace
  • Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

Month 1. Learn our clients, cadence, and tooling. Shadow live accounts on both the client and technical sides. Sit in on pre-sales calls. Start owning one account.

Months 2 and 3. Take full ownership of your first accounts. Run the meetings, build the roadmaps, direct the build. An experienced account owner stays close.

Months 4 to 6. Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

After 6 months. You own the commercial and delivery arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. New hires learn from you.

What is hard. The role spans two jobs and will pull you both ways in the same week. Pre-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. A portfolio across two continents splits your day in half.
