jobs.description:
GPU Systems Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: GPU Systems Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a GPU Systems Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads. The ideal candidate combines low-level systems mastery with strong software engineering practices, and has a track record of delivering measurable performance improvements on production GPU systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement high-performance CUDA kernels for compute-intensive workloads across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Profile and optimize GPU code using tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and CUDA profilers.
  • Tune memory access patterns, occupancy, register usage, and shared memory utilization for peak performance.
  • Develop highly optimized libraries for linear algebra, attention, and other ML primitives.
  • Optimize multi-GPU and multi-node training using NCCL, RDMA, and high-performance networking.
  • Implement custom operators and fused kernels in PyTorch, JAX, or Triton.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to identify performance bottlenecks in training and inference pipelines.
  • Develop benchmarks and regression tests to safeguard performance over time.
  • Evaluate new GPU architectures and feature sets, and advise on adoption strategy.
  • Contribute to compiler-level optimizations for tensor programs where appropriate, working at the boundary between ML frameworks and underlying accelerator codegen to unlock performance not reachable through framework-level tuning alone.
  • Optimize memory hierarchy usage across HBM, L2, shared memory, and registers.
  • Implement mixed-precision and quantized compute paths that maximize accelerator throughput while preserving numerical fidelity within bounds acceptable for the target workloads.
  • Document performance characteristics, design decisions, and tuning playbooks for internal teams.
  • Stay current with GPU architecture, CUDA evolution, and emerging accelerator technologies.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.
  • Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.
  • Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.
  • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.
  • Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.
  • Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.
  • Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
  • Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Volontariat Virtuel

Emplacement du partenaire : Cameroun

Date de début : Aout 2025

Durée de l’affectation : 3 Mois

Exigences linguistiques :Français Niveau 5 - Pleine maîtrise et Anglais Niveau 3 - Intermédiaire

L'éligibilité : Ouvert aux citoyens canadiens et aux résidents permanents du Canada seulement

Rôle du coopérant-volontaire

Si vous êtes une personne créative, bilingue et motivée par l’impact social, cette affectation vous offre l’occasion de mettre vos talents en communication digitale, design graphique et storytelling au service d’une mission porteuse de sens. Vous collaborerez avec les équipes du MINJEC pour donner plus de visibilité aux initiatives qui soutiennent les jeunes, valorisent le volontariat et renforcent l’engagement citoyen. Votre contribution aidera à transformer des réalisations locales, des témoignages et des données de terrain en contenus visuels attrayants, accessibles et mobilisateurs.

Cette mission est une belle occasion de partager votre expertise, d’apprendre aux côtés de partenaires locaux et de contribuer concrètement à des programmes qui ouvrent de nouvelles perspectives aux jeunes au Cameroun. Si vous souhaitez utiliser vos compétences pour créer des communications plus fortes, inspirantes et utiles aux communautés, nous vous encourageons vivement à poser votre candidature.

La personne sélectionnée devra mener les activités suivantes :

  • Créer des contenus visuels, messages clés et supports de communication attrayants afin de mieux faire connaître les initiatives des structures partenaires auprès des jeunes, des communautés et des partenaires institutionnels.
  • Appuyer la planification, la production et la diffusion de contenus pour les plateformes numériques, y compris les médias sociaux, les sites web et autres canaux de communication pertinents.
  • Renforcer les capacités du personnel du MINJEC en communication digitale, création de contenu, storytelling visuel et bonnes pratiques de visibilité en ligne.

Compétences académiques essentielles:

  • Diplôme universitaire ou formation équivalente en communication, marketing digital, design graphique, journalisme, arts visuels, relations publiques ou tout autre domaine pertinent.

Expérience / Compétences professionnelles essentiels:

  • Au moins deux ans d’expérience professionnelle en communication, marketing digital, design graphique, création de contenu ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Expérience dans la création et l’adaptation de contenus pour le web, les médias sociaux et différents publics cibles.
  • Capacité à travailler en français et en anglais, avec une excellente maîtrise du français à l’oral et à l’écrit.

À propos du coopérant-volontaire

Le programme de volontariat virtuel de Cuso International accueille de nouveaux et anciens bénévoles à travailler à distance avec nos partenaires internationaux et bureaux pays. Le volontariat virtuel offre plusieurs des avantages du volontariat international, cependant se démarque pour sa flexibilité; pouvant être géré à partir de chez soi et en accord avec sa disponibilité. Contribuer ses compétences à une communauté, acquérir de nouvelles compétences, et de faire de nouvelles connexions sont les avantages communs du volontariat virtuel, et pour Cuso International c’est aussi une grande opportunité pour engager plus de personnes dans sa mission.

Certains de nos partenaires se trouvent dans des zones reculées avec une connexion Internet peu fiable. Par conséquent, lorsque vous travaillez avec les partenaires, il est raisonnable de supposer que les réponses à vos courriels ne seront pas envoyées immédiatement (structure change in this sentence). De plus, pour certains de nos partenaires, il s'agit de leur première expérience de travail avec des volontaires virtuel, de sorte que la flexibilité et la patience sont une caractéristique précieuse du volontariat virtuel.

À propos de nous, du projet et du partenaire

Cuso International (Cuso) est une organisation internationale de coopération et de développement basée au Canada qui œuvre à créer des opportunités sociales et économiques pour les groupes méritant l'équité. Forts de plus de soixante ans d'expérience, nous relevons les défis mondiaux en nous attaquant aux causes profondes des inégalités. En collaboration avec nos partenaires, nous nous concentrons sur les efforts visant à améliorer la résilience économique, à promouvoir l'équité et l'inclusion pour tous et à faire progresser l'action climatique. Nous croyons qu'en partageant nos compétences et habiletés, nous pouvons bâtir un avenir meilleur. Guidée par ses valeurs de courage, d'inclusion, de durabilité et de redevabilité, Cuso combine des stratégies innovantes et des partenariats durables pour créer un changement significatif et durable dans les communautés d'Afrique, d'Amérique latine, des Caraïbes et du Canada.

Projet : Partage du savoir-faire canadien pour un développement inclusif et l’égalité entre les sexes (SHARE)

Partenaire : Ministère de la jeunesse et de l'éducation civique

Requirements

Conditions de sélection

Veuillez noter que si vous êtes présélectionné(e) pour l'affectation, vous devrez :

  • Fournir 2 références professionnelles et 1 référence personnelle
  • Compléter une évaluation linguistique lors de l'entretien téléphonique préliminaire dans la langue requise pour votre affectation.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Product, Merchant Acquisition & Growth to lead the sales and acquisition strategy for our core term product line. You will work closely with our counterpart Director of Product, Decisioning & Underwriting, to ensure a cohesive end-to-end journey from initial touchpoint to final funding.

What You’ll Do:

  • Strategic Thinking & Vision: Define a compelling product vision for the acquisition funnel and translate company strategy into actionable product priorities. Utilize strong business acumen to assess the financial impact of product decisions and identify "white space" market opportunities.

Track relevant product metrics to derive actionable insights. Actively leverage AI in daily workflows and maintain an eagerness to explore new AI engagements that can accelerate our sales and acquisition strategies.
  • Product Execution & Delivery: Oversee the development lifecycle by establishing and enabling strong product routines and scalable processes. Leverage team level metrics and actionable insights to continuously refine workflows, remove bottlenecks, and speed up our overall execution and time-to-market.
  • Acquisition Integrations: Drive the strategy for third-party and API integrations that unlock new referral channels. Manage the integration roadmap to seamlessly onboard lead generation partners and deliver a frictionless, high-converting experience for all integrated partnerships.

  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the small business lending and fintech landscape, with a strong focus on the B2B sales cycle, merchant acquisition, and optimizing the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Growth Mindset: Proven track record of managing "Growth" or "Acquisition" product teams, with a strong background in optimizing sales funnels, marketing technology, and CRM/Sales enablement tools (e.g., Salesforce ecosystem).
  • AI Forward: Comfortable utilizing AI tools to enhance productivity and highly eager to explore how AI can be embedded into go-to-market strategies and product features.
  • Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of technical constraints, evaluating technical debt vs. new features, and managing complex third-party SaaS and API integrations.
  • Leadership: Exceptional capability in gaining buy-in for product vision, resolving complex stakeholder disagreements, and leading without authority across engineering, design, and revenue-facing teams.

Kapitus Total Rewards Package Includes:

Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life.
  • Flexible Spending Account: Set aside pre-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out-of-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses.
  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Employer sponsored post-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well-being.
  • 100% Company Paid Insurances: Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense.
  • Voluntary Insurance: Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short- and long-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events.
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave: Beyond state-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones.
  • Commuter Benefits: We offer pre-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work.
  • LifeBalance Program: Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include:
    • Pet and car insurance discounts.
    • Financial services such as LegalShield.
    • Relaxation and stress management tools.

  • Tuition Reimbursement: Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy.

  • Paid Time Off and Sick Time.

About Kapitus:

Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

The Member Services Specialist serves as a trusted advisor and advocate for HealthEquity members by delivering accurate, timely, and personalized support across multiple service channels, including phone, chat, email, and emerging digital platforms.

In an AI-enabled service environment, this role leverages technology, digital tools, and human expertise to resolve member needs, provide consultative guidance, and create exceptional member experiences. The Member Services Specialist is responsible for researching and resolving complex account issues, educating members on HealthEquity products and services, and helping members maximize the value of their healthcare savings and spending accounts.

This role requires strong critical thinking, problem-solving, adaptability, and relationship-building skills to support increasingly complex member interactions while ensuring compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and data privacy standards.

This is a REMOTE position, but candidates must reside in the following states to be considered: AR, AL, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, MO, MS, NC, OH, OK, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, WY

This Job Posting is for our two upcoming training classes:

  • November 2nd - November 25th, 2026

Member Experience & Resolution

  • Research, analyze, and resolve member inquiries accurately and efficiently while adhering to established policies, procedures, and security requirements.

  • Exercise sound judgment when evaluating member situations and determining appropriate solutions.
  • Partner with internal teams to resolve issues requiring cross-functional collaboration.

Member Advocacy & Consultative Support

  • Serve as a trusted advocate by identifying underlying member needs and guiding members to appropriate products, resources, and solutions.
  • Build trust and rapport through professional, compassionate, and solution-oriented interactions.
  • Consult with members to help them maximize the value of HealthEquity products, improve financial outcomes, and fully utilize available benefits.

Product Expertise & Education

    • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

AI & Digital Enablement

  • Utilize AI-enabled tools, knowledge resources, automation platforms, and digital support technologies to improve service quality, efficiency, and member outcomes.
  • Apply critical thinking and human judgment when interpreting recommendations provided by AI-assisted tools.
  • Assist members in navigating digital resources and self-service capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve member experiences through increased adoption of digital solutions.

Operational Excellence

  • Utilize multiple systems, platforms, tools, and resources simultaneously to provide accurate information and maintain account records.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy, productivity, quality, and compliance in all member interactions.
  • Protect member information and safeguard confidential data in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Adapt successfully to changing processes, products, systems, technologies, and business priorities.

Team Contribution

  • Assist peers with questions and routine escalations.
  • Contribute to a collaborative and positive team environment.

This is a remote position.

$20.00 / hour

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision

Onboarding & Travel

New Member Services Specialists whom have been in employed with us for 6 months must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters in Utah. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

Why work with HealthEquity

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. jobs.excerpt: This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job.
jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

jobs.description:
About Us

Are you ready to build the future of the supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.

About the Team

You’ll be part of our Engineering organization, working closely with our Full Stack and WMS integration teams. The group builds and operates the production systems behind Gather AI’s warehouse intelligence platform, including APIs, integrations, data pipelines, databases, and application services used by our customers and internal teams every day.

This is a small, distributed engineering team where engineers work across a broad technical surface area and have the opportunity to see their work through the full software development lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and improvement.

About the Role

We are hiring an SDE II, Full Stack, for our India-based team. You'll build and run the web platforms behind Gather AI's products - Drone Vision, MHE Vision and SAGE, from the customer-facing dashboards down to the APIs, Integration layers and data pipelines that serve them.

This is a fully remote, hands-on engineering role for someone early in their career who already has experience building production software and wants broader ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, taking on well-scoped features, integrations, and platform improvements while developing deeper expertise across APIs, backend services, databases, distributed systems, infrastructure, and production reliability.

You won’t be limited to writing code against someone else’s design. You’ll contribute to technical decisions, troubleshoot systems in production, work through failures and performance issues, and gradually take ownership of components from development through deployment and ongoing support.

Because our team is distributed across multiple time zones, clear written communication, initiative, and the ability to make progress independently are especially important.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain production backend services using Python and Node.js/NestJS
  • Design, build, and maintain REST APIs and integrations with internal and external systems
  • Work with PostgreSQL in production, including schema design, complex queries, indexing, connection management, and performance tuning
  • Build and support asynchronous workflows using message queues and distributed system patterns
  • Apply caching strategies across application and data layers, including understanding cache invalidation and performance tradeoffs
  • Take features and integrations through the full software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and iteration
  • Containerize and deploy services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitor production systems using logs, dashboards, metrics, and other observability tools to understand reliability, throughput, and performance
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues, including failures across APIs, integrations, queues, databases, and multi-service workflows
  • Contribute to secure development practices including authentication, authorization, secrets handling, and protection against common application vulnerabilities
  • Work closely with senior engineers on technical design and architecture decisions while progressively taking greater ownership
  • Identify opportunities to improve code, reliability, performance, engineering processes, and system design rather than only executing assigned work
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Security, Customer Success, Product, and other teams as our platform continues to scale

What You’ll Need

  • 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production software
  • An engineering degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
  • Production experience with Python and Node.js/NestJS, with strong production depth in at least one and working experience with the other
  • Experience building production-grade APIs, microservices, or backend systems and seeing them through deployment and ongoing operation
  • Strong SQL fundamentals and hands-on relational database experience, including complex queries, indexing, schema design, and production performance troubleshooting
  • Experience designing and maintaining REST APIs, not only consuming them
  • Experience integrating with external systems and understanding real-world concerns such as retries, duplicate processing, failure handling, and unreliable dependencies
  • Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts including asynchronous processing, message queues, retries, consistency, and failure recovery
  • Understanding of caching, including what to cache, where caching should occur, and how invalidation is handled
  • Experience with message queues or asynchronous processing technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or equivalent
  • Experience with Redis or another caching technology
  • Experience with Azure or another major cloud provider, deploying and debugging, using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Git and modern code review workflows

CACI is looking for a Junior Systems Administrator to support a key program based in Chesapeake, VA as part of our Enterprise Solutions & Services team.

A culture of integrity.

About My Secure Advantage

My Secure Advantage (MSA) is a financial wellbeing company with more than 25 years of experience helping people move from financially concerned to financially confident. We partner with employers and other organizations to provide financial coaching, education, and digital resources to the people they serve.

Position Summary

The Financial Success Coordinator (FSC) is a member-facing contact center position responsible for providing a welcoming, efficient, and professional experience for members seeking financial coaching and support.

As a Financial Success Coordinator, you will serve as a primary point of contact for members through inbound and outbound phone calls, email, and other communication channels. You will help members understand available services, identify their needs, connect them with the appropriate financial coach or resource, schedule appointments when applicable, and provide ongoing support throughout their experience with MSA.

This is a high-volume, fast-paced contact center role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, accurate documentation, and the ability to move efficiently between member interactions while maintaining a high level of service.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Handle a high volume of inbound and outbound member calls in a professional, friendly, and efficient manner.
  • Respond to member emails, messages, and service requests throughout the workday.
  • Welcome new members, explain available services, and help them understand what to expect from the financial coaching experience.
  • Ask appropriate questions and actively listen to understand the member's financial needs, goals, and reason for contacting MSA.
  • Connect members with the appropriate financial coach, service, or resource based on their needs.
  • Schedule, reschedule, and manage coaching appointments in accordance with established processes and service standards.
  • Support callback and call-queue processes to help members receive timely assistance.
  • Conduct outbound follow-up and engagement calls when appropriate.
  • Assist members with registration, access, scheduling, and general questions regarding MSA services and digital resources.
  • Maintain accurate and complete member records, call notes, appointment information, and other required documentation.
  • Coordinate with financial coaches and internal teams to ensure effective member handoffs and continuity of service.
  • Resolve routine member questions and service issues while taking ownership of the member experience and escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Protect member privacy and confidentiality and follow all applicable company policies and procedures.
  • Meet established contact center expectations for availability, productivity, quality, accuracy, attendance, and member service.
  • Participate in ongoing training, coaching, team meetings, and quality-improvement initiatives.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in customer service, member services, call center/contact center, scheduling, customer success, or a related role.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish, both written and verbal.
  • Strong verbal communication and active-listening skills.
  • Comfortable spending a significant portion of the workday interacting with members by telephone.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls, emails, and messages while maintaining professionalism and accuracy.
  • Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to demonstrate patience, empathy, and professionalism.
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and follow-through skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills.
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems and applications while communicating with members.
  • Comfortable using CRM, scheduling, phone, email, and other contact center technology.
  • Ability to learn new systems, processes, and procedures quickly.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining engaged and accountable to the team.
  • Ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive member information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a contact center or call center environment.
  • Experience working with performance expectations such as call quality, productivity, schedule adherence, customer satisfaction, or similar service metrics.
  • Experience with CRM, workforce scheduling, or contact center software.
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, communications, finance, or a related field.
  • Experience in financial services, employee benefits, healthcare, wellness, or another service-oriented environment.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Financial Success Coordinators provide members with a consistent, welcoming experience while working efficiently in a high-volume environment. They listen carefully, identify what the member needs, provide accurate information, and take ownership of getting the member to the appropriate next step.

Success in this position also means maintaining accurate documentation, following established processes, meeting contact center performance expectations, and working collaboratively with coaches and other MSA teams to provide a seamless member experience.

Why Join MSA

Meaningful work. You will often be one of the first people a member speaks with when seeking financial support. Your ability to listen, assist, and connect that member with the right resource can have a meaningful impact on their experience.

A mission-driven organization. MSA helps people make wise decisions with money and build greater financial confidence.

Opportunities for growth. The Financial Success Coordinator team provides opportunities to develop customer-service, operational, and financial-wellbeing knowledge and advance within the organization.

Remote work. This is a fully remote position designed to support members through phone and digital communication channels.

Equal Employment Opportunity

My Secure Advantage is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Compensation

The posted pay range reflects the range MSA reasonably expects to pay for this position. Actual compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Your Role at aGlance

The Vice President, Global Direct Sales leads Mastercam's global direct-sales organization and is accountable for developing, implementing, and executing the direct-sales strategy in alignment with Mastercam's overall commercial objectives. This role owns the global direct-sales operating model, including direct account ownership, strategic account management, regional and territory strategy, customer segmentation, new customer acquisition, customer retention, expansion revenue, and direct seller productivity. *This position is open to candidates located in the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, France, Italy, Spain, Germany or Portugal.*

Leadership

  • Evaluate performance, review work quality, and provide constructive coaching and feedback to support continuous improvement, leadership development, and strong execution across the organization.
  • Lead employees and regional sales leaders across multiple geographies, cultures, and time zones by establishing an inclusive operating rhythm that balances global alignment with local responsiveness.

Strategy

Collaboration

  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders across Mastercam and Sandvik to ensure protocols, processes, and priorities are aligned, consistently executed, and positioned to support future growth.

  • Maintain clear communication and alignment with senior leadership on priorities, performance, risks, and opportunities across the global direct-sales organization.

Knowledge

  • Maintain current knowledge of departmental activities, direct-sales best practices, market dynamics, and industry trends to support informed decision-making and high-performance execution.
  • Understand relevant legislation, regulatory requirements, and internal policies across applicable jurisdictions, and ensure direct-sales activities remain compliant.

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

The Talents We’re Seeking

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Sales, Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive direct B2B sales leadership experience, including 7+ years managing global, customer-facing sales teams and regional sales leaders. Proven ownership of quota performance, revenue or ARR targets, CRM discipline, forecast rigor, pipeline management, and sales operating cadence, with demonstrated success scaling high-performing direct-sales teams in a technical, manufacturing software, CAM, or related environment.

Technical sales, manufacturing software, CAM, or related industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience leading direct-sales teams in a technical B2B environment, driving end-to-end sales execution through direct account ownership, strategic account planning, customer acquisition, expansion opportunities, and disciplined opportunity management. Demonstrated ability to improve direct seller productivity, align technical sales resources to customer needs, and deliver measurable results through a structured, customer-focused direct-sales process.

At Mastercam, we do not just keep pace with manufacturing—we set the pace. For over 40 years, we have been the name behind the breakthroughs, the partner for those who refuse to settle. When the industry says “too complex,” we say, “challenge accepted.”

Innovation. Collaboration. Growth. That is the Mastercam way. Explore more at , connect on LinkedIn, and join the conversation with #mastercam.

Peer Support

Being a Champion for Change and Innovation

Speaks and writes clearly, conveys information in a concise, organized, and logical manner. Is adept at tailoring the message to fit the interests and needs of the audience. Shows respect for the beliefs of others; encourages and promotes practices that support cultural diversity; discourages behaviors or practices that may be perceived as unfair, biased, or critical toward people with certain backgrounds.

Physical Requirements

Requires sitting for long periods of time, use of computer and other telecommunication devices. Must be able to work in a stressful environment, work independently, and be capable of critical thinking, making sound decisions, detail oriented, alert, and self-motivated.

In tandem, the LA Manager will perform lease administration services on their assigned account(s).

In this role, you will…

  • Communicate with clients and brokers / account managers for assigned accounts, as well as Landlords when appropriate.

  • General understanding of AI technology and openness to adapting to the evolution of technology.

Code for America believes government can work for the people, by the people, in the new digital age, and that government at all levels can and should work well for all people. For more than a decade, we’ve worked to show that with the mindful use of technology, we can break down barriers, meet community needs, and find real solutions.

Our employees build and transform government and community tools and services, making them so good they inspire change. We merge the best parts of technology, nonprofit, and government to help support the people who need it most.

With a focus on transparency and fairness, and deep empathy for partners in government and community organizations and the people that our partners serve, we’re building a movement of motivated change agents driven by meaningful results and lasting impact.

At Code for America, you contribute to exciting work while learning and developing in a supportive and flexible environment. Our compensation and benefits are holistic and thoughtfully curated to represent our employees and our mission. Help us drive real generational change that lasts.

Code for America is looking for a talented Staff Solutions Engineer who will collaborate with government partners and deliver technical guidance, transforming the way our government delivers services to communities in need.

This person is a deeply experienced technologist and systems thinker who builds bridges between complex legacy government systems, cutting-edge civic technology, and mission-aligned public policy.

About the role:

In this role, you’ll work with a team of designers, researchers, engineers, product managers, and policy experts across our program portfolios. You will spend time with key government agencies to build rapport with their technical team, understand their technical needs, and develop a shared understanding of how Code for America can help them achieve their goals. This will involve identifying and designing technical solutions to improve access to their programs.

Solutions Engineers at Code for America are an integral component of all of our program areas. There are currently three focused program areas at Code for America:

  • Criminal Justice, which focuses on Automatic Record Clearance,
  • Tax Benefits, which focuses on free trustworthy tax services and simplified tax filing,
  • And the Social Safety Net. Focus areas in this portfolio include food benefits, integrated benefits applications, and training & capacity building.

This role will report to the Solutions Engineering Manager and is expected to travel no more than 10% of the time.

Code for America is based in California and can employ those who reside full-time within the United States. This is a remote position.

In this position you will:

  • Partnerships and Collaboration
    • Build and maintain relationships and develop technical champions within government and partner organizations.
    • Assist in project planning and drafting statements of work and technical requirements
    • Work closely with cross-functional government partners to clarify problems and understand system constraints, and offer feasible and high-value technical solutions that consider the needs of all stakeholders.

    • Collaborate with government partners and provide written resources to communicate complex technical concepts.

    • Lead light technical implementations and low / no-code software solutions.
    • Develop and implement training plans and documents to empower government agencies to improve and modernize the delivery of government services.
  • Other duties as assigned

About you:

This role may be perfect for you if you have the technical skills to tackle engineering problems, the social skills to face human-factors problems, and the judgment to differentiate between the two. The ability to communicate complex technical concepts in straightforward language to non-technical audiences will be critical to your success.

  • 7+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solutions Architect with experience leading projects and interacting with customers.
  • Recent back-end development, database, data-science and/or devops experience.
  • 4+ years of experience coding backend systems and data infrastructure in an industry-standard language (Python, Java, C#, Ruby, etc)
  • Recent experience integrating emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI models) into existing workflows or new solutions.
  • Strong self-management skills and a proven ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously
  • Fundamentally curious and empathetic; able to thoughtfully balance partner, user, and team needs and identify solutions that move the work forward towards greater impact.
  • Tenacity and adaptability; able to navigate relationships, ambiguity, and technical challenges and unblock yourself and your team.
  • Ability to engage in research to learn about current systems and architecture, and then incorporate this knowledge to design new solutions and new architectures.
  • Curiosity about emerging AI tools and a commitment to using them responsibly and effectively.
  • A deep commitment to Code for America's mission of making government services work well for the people who need them most

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Experience working with or in government.
  • Personal experience with or professional experience working within the justice system, social safety net or other mission-relevant government services.
  • Experience working with machine learning or natural language processing technologies.
  • Experience with government procurement processes.
  • Active contribution to open source projects.

Offer targets vary based on market / geographic location. The offer targets for this role range from $128,945 to $157,850,annually. Your Recruiter will discuss compensation in more detail & answer any related questions, during the initial Recruiter phone screen.

  • Values:

    • A collaborative, cross-functional, hardworking, and joyful environment
  • Employee Enablement Support:

    • Training / guidance for staff required to utilize AI as part of their role, plus opportunities for employees to gain AI-related skills to support job and career growth
  • Retirement & 401k Plans:

  • Medical:
    • At least one no cost health insurance option for full-time employees for employee-only coverage

    • Code for America employees main residence must be within the US

    • Collaborative working hours: we aim to hold all internal meetings between 10 AM - 3 PM PT. We expect all Code for America staff to be available during these set working hours

jobs.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The Hardware Designer plays a key role in architecting and delivering complex, high-performance electronic systems for Fidus clients. You will work closely with customers and cross-functional teams (FPGA, software, SI/PI) to define system and board-level architectures, design high-speed circuits, and support full product development from concept through bring-up and validation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys tackling challenging, high-speed designs (DDR, PCIe, SerDes), working across the full hardware lifecycle, and collaborating in multidisciplinary environments. You take pride in delivering robust, production-ready designs and mentoring others while maintaining a high standard of engineering quality and documentation.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you’ll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You’ll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects in areas such as space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video, imaging, VR/AR applications, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. You won’t be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop the system and board level architectural design, but working collaboratively with the software and FPGA programmers to analyze requirements
  • Provide schematic design and component selection for high-speed circuits, SerDes to 32Gbps, control circuits, power supply sequencing, inter-board connectors, and memory busses
  • Conduct design simulations using LTSpice and prove circuits using prototype bench tests
  • Work with the Signal Integrity team to ensure a detailed analysis of critical nets
  • Participate in design reviews (Signal Integrity, PCB Layout, FPGA coding, Software) to ensure Fidus quality standards are met
  • Perform parts library creation and schematic capture, including embedded layout constraints, using OrCAD Capture CIS
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test procedures
  • Lab bring-up and in-depth verification of hardware prototypes
  • Actively collaborate with the team to address hardware & software integration issues
  • Lead regulatory certification testing
  • Generate technical and user documentation
  • Provide pre-project technical support to the business and sales teams on project scope, schedule, effort estimates, and deliverables, and post-project technical support to customers
  • Act as a mentor and sounding board to junior and intermediate electronic designers.

Who You Are:

  • Minimum 5 years of direct electronics design experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Ability to lead a design technically and as a mentor
  • Strong fundamental knowledge of high-speed circuit and multi-layer PCB design
  • In depth understanding of all aspects of the hardware product development cycle including requirements, architecture, schematic capture, PCB layout, signal integrity, verification, and manufacturing
  • Background in FPGA designs, including 32Gbps diff pairs, power/thermal design
  • Experience with high-speed devices and protocols including DDR4, PCIe Gen4, MIPI, Gigabit Ethernet, USB-C, HDMI, SerDes and JESD204B.
  • Experience with development tools such as Cadence CIS/Orcad/Cadence Allegro
  • Experience using optical test sets, signal analyzers, and GHz+ oscilloscopes for analysis of eye diagrams, phase noise, and overall signal quality
  • Hands-on debugging experience involving scopes, VNAs, signal generators, electronic loads
  • Familiarity with ESD, EMI, and RF design considerations
  • Ability to use Verilog, RTL, or HLS an asset
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

Location and travel: Fully remote role and requires around 15% travel, including domestic and international.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry—our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can’t wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our Working at Fidus page.

All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

jobs.description:
Project Overview:

The Government of Alberta (GoA) has embarked on transforming the work of government to deliver simpler, more efficient, and better services for the citizens of Alberta, thereby ensuring that the needs of Albertans are effectively met in the digital age. The Province has a strategic role within government to drive efficiencies, innovation and modernization. The Digital Design and Delivery Division (DDD) is the Province's new center for digital delivery. It was established to maximize capability and confidence in modern digital practice by ensuring service quality and value through standards and controls. This includes utilizing human-centered design approaches together with agile methodology and modern data practices.

DDD works in partnership with GoA ministries to deliver programs that better serve Albertans. DDD requires ten (10) Scrum Masters to work with DDD on service innovation, program review, and digital transformation projects across the GoA. The Scrum Master will work as part of cross-functional program review or product delivery teams. These teams, led by GoA product owners and DDD work collaboratively, and collectively participate in a full range of activities including field research, backlog definition and refinement, and sprint planning and execution. Digital transformation projects review the current state of services, identify future opportunities, and then deliver new services that are efficient, effective and affordable.

Scrum Master(s) identify and remove roadblocks and distractions that affect sprint commitments and prevent delivery of product features. Scrum Master(s) will be responsible for the management of the agile sprint process for cross-functional program review or product delivery teams, and will provide leadership and mentoring in agile principles, policies, and procedures, to enable the teams to self-organize and deliver consistently on sprint deliverables. Scrum Master(s) will be expected to manage communication, maximize transparency, disseminate information related to service delivery, and resolve any conflict when it arises.

Scrum Master(s) are expected to demonstrate AI fluency through daily use of generative AI and agentic tooling for delivery-grade work, including drafting, analysis, structured retrieval, meeting synthesis, backlog support, delivery reporting, and automation. Scrum Master(s) should be comfortable with prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation of AI output for risk, hallucination, privacy, sensitivity, and appropriateness for use in the delivery environment. Scrum Master(s) are expected to build AI-augmented routines that improve team delivery practices and reduce administrative overhead; they do not only consume AI tools.

Scrum Master(s) are also expected to demonstrate process automation literacy, including working knowledge of process-automation patterns such as workflow automation, digital forms, structured intake, status reporting, agentic process orchestration, and the implications of these patterns for roles and workflows. Scrum Master(s) must be able to translate technical change into accessible communication for business, product owners, delivery teams, and stakeholders.

Duties:

The Scrum Master will be required on a full-time basis, working across two (2) or more projects. Time, location, and frequency of work will vary depending on the needs of the particular project. At the end of each term, it is expected that the Scrum Master may work a maximum of 1,960 hours, unless otherwise agreed upon with the Province. However, the Scrum Master may be required to work fewer or more hours depending on the nature and needs of their work, as directed by the Province.
Services and project deliverables should evolve as the work progresses, in response to emerging user and business needs, as well as design and technical opportunities. However, the following must be delivered (iteratively) over the course of the project:
Lead and mentor cross-functional program review and product delivery teams in agile principles, policies, and procedures.
Lead and facilitate key agile ceremonies, including planning sessions, stand-ups, sprint reviews, product demos, retrospectives, and refinement. This could also include ad hoc sessions.
Facilitate effective delivery of Services and deliverables by the cross-functional program review and product delivery teams through coaching and guiding the GoA product owner and the team. Specifically:
o Coach the team on the application of agile methodology including how to provide effective estimates and sprint commitments, how to adjust for external dependencies, how to eliminate blocking issues, etc.
o Promote the successful achievement of sprint goals and commitments, by acting as the intermediary between the GoA product owner and team.
o Guide the GoA product owner on reporting, release planning, and road-mapping.
Maintain delivery metrics and report on product level plans, progress, and quality assurance using project management tools and Artifacts such as sprint burndown/velocity charts, product backlogs, and sprint backlogs. The Scrum Master(s) will be required to report on progress to the Province as directed.

Demonstrate AI fluency through daily use of generative AI and agentic tooling for drafting, analysis, structured retrieval, backlog support, meeting synthesis, delivery reporting, and automation.

Apply prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, and review of AI output for risk, hallucination, privacy, sensitivity, and delivery use.

Build AI-augmented routines to improve agile delivery support; do not only consume AI tools.

Demonstrate process automation literacy, including workflow automation, digital forms, structured intake, status reporting, and agentic process orchestration.

Translate technical change and automation impacts into accessible communication for staff, product owners, delivery teams, and stakeholders.
Participate in digital service delivery activities, such as user research and usability testing.

This Sales Enablement Manager is a strategic orchestration role serving major GTM initiatives across our Upsell and Fintech organization This role will own enablement strategy across high-priority, cross-functional initiatives in addition to day-to-day enablement deliverables, including onboarding content, training sessions, and stakeholder communications.
jobs.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

This Sales Enablement Manager is a strategic orchestration role serving major GTM initiatives across our Upsell and Fintech organization This role will own enablement strategy across high-priority, cross-functional initiatives in addition to day-to-day enablement deliverables, including onboarding content, training sessions, and stakeholder communications.

This role is measured on the standard enablement fundamentals — scorecard-driven coaching and performance improvement for the team it supports — and, just as heavily, on how well it orchestrates change across the Upsell functions: product releases, pricing and process changes, and system changes that ripple across Sales Enablement, Product Marketing, RevOps, Post-Sales, Demand Gen, and Upsell leadership. Rollout success itself counts as performance here — the effectiveness and impact of a change to the function, not just that it shipped. The person in this seat runs the intake, prioritization, and enablement planning process for these initiatives (including the weekly Enablement Planning forum with business partners), decides what level of enablement effort a given change warrants, and makes sure the right stakeholders are aligned before, during, and after rollout.

What you'll do:

Initiative orchestration & strategy

  • Own intake, prioritization, and sequencing for high-priority Upsell initiatives — product releases, pricing/process changes, and system changes — using an impact-tiering framework (major/minor/minimal) to determine the right level of enablement effort for each.

  • Facilitate the recurring enablement planning forum with Upsell business partners (Sales Enablement, Product Marketing, RevOps, Post-Sales, Demand Gen, Sales/Engineering) to align on upcoming changes, timelines, and success criteria before rollout.

  • Build and maintain enablement plans for Tier 1 initiatives: problem, solution, success criteria, timeline, and stakeholder alignment, documented for reference.

Process & product change management

  • Translate product releases and process changes into what IC’s and managers need to know, do differently, and be measured on — then build the training, documentation, and communications to get them there.

  • Own change management and internal communications strategy for the function, based on the actual level of change management impact.

  • Partner with Product and Product Marketing to shape go-to-market requirements and adoption programs from an enablement lens, not just react to them after launch.

Training delivery & content creation

  • Build thoughtful, effective enablement content — training materials, playbooks, aids — not just orchestrate who else builds it, partnering with functional SMEs and stakeholders on subject-matter accuracy.

  • Deliver training directly for high-priority initiatives when it's the right vehicle (instructor-led sessions, working sessions with subject matter experts & managers), rather than handing delivery off entirely to stakeholders.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Serve as the enablement point of contact for Upsell leadership, GTM, Post Sales Functions, Fintech sellers, and product/revenue leaders on anything that touches how Upsell teams sell or operate.

  • Represent enablement's perspective in cross-functional planning so initiatives land with the right sequencing, training, and change management — not enablement as an afterthought.

Performance & measurement

  • Track adoption and effectiveness of major initiatives against the Upsell scorecard (readiness, adoption, effectiveness) and flag gaps or risks honestly rather than after the fact.

  • Continuously refine the intake and tiering process itself based on what did and didn't work on past rollouts.

What you'll bring:

  • Proven enablement experience, with demonstrated impact on business outcomes in a high-growth, fast-changing organization.

  • Deep knowledge of the home services industry and ServiceTitan's product, platform, and customer base — able to speak credibly to what ServiceTitan sell and who they sell to.

  • Sales or account management experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or post-sales motion, in addition to enablement experience.

  • BA/BS degree and 4-6+ years of related experience in enablement, training, or GTM program management.

  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent, cross-functional initiatives — running intake, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment without a lot of oversight.

  • Strong track record building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders across Product, Product Marketing, RevOps, and Sales/Account Management leadership.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate product and process change into clear, action-oriented enablement for frontline teams and managers.

  • Ability to prioritize and sequence competing high-priority initiatives in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment.

  • Proficiency with CRMs, LMS platforms, eLearning software, and project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).

  • Experience in people management or a demonstrated ability to motivate and lead others without direct authority.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

jobs.description:
About Anaconda

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Summary:

We’re looking for a Senior Corporate Paralegal to own Anaconda’s corporate, equity, and entity operations as the company grows.

You will be the go-to person for equity administration, subsidiary management, board and corporate records, and the company’s insurance program. You will also support our employment legal work and take on special projects wherever the business needs you. Your work will touch every part of the company: Finance, Tax, People, and the executive team. Employees will come to you directly with questions about their equity, and you’ll help implement—and further develop—our playbook for those responses and for more of our corporate practices going forward.

We want someone who operates independently, cares about getting details right, and fixes problems before anyone asks. No task is too big or too small for this person. You will spot what could work better, build the fix, and keep moving. This is a chance to build and scale core legal infrastructure at a company at the center of AI.

What You'll Do:

Equity Administration

  • The equity administration portion of this role is deeply cross-functional and relies on you to be a stakeholder who works closely with Finance and People teams, which have critical voices in all things equity. You will serve as the primary responsible individual and administrator of Carta for day-to-day work. You will keep the cap table, equity plans, and all equity records accurate and audit-ready at all times.
  • Manage the full equity lifecycle, including grant preparation and board approvals, award agreements, exercises, vesting, terminations, cancellations, and post-termination exercise tracking.
  • Partner closely with People, Finance, and Tax on equity matters, including grants, 409A valuation coordination, equity expense reporting, compliance, blue sky filings, equity reporting and disclosures, tax reporting and withholding, and year-end equity filings.
  • Act as the first point of contact for employee equity questions. You will write clear, accurate, and approachable emails that help employees understand their equity.
  • Support equity-related work for acquisitions and other corporate transactions, including assumed or converted awards and cap table integration.
  • Keep equity-related policies, processes, and templates current, and build documentation that scales as the company grows.

Subsidiary and Entity Management

  • Own documentation and compliance for all Anaconda subsidiaries, domestic and international. This covers formations, annual filings, good standing, foreign qualifications, registered agents, director and officer changes, and dissolutions.
  • Maintain an accurate, centralized entity management system and organizational chart.
  • Support entity integration for acquired businesses, working with Finance, Tax, and outside counsel.
  • Coordinate with local counsel and service providers on international entity requirements.

Board and Corporate Governance

  • Draft board and stockholder consents, resolutions, and minutes for Anaconda, Inc. and its subsidiaries.
  • Help prepare board meetings, including materials, logistics, and follow-up on approvals and action items.
  • Maintain complete, organized corporate records and minute books. You will keep records ready for financings, audits, diligence, and other corporate events.
  • Support corporate transactions, financings, and diligence requests, including building and maintaining data rooms.

Insurance

  • Manage the company’s insurance program end to end, working with our broker and Finance on renewals, coverage reviews, applications, and policy documentation.
  • Keep a current inventory of policies, coverage limits, and renewal dates.
  • Issue certificates of insurance and respond to customer and vendor insurance requirements.
  • Coordinate notices of circumstances and claims with the broker and carriers.

Employment Law Support

  • Support the Legal team and People team on employment matters, including policy and handbook updates, separation and settlement documentation, leave and accommodation questions, and multi-state and international employment compliance.
  • Track employment law developments that may affect Anaconda’s distributed workforce and flag them to the Legal team.
  • Assist with employment-related documentation, research, and record-keeping.

Special Projects and Continuous Improvement

  • Take on special projects across the Legal team and the broader business, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves wherever needed.
  • Proactively identify gaps, inefficiencies, and manual processes, then design and build better solutions without waiting for direction.
  • Use AI tools to speed up drafting, research, record-keeping, and recurring workflows. You will build reusable AI-enabled processes that create leverage for the Legal team.
Your Impact Will Be Measured Through:
  • Accuracy and audit-readiness of the cap table, equity records, and corporate records, with minimal corrections or follow-up requests from auditors, investors, or counterparties.
  • Timely, accurate execution of equity transactions and board approvals, including grant turnaround time.
  • Quality, clarity, and responsiveness of employee-facing equity communications.
  • Complete, current subsidiary compliance with no missed filings or lapses in good standing.
  • Timely insurance renewals and fast turnaround on certificates and customer insurance requests.
  • Measurable improvements to legal operations through process redesign, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Trusted, effective partnerships with People, Finance, Tax, and the broader Legal team.
What You Need:
  • 6+ years of corporate paralegal experience, including meaningful time in-house at a venture-backed or high-growth technology company or at a law firm supporting emerging-growth companies.
  • Extensive, hands-on experience administering equity in Carta, including grants, exercises, terminations, and cap table maintenance.
  • Solid working knowledge of equity compensation, including stock option plans, ISOs and NSOs, RSUs, 409A valuations, and related tax and securities considerations.
  • Experience drafting board and stockholder consents and maintaining corporate records for multiple entities.
  • Experience managing subsidiary compliance, including international entities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a track record of producing accurate work under tight deadlines.
  • Strong written communication skills and comfort working directly with employees at every level on sensitive topics such as equity and compensation.
  • A self-starter mindset: you work independently, spot areas for improvement, and get to work without being asked.
  • A positive, team-first attitude and a willingness to take on any task, big or small.
  • Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day work, or a strong interest in adopting them.
  • Paralegal certificate and/or bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • You embody our values: Curious by Default, Build Together, Own It, and Lead with Guts and Heart, and our behaviors: Clarity, Care and Candor.
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish.
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • You have administered equity through M&A, including assumed awards, rollover equity, or cap table integration for acquired companies.
  • You have supported tender offers, secondary transactions, or financing rounds.
  • You have managed corporate insurance programs, including D&O, E&O/cyber, and other commercial lines.
  • You have employment law support experience in a distributed, multi-state, or global workforce.
  • You have implemented or improved entity management systems, equity workflows, or other legal operations processes.
  • You have built AI-enabled workflows, prompts, or tools that measurably increased your own or your team’s capacity.
  • You have worked in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • You have experience at an open-source, AI, or data science company.
Why You'll Like Working Here:
  • You’ll own core corporate and equity functions with real autonomy and visible impact across the company.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to build and improve legal infrastructure as the business scales.
  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
  • You’ll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded.
  • You’ll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity, care, and candor.
  • You’ll be supported by a culture that puts employees first, with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your well-being and growth.

The application deadline for this role is 11/30/2026;applicants will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.
